izzyondroid:com.zell_mbc.publicartexplor.name: PublicArtExplorer
izzyondroid:com.zell_mbc.publicartexplor.description:
Have you ever found yourself standing before a piece of outdoor art, curious about its story? Or arrived in a new place wondering if there’s any outdoor artwork waiting to be discovered nearby?
 PublicArtExplorer allows you to discover and explore public art around you in just two clicks. The app uses your location to instantly reveal nearby sculptures, murals, and installations, complete with detailed information about each piece and its artist.
 PublicArtExplorer’s data is based on the open platforms OpenStreetMap and Wikipedia. Because these platforms are built and maintained by a global community of volunteers, anyone can contribute: if you notice missing details or discover new artworks, you’re encouraged to add or update information directly on OpenStreetMap or Wikipedia. This collective approach means that every contribution helps to improve the app for all users, fostering a shared, up-to-date resource that benefits everyone interested in public art.
 Key features
 Show what's around and offer to show the details for each artwork.
 Aimed at providing low barrier access to public art as well as instigiating people to add missing information to OSM and Wikipedia for the benefit of others.
 Web site
 https://publicartexplorer.com/

izzyondroid:net.gmartin.paperlessngx_upl.name: Paperless NGX Uploader
izzyondroid:net.gmartin.paperlessngx_upl.summary: Upload documents to a Paperless-NGX server using the native share intent
izzyondroid:net.gmartin.paperlessngx_upl.description:
Paperless‑NGX Uploader uploads single or multiple documents to Paperless‑NGX directly from the system Share menu. This project updates and adapts the original “Paperless Share” by qcasey to modern Android versions while keeping the same simple “share and upload” workflow.
 Features: 
 Android native Share Intent integration (one action = one file).
 Paperless‑NGX server configuration (URL), username and password.
 Secure credential storage with automatic recovery on startup.
 Connection test with feedback (success, invalid credentials, unreachable host).
 Tag management: Fetches tags from Paperless‑NGX after a valid connection.
 Tag selection dialog with search/filter.
 Option to set default tags for uploads.
 Selected tags are persisted and restored on startup.
 Uploads the shared document with the configured/default tags.
 Upload status indicator; on failure, a Snackbar notifies the user.
 On success, the app returns to background.

izzyondroid:vadimerenkov.aucards.name: Aucards
izzyondroid:vadimerenkov.aucards.summary: Create reusable cards for quick access when non-verbal communication is needed.
izzyondroid:vadimerenkov.aucards.description:
Aucards is a free and open-source app where you can create colorful communication cards to help you communicate with others.
 App is based on the concept of "autistic cards", which people with special needs use to quickly communicate their feelings, their requests or inform others of their conditions.
 If you've ever experienced the need to say something when you couldn't, for example, in a moment of autistic shutdown, when you are too overwhelmed to speak, then this app is for you. It is designed to be as frictionless as possible to minimize the effort needed to express what you feel right now.
 Highlights: 
 Create an endless amount of cards with unique messages
 Choose any color from a rich palette – or create your own!
 Organize your cards however you like: drag them around or add to favourites
 Easy to use: just tap on the card to open it in fullscreen!
 Bring your cards to any device: easily export and transfer them wherever you like
 Play a sound to let others know you want to say something
 Completely free, open source and no ads – ever!
 Who can benefit from this app: 
 People with autism/adhd
 Children who have difficulties with verbal communication
 Elderly people who need assistance
 Or anyone in a situation where you can't speak: on a loud concert or a lecture!

fdroid:com.akylas.enforcedoze.name: EnforceDoze
fdroid:com.akylas.enforcedoze.summary: Enable Doze mode immediately after screen off and turn off motion sensing
fdroid:com.akylas.enforcedoze.description:
**EnforceDoze** allows you to forcefully enable Doze right after you turn off your
screen, and on top of that, it also disables motion sensors so Doze stays active
even if your device is not stationary while screen off. Doze will only deactivate
periodically to execute maintenance jobs (like getting notifications, etc),
otherwise it will remain active as long as your screen is off. This brings a lot
more battery savings than standard Doze functionality, because even with screen
off and Doze enabled, Doze is still periodically checking for movement, and
disabling motion sensing improves battery life further.
**Features**
* Force Doze mode immediately after screen off or after a user specified delay
* Add/remove apps or packages directly to system Doze whitelist
* Disable motion sensors to prevent Doze from kicking in during movement
* Tasker support to turn on/off EnforceDoze and modify other features
* Disable WiFi and mobile data completely during Doze
* Ignore disabling Wifi/Data if music is playing
* Ignore disabling Wifi/Data if hotspot is enabled
* Enable Doze mode on devices where OEM has disabled it
* No root mode so you can enjoy the core benefits without rooting your device

fdroid:com.baldo.bob.summary: Baby on Board is an application of pregnancy tracking that respect your privacy
fdroid:com.baldo.bob.description:

fdroid:com.jerboa.description:

Lemmy is similar to sites like Reddit, Lobste.rs, or Hacker News: you subscribe to forums you're interested in, post links and discussions, then vote, and comment on them. Behind the scenes, it is very different; anyone can easily run a server, and all these servers are federated (think email), and connected to the same universe, called the Fediverse.

fdroid:com.rastislavkish.vscan.name: VScan
fdroid:com.rastislavkish.vscan.summary: A visual perception layer for the blind
fdroid:com.rastislavkish.vscan.description:
This is a little project of mine aiming to research how vision LLMs could help out blind people on travel and in their every-day life by substituting eyesight for various visual tasks. VScan turns your smartphone's camera into a device for visual perception. You can define various optical cognitive functions, like looking for objects, signs, evaluating a scene or simply mediating visual impressions. You can afterwards use these functions on the camera view, just like a sighted person would use their eyes to achieve a specific goal in the physical world.
Each cognitive tool consists of two major parts:
• The camera to be used - front / back, as well as camera parameters - resolution, flashlight etc.
• The prompts used for LLM processing. LLM is the bridge between raw pixel data and your interpretation of it, and in the user/system prompt, you can specify what exactly are you interested in for the particular function and how should it be communicated, as well as the LLM model that should be used.
Camera input in combination with an LLM processing prompt forms a cognitive function, which can be used to serve various visual tasks.
VScan is open-source software. Visit the project's official repository to learn more about its background, motivation, specific usage examples and setup instructions.

fdroid:com.slate.launcher.name: Slate
fdroid:com.slate.launcher.summary: Minimal text-only Android home screen. No icons. No analytics. Zero network.
fdroid:com.slate.launcher.description:
Slate is a minimal text-only Android home screen built for focus.
Most launchers want to keep you on your phone. Colourful icons trigger recognition without thought, notification badges create artificial urgency, and recommendation widgets are optimised for engagement, not intent. Slate removes all of that. Apps are presented as plain text, the same way a to-do list presents tasks. You open the app you meant to open, not the one that looked most appealing.
APPEARANCE
* Two homescreen layouts: Flow (apps wrap like text, sized by usage) or Minimal List (one app per line with optional alphabetical fast-scroll)
* Fully customisable background and text colours with a live colour picker
* Follow system theme: switches automatically with system dark mode
* Apply background colour to the lockscreen for a uniform look
* Per-app colour overrides to highlight what matters
* Notification highlight: app names change colour when an app has a pending notification
* Typography control: font family (Google Fonts plus import your own), weight, line spacing, word spacing
* Font size scales with usage in Flow view
INTERACTION
* Swipe up to search apps
* Configurable single-finger swipe gestures (any app, notifications, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, location, camera, more)
* Double-tap to lock screen (via accessibility service)
* Long-press an app to pin, hide, rename, recolour, uninstall, or move to a folder
* Pin apps to the top regardless of sort order
* Sort alphabetically or by most used
* Custom folders: each folder is a text label with a marker (chevron, slash, bullet, brackets, count, or plain). Tap to expand inline. Long-press to rename, recolour, or delete
QUICK TOGGLES STRIP
An optional row of text widgets at the top or bottom of your home screen. Choose from Clock, Date, Next alarm, Battery percent, Charging, Time to full, Battery temperature, Uptime, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Mobile data, Airplane mode, DND, Volume, Ringer mode, Torch, Brightness, Location, NFC, and contact tap-to-call or tap-to-text shortcuts. Off by default. Pick widgets, position, and typography from Settings.
CONTROL
* Lock orientation to portrait
* Optional persistent search bar on the home screen
* Optional contact search: turn it on to surface contacts inline with apps when you type. Read at search time, never stored. Google-only sub-toggle skips duplicates from WhatsApp, Telegram, SIM
* PIN-lock the hidden apps list (4 to 8 digits, PBKDF2 hashed) with optional biometric unlock. Hidden-app launches stay out of Android Recents, with an opt-out
* Work-profile apps are listed too, marked with the profile name and grouped into a folder on first sight
* Export and import all settings as a JSON backup. Hidden-apps list and PIN are omitted by default. Opt in via Settings, with an in-memory PIN check on import
PRIVACY
Slate does not collect, transmit, or share any data. No analytics, no crash reporting, no network activity. All preferences are stored locally. App usage counts never leave the device. Each Android permission Slate declares is requested only for the specific feature that uses it. Full details in the in-app privacy policy.
OPEN SOURCE
MIT licensed. Source at github.com/roufsyed/Slate-Minimal-Launcher

fdroid:com.sleeptimer.name: SleepTimer
fdroid:com.sleeptimer.summary: Timer, which activates the devices standby mode
fdroid:com.sleeptimer.description:
SleepTimer is a timer, like the ones in TVs an Hifi systems. After a specified time the devices
standby mode is activated, as if the power button was shortly touched. It doesn't matter if a video
or audio stream is played or another app tries to prevent the standby mode.
Reactivating is possible by a short press of the power button.
Features:
- permanent notification showing the remaining time until standby
- possibility to use Androids quick settings for pausing and resuming a countdown

fdroid:com.yourname.pdftoolkit.name: PDF Toolkit
fdroid:com.yourname.pdftoolkit.summary: All-in-one PDF and image toolkit for Android
fdroid:com.yourname.pdftoolkit.description:
PDF Toolkit is a comprehensive PDF and image manipulation tool for Android.
Features include:
* Merge multiple PDFs into one
* Split PDF into multiple files
* Compress PDF to reduce file size
* Convert PDF pages to images
* Convert images to PDF
* Reorder, rotate, and delete PDF pages
* Extract specific pages from PDF
* Add watermarks and page numbers
* Password protect PDFs (lock/unlock)
* Sign PDFs with digital signatures
* OCR using Tesseract (open source)
* Scan documents to PDF using camera
* Extract text from PDFs
* View and edit PDF metadata
* Image tools (compress, resize, convert formats)
The F-Droid version uses Tesseract OCR instead of Google ML Kit
to maintain compatibility with F-Droid's free software requirements.

fdroid:de.anderdonau.hackersdiet.name: Hacker's Diet Offline
fdroid:de.anderdonau.hackersdiet.summary: This is an offline version of the Hackers Diet Online.
fdroid:de.anderdonau.hackersdiet.description:
The Hacker's Diet, published by John Walker, founder of Autodesk, Inc, and co-author of AutoCAD, as a handy Android app. You can track your weight and excercise and get a weighted moving average of your weight's change over time.
The app can be used completely offline, with local backups being created as well. You can also optionally synchronise your weight to the Hacker's Diet Online at https://www.fourmilab.ch/cgi-bin/HackDiet which has additional features like weight gain/loss goals, Trend calculations, graphs over long periods and more.

fdroid:de.neuwirthinformatik.alexander.a.name: ArcheryStats
fdroid:de.neuwirthinformatik.alexander.a.description:
This app lets you save your archery scores in blocks of six.

fdroid:de.retujo.bierverkostung.name: Bierverkostung
fdroid:de.retujo.bierverkostung.summary: Document and manage your personal beer tastings
fdroid:de.retujo.bierverkostung.description:
Developed by a beer sommelier, this app allows for managing your personal beer
tastings. Its functionality comprises the addition, changing and, if necessary,
the deletion of
* beers,
* breweries,
* beer styles and of course
* tastings.
Besides the database can be exported and imported as a whole This makes it
possible to easily migrate the application to another phone. All data resides
locally on the phone. An internet connection is thus not required.

fdroid:fr.pierre.chiffreslettres.name: Numbers & Letters
fdroid:fr.pierre.chiffreslettres.summary: Mental arithmetic and vocabulary game, no ads, no trackers
fdroid:fr.pierre.chiffreslettres.description:
Numbers & Letters is a mental arithmetic and vocabulary game, in the spirit of the well-known French TV game show of the same principle, with no affiliation to it.
Two game modes:
* Numbers: 6 numbers are drawn along with a target to reach. Build your calculation step by step, calculator-style, combining the numbers with the 4 basic operations.
* Letters: 10 letters are drawn. Find the longest possible word using these letters before time runs out.
Several ways to play:
* Solo game, with 4 levels of increasing difficulty (Emile, Nestor, Monique, Mathieu), alternating numbers and letters rounds.
* Duo game, for two players on the same phone, with a Duo mode (each keeps their own score) or a Head-to-head mode (only one winner per round).
* Network game, the same duo game but on two separate phones, connected over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth.
* Daily challenge, with a randomly drawn goal each day and trophies for streaks of successful days.
* Streak, timed, words and no-mistake challenges, to progress at your own pace.
* Free training mode, with no time limit and no round limit.
The app keeps track of your statistics and rewards your progress with trophies, offers a light or dark theme, and works entirely offline: no ads, no trackers, no network connection required (except to play a network game).
Free and open source software under the GNU GPL-3.0 license.

fdroid:io.github.samcrow.jrbpsurvey.name: JRBP Survey
fdroid:io.github.samcrow.jrbpsurvey.summary: Jasper Ridge ant survey navigation and data entry
fdroid:io.github.samcrow.jrbpsurvey.description:
The Jasper Ridge Biological Preserve ant survey regularly surveys the species of ants in each of
hundreds of locations across the preserve. This application helps people navigate to the correct
locations, identify ants, record observations, and upload them to a central database.
Note: This application is intended only for registered volunteers participating in the ant survey.
For more information about the ant survey, see https://jrbp.stanford.edu/research/jrbp-ant-survey .

fdroid:io.privkey.keep.name: Keep: FROST Nostr Signer
fdroid:io.privkey.keep.summary: FROST threshold signer and Nostr event signer for Android
fdroid:io.privkey.keep.description:
Keep is a FROST (Flexible Round-Optimized Schnorr Threshold Signatures) threshold signing app and dedicated Nostr event signer for Android. It lets you hold FROST key shares on your phone and sign Nostr events without any single device ever holding the full private key.
Keep implements the NIP-55 Android Signer protocol and NIP-46 remote signing, so any compatible Nostr client can request signatures directly.
Features:
- FROST threshold signing (2-of-3, 3-of-5, etc.)
- NIP-55 Android Signer protocol
- NIP-46 remote signing (bunker service)
- Import and export FROST shares via QR code or text
- Multiple account support
- Per-app signing permissions and policies
- Biometric and PIN authentication
- Hardware-backed key storage (Android Keystore)
- NIP-44 encryption and decryption
- SOCKS proxy support (Tor)
- Encrypted backup and restore

flathub:io.github.vipaol.mobapp-game.summary: Minimalist physics arcade: speed, flips, built-in editor
flathub:io.github.vipaol.mobapp-game.description:
A cross-platform minimalist arcade game powered by Emini physics engine. Android, desktop Java,
 and J2ME are supported.
 Two game modes:
 Endless mode: the track is procedurally generated on the fly, randomly connecting various
 structures (both built-in and custom).
 Levels: completely predefined tracks with obstacles, where the main goal is to reach the
 finish plate.
 Built-in editor: The game offers complete creative freedom. You can create your own levels and
 structure blocks for endless mode.
 Examples: The editor allows you to open the game's built-in structures and levels - they are
 highlighted and displayed at the end. Built-in structures can be overridden by naming a custom
 one with the same name (don't forget to load the structures from the main menu).
 Tools for creating tracks of any difficulty:
 Surfaces: Lines, Circles (arcs with adjustable radius and scaling), and Sinusoids for smooth
 transitions.
 Interactive Platforms: Trampolines with adjustable springiness, deadly "Lava", and "Broken
 Lines" (falling slabs).
 Accelerators: Plates that change the engine's power and direction (can also slow down).
 Physics Bodies: Round and Square physical entities. Adjust their mass, friction, elasticity,
 gravity, color, fall timers, or turn them into moving lava!
 Auxiliary elements: Finish, Spawn points, and "Link" (copies another element with an offset).

 Its main focus, in fact, is on music management.
 Features:
 Collection list and multiple user defined playlists

flathub:org.mosh.mosh.name: Mosh
flathub:org.mosh.mosh.developer: Keith Winstein, John Hood, et al.
flathub:org.mosh.mosh.description:
Mosh is a remote terminal application that supports intermittent
 connectivity, allows roaming, and provides speculative local echo
 and line editing of user keystrokes.
 It aims to support the typical interactive uses of SSH, plus:
 Mosh keeps the session alive if the client goes to sleep and
 wakes up later, or temporarily loses its Internet connection.
 Mosh allows the client and server to "roam" and change IP
 addresses, while keeping the connection alive. Unlike SSH, Mosh
 can be used while switching between Wi-Fi networks or from Wi-Fi
 to cellular data to wired Ethernet.
 The Mosh client runs a predictive model of the server's behavior
 in the background and tries to guess intelligently how each
 keystroke will affect the screen state. When it is confident in
 its predictions, it will show them to the user while waiting for
 confirmation from the server. Most typing and uses of the left-
 and right-arrow keys can be echoed immediately.
 As a result, Mosh is usable on high-latency links, e.g. on a
 cellular data connection or spotty Wi-Fi. In distinction from
 previous attempts at local echo modes in other protocols, Mosh
 works properly with full-screen applications such as emacs, vi,
 alpine, and irssi, and automatically recovers from occasional
 prediction errors within an RTT. On high-latency links, Mosh
 underlines its predictions while they are outstanding and removes
 the underline when they are confirmed by the server.
 Mosh does not support X forwarding or the non-interactive uses of SSH,
 including port forwarding.

A cross-platform ship-borne GUI navigation application made

 available charts. The application is configurable with user
 icon. The core supports:
 GPS/GPSD Position Input and Display
 BSB Raster Chart display 
 S57 Vector ENC and CM93 chart display 
 AIS Input Decoding and Display
 Waypoint Autopilot Navigation 
 Plugin support includes wheather, tactical, annotations and tidal data.
 Pilot charts can be downloaded from project website at opencpn.org.
 Other useful add-ons may be found inside the "Download" link at
 at the same site.

flathub:org.scilab.Scilab.name: Scilab
flathub:org.scilab.Scilab.summary: Scientific software package for numerical computations
flathub:org.scilab.Scilab.description:
Scilab is free and open source software for numerical computation providing a powerful computing
 environment for engineering and scientific applications. Scilab includes hundreds of mathematical
 functions. It has a high level programming language allowing access to advanced data structures,
 2-D and 3-D graphical functions. A large number of functionalities is included in Scilab:
 Maths & Simulation: For usual engineering and science applications
 2-D & 3-D Visualization: Graphics functions to visualize, annotate and export data
 Optimization: Algorithms to solve constrained and unconstrained continuous and discrete problems
 Statistics: Tools to perform data analysis and modeling
 Control System Design & Analysis: Standard algorithms and tools for control system study
 Signal Processing: Visualize, analyze and filter signals in time and frequency domains
 Application Development: Increase Scilab native functionalities and manage data exchanges
 Xcos - Hybrid dynamic systems modeler and simulator: Modeling physical systems, control systems
 Thanks to its ability to interconnect with third-party technologies and applications, Scilab
 can also act as a unique platform to bring together codes written in different programming languages
 in a single, unified language, thus facilitating their distribution, their back-up and use.

fedora-packages:apbs/apbs.name: apbs
fedora-packages:apbs/apbs.description: APBS is a software package for the numerical solution of the Poisson-Boltzmann equation (PBE), one of the most popular continuum models for describing electrostatic interactions between molecular solutes in salty, aqueous media. APBS was designed to efficiently evaluate electrostatic properties for such simulations for a wide range of length scales to enable the investigation of molecules with tens to millions of atoms. It is also widely used in molecular visualization (in such applications as PyMOL).

fedora-packages:bcrypt/bcrypt.name: bcrypt
fedora-packages:bcrypt/bcrypt.description: Bcrypt is a cross platform file encryption utility. Encrypted files are portable across all supported operating systems and processors. Passphrases must be between 8 and 56 characters and are hashed internally to a 448 bit key. However, all characters supplied are significant. The stronger your passphrase, the more secure your data. In addition to encrypting your data, bcrypt will by default overwrite the original input file with random garbage three times before deleting it in order to thwart data recovery attempts by persons who may gain access to your computer. Bcrypt uses the blowfish encryption algorithm published by Bruce Schneier in 1993.

Secondary objective is to make it possible to explore atmospheric effects such as glories, fogbows etc., as well as simulate unusual environments such as on Mars or an exoplanet orbiting a star with a non-solar spectrum of radiation. It can rpmbuild packages, dnf/yum install their dependencies, prep packages, and install them. There are commands to list package dependencies and missing dependencies. The diff command compares the current spec file with a freshly generated one, the update command updates the spec file to latest version from Stackage or Hackage, and the refresh command updates the spec file to the current cabal-rpm packaging. It also handles Hackage revisions of packages. Standalone packages can also be made, built with cabal-install.

bluejetty:00100153:ios.description:
AI CoinScan is your go-to AI-powered tool for effortless coin identification. Whether you're a passionate collector, a history enthusiast, or simply curious about the coins in your pocket, AI CoinScan offers a fast and accurate solution. Using cutting-edge AI technology, this app allows you to scan coins from different countries and time periods to instantly identify details like the year of issue, rarity, designer, and much more.
Our app boasts a vast, global database of coins, making it easy to discover both common and rare coins from around the world. With just a simple scan, AI CoinScan gives you a deeper understanding of your coins, enhancing both your collection and your knowledge of numismatics.
The user-friendly interface ensures a seamless experience, allowing you to identify coins with a single tap. Whether you’re sorting through your collection, browsing coins, or verifying the value of a piece, AI CoinScan is the ideal companion.
Perfect for beginners and seasoned collectors alike, AI CoinScan turns every coin into an opportunity to learn and explore. Unlock the full potential of your collection today with AI CoinScan and let AI do the heavy lifting!
Subscription unlocks all premium features of the app, including but not limited to an ad-free experience, faster cleaning speed, and additional storage space. The subscription will auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. You can manage your subscription at any time through your App Store account settings.
Key Features:
AI-powered recognition for accurate coin identification
Detailed information on year, rarity, designer, and more
Extensive worldwide coin database
Simple and intuitive interface for quick identification
Ideal for collectors, hobbyists, and numismatists
Ready to start scanning?

- **Powerful Bats Collection**: Swing for the stars with over 9 powerful bats. Unlock these bats to increase your chances of sending the ball into orbit.

bluejetty:00034033:ios.description:
Ace your SHRM-CP or SHRM-SCP exam effortlessly with our comprehensive preparation tool! Immerse yourself in an environment of realistic practice exams and quizzes designed to significantly enhance your likelihood of succeeding on the actual test at your first attempt. Boasting over 3,000 meticulously crafted questions by industry specialists, accompanied by thorough explanations for each, and an abundance of tests and quizzes readily available, our platform stands as the quintessential resource for your SHRM exam preparation.
We are excited to unveil our revolutionary AI feature, powered by ChatGPT, tailored to elevate your exam prep experience for the SHRM-CP or SHRM-SCP. This state-of-the-art tool offers immediate, customized support on the toughest exam subjects, ensuring you're well-equipped to tackle any challenge. Our AI, updated with the latest exam materials, flawlessly integrates with our question database, providing detailed insights into both correct and incorrect responses, and extending further advice to enhance your comprehension. Whether you're navigating through intricate HR topics or polishing your expertise, our AI guide is dedicated to assisting you every step of the way, guaranteeing your readiness to excel in your SHRM certification exam.
Our application is thoughtfully segmented into two distinct streams: SHRM-CP (Certified Professional) and SHRM-SCP (Senior Certified Professional), guaranteeing content specificity tailored to your certification goals.
## Pass On Your First Attempt ##
Praised for its detailed content analysis, innovative learning strategies, and meticulous accuracy, our SHRM exam prep app delves deeply into every aspect of the current exam syllabus, continuously updating our resources to maintain relevance. We provide extensive explanations for all answers, fostering a deep understanding of vital exam principles.
Moreover, our mobile app offers a customized study schedule that aligns with your proficiency level, study habits, and preferred exam date. Flexible in its design, you can modify your study plan anytime. Our unique readiness indicator will signal when you are primed to tackle the actual exam, aiming for a top score on your initial attempt.

Highlights:
* Specialized SHRM-CP and SHRM-SCP Exam Preparation
* Personal AI Mentor for Complex Topics
* Unlimited Access to AI-Powered Study Tools
* Over 3,000 Authentic Questions
* More than 350 Tests and Quizzes
* Comprehensive Explanations
* Five Distinct Test and Quiz Modes
* Developed by Subject Matter Experts
* Community Insights for Benchmarking
* Detailed Progress Tracking and Analytics
* Convenient Reminders and Widgets

Are you tired of the old-fashioned word search interfaces? 
Do you want to enjoy a totally new experience of word puzzle game?
Now, you can download Word Cross and play on BOARDS for FREE! 
Word Cross is a creative crossword puzzle game which can inspire your passion for brain challenges. It includes all the essences of word scramble games to make you feel totally ADDICTIVE & ENTERTAINING. 
New & Fresh Look: If you like to play board games and puzzle games, you must love the clean and fresh BOARD UI for your first sight.
Handy & Easy to Play: You can easily swipe the letters to form a specific hidden word. It’s easy to play and fun to master for everyone.

- Swipe the letters to line up words to fill up the blanks horizontally and vertically on the board
- Tap the “Shuffle” button to change the order of letters
- Tap the “Hints” button to get clues
- Get more hints with coins by purchasing or watching videos

• Nice & Clean BOARD for you (Stay tuned for customizable themes)
• More than 2000 Challenges
• FREE to get Daily Bonus
• Find words with bonus to collect more coins
• Simple & Easy to play, hard to beat gameplay
• Suitable for you to train word search skills
• No network required and you can enjoy word search at any time
DOWNLOAD now to begin training your brain and become a real master of word search puzzles on BOARDS!

bluejetty:00129351:ios.description:
Want to introduce your toddler to a musical instrument? Let your kid discover the joys of music with Baby Piano, Drums, Xylo & more by Bebi. 
With Baby Piano, Drums, Xylo & more, kids can enjoy a safe, interactive learning experience, allowing them to spend hours unsupervised honing their musical skills as they take the first steps on their music journey. 
Why teach your toddler music? 
► Musical instruments increase memory skills 
► Music teaches kids to be patient, whilst giving them an outlet to feel a sense of achievement and satisfaction 
► Learning music improves listening skills, an essential adult skill. 
Through engagement, fun, practise and play, your 2-4 year old toddler can learn Piano, Xylophone, Drums, Saxophone and Pan Flute, plus all about sounds, from animal and vehicle sounds to electronic piano. 
► Piano - learn basic notes using a single octave piano keyboard 
► Xylophone - one of the most recommended musical instruments by childhood development experts. It's easy, fun and a great start to your toddlers' musical career. 
► Drums – discover percussion instruments that teach kids how to keep the rhythm and maintain a beat 
► Saxophone – advanced, challenging and fun in equal measure
► Pan Flute – a fun, easy to play instrument with a deep cultural history
Teach your child Twinkle Twinkle Little Star, Old Macdonald, Baa Baa Black Sheep and more!
Studies show that exposure to music throughout early childhood accelerates brain development, language and reading skills. Additionally, we also know that dancing and listening to music help the body and mind work together.

bluejetty:00036106:ios.description:
BestMe: Your Personalized Path to Success
BestMe is an innovative AI-driven app that helps you achieve your goals faster and more efficiently. Whether you want to become more confident, overcome procrastination, build wealth, or improve your health, BestMe creates a custom step-by-step plan tailored specifically to your needs.
With BestMe, every plan is personalized. The process begins when you input your goal — whether it’s financial freedom, self-improvement, or boosting your confidence. From there, BestMe’s AI generates a set of 24 personalized questions designed to analyze your current situation, challenges, and motivations. These questions are unique to each user, ensuring that your plan fits your lifestyle and objectives perfectly.
How It Works:
-Set your goal by entering any objective you want to achieve. BestMe’s AI will handle everything from career advancement to personal development.
-Next, answer 24 AI-generated questions, uniquely tailored to you, which help the app understand your strengths, challenges, and circumstances.
-After completing the questions, BestMe will generate a personalized, detailed action plan. This plan will break down your goal into manageable steps that are specific to your situation.
-To help you stay on track, your plan comes with a 24/7 AI assistant that is available to provide guidance, motivation, and answers to any questions you may have.
Subscription Options:
BestMe offers two mandatory subscription plans. The standard subscription allows you to create one personalized plan per month, perfect if you’re focusing on a single goal at a time. For those with multiple goals or a desire to make faster progress, you can upgrade to the pro subscription, which lets you create up to five personalized plans each month. This upgrade gives you the flexibility to work on several goals simultaneously and maximize your success. 
Key Features:
-BestMe delivers customized goal plans based on your specific circumstances, making sure that your path to success is tailored just for you.
-The AI-powered engine analyzes your responses and provides a step-by-step guide designed to make achieving your goals more efficient and manageable.
-Your AI assistant is available around the clock to help keep you motivated, answer questions, and ensure you remain on track.
-With BestMe, users are up to 15 times more likely to reach their goals than with traditional methods, making your journey quicker and more effective.
-BestMe supports a wide variety of goals, whether it’s career advancement, fitness improvement, financial growth, or personal development.
Who Is BestMe For?
BestMe is designed for anyone seeking to make progress in their personal or professional life but unsure where to start. Whether you’re struggling with procrastination, lack of motivation, or simply need guidance, BestMe provides the clear structure and support necessary to reach your goals. It’s particularly useful for individuals with busy schedules or those who need help staying focused, offering small, manageable steps to help you succeed.
Unlock Your Full Potential with BestMe
In today’s fast-paced world, staying focused on your goals can be challenging. BestMe provides the structure, motivation, and personalized planning you need to make consistent progress. By using cutting-edge AI, BestMe transforms your dreams into achievable milestones, helping you reach your goals faster and more efficiently. Download BestMe today and start unlocking your true potential.

bluejetty:00127857:ios.name: ID Photo application
bluejetty:00127857:ios.summary:
You can easily create ID photo data from photographs taken with a smartphone.
It is also possible to save individual photo data.
The ability to retake the photos as many times as you like makes this perfect for creating ID photos of childre
bluejetty:00127857:ios.description:
You can easily create ID photo data from photographs taken with a smartphone.
It is also possible to save individual photo data.
The ability to retake the photos as many times as you like makes this perfect for creating ID photos of children too.
This app creates data that matches the general print size of photos - 4x6 size (101.6mm x 152.4mm).
You can print photos at home if you have a printer capable of printing photos from smartphones or digital cameras as the created file format is the same as that of photos taken on most smartphones and digital cameras (JPEG).
The size of the ID photo can be specified from the following options.
- height 51 × width 51mm (2 x 2 inches)
- height 25 × width 25mm (1 x 1 inches)
- height 45 × width 35mm
- height 50 × width 35mm (2 inches)
- height 48 × width 33mm
- height 35 × width 25mm (1 inch)
- height 45 × width 45mm
- height 40 × width 30mm
Other sizes of different height and width can also be specified.
You can also specify the number of cropped ID photos to be placed on a single photo print.
ID photos of different sizes can also be included on a single photo print.
Black and white (gray-scale) ID photos can also be created from a color photo.
The size of the finished print is 4x6 size (101.6mm x 152.4mm) by default, but you can change it.

bluejetty:00128636:ios.summary:
Begin your adventure as a Postknight trainee, your sole purpose – to deliver goods to the unique people living throughout the vast world of Prism!
Adventure through this fantasy world filled with boundless oceans, scorching landscapes, mea
bluejetty:00128636:ios.description:
Begin your adventure as a Postknight trainee, your sole purpose – to deliver goods to the unique people living throughout the vast world of Prism!
Adventure through this fantasy world filled with boundless oceans, scorching landscapes, meadows bursting with colour, and mountains that reach for the clouds. Only the bravest of the brave dare to embark on this adventure and defeat any monsters they meet along the way. All to become the best Postknight in this adventure RPG. Do you dare?
[ Personalised Playstyles ]
Play by your own rules. Experiment with over 80 weapon skill traits in your adventure. You can change up your playstyle and choose your preferred combos! Each weapon – Sword Shield, Daggers and Hammer – have their own unique set of combos. Which weapon will you go to adventure with?
[ Wondrous Weapons ]
Collect, upgrade and wear your armour and weapons with pride. Adventure to each new town and collect their sets of armour. Upgrade them to their fullest potential and appearance.
[ Delightful Dialogues ] 
Converse with knowledgeable elves, mighty humans, tricky anthromorphs and a technologically advanced dragon race, as you adventure through Prism. Depending on which dialogue option you choose, you can get more information, or just a response. But don’t worry, there won’t be any irreversibly wrong choices… most times.
[ Resonating Romances ]
Find your match along your adventure. Meet an eclectic range of characters you can romance, from brooding Flint, to sweet Morgan, to shy Pearl and socially awkward Xander. The more you grow closer to them, the more they’ll open their hearts. Adventure with your sweetheart(s), collect memories on dates and learn their personal preferences. 
[ Chaotic Customisations ]
Change up your style with over 150 character customisations and fashion items. With different types of outfits to suit your everyday adventure.
[ Snuggly Sidekicks ]
Adventure with a loyal companion as it follows you into battle! Adopt from more than 10 pets, each their own little personality – a mischievous bloop, a timid tanuki, playful boar, and proud feline. When happy, they’ll thank you with a buff in your adventure.
New Content!
But that’s not all! Adventure through new areas in the upcoming major update! Online interactions among fellow Postknights, with new stories, bond characters, enemies, armouries, and much more to come to your Postknight adventure.
Become a Postknight in this casual RPG adventure. Fight through nasty enemy-infested trails and deliver goods to the adorable people of Prism! Download Postknight 2 and begin your delivery adventure now!
It is recommended to play Postknight 2 on a device with at least 2GB RAM. Playing on a device that does not meet the recommended requirements may result in subpar game performances.

bluejetty:00020705:ios.name: Turmoil
bluejetty:00020705:ios.summary: Turmoil is a casual business simulation game inspired by the oil rush in 19th-century North America. It is developed by Dutch game studio Gamious and published by LTGames. In Turmoil, you are up against time and rivals on your path to becom
bluejetty:00020705:ios.description:
Turmoil is a casual business simulation game inspired by the oil rush in 19th-century North America. It is developed by Dutch game studio Gamious and published by LTGames. In Turmoil, you are up against time and rivals on your path to becoming a succesful oil entrepreneur. Start raking in the oil money and watch the town grow along with you!
[Game Features]
*Real-Time Strategy, Oil Field Management
Acquire land at the town auction, and uncover oil with dowsers, moles, or scans. Create an efficient pipe network to get the oil above ground, and buy wagons and silos to transport and store it. Wait for the right price to sell, or use natural gas to raise the oil price yourself!
*Upgrade Technology, Expand Your Connections
There are dozens of upgrades and new tools that will improve your oil drilling operation. You will need them to drill through rocks, deal with natural gas pockets, and prevent oil spillage! Don't forget to visit the saloon, the people there may have some very juicy business proposals for you!
*Buy Stocks, Become a Mayor
Start from the bottom and rise to the top! Turmoil is not all about money, you also need town shares. Use your hard-earned cash to outbid your rivals at the stock auction and become the new mayor to win the game!
*Randomly Seeded World, Challenge Your Limits
Different settings and randomly generated levels provide an almost unlimited variety of oil-drilling challenges. Challenge other players to find out who's the real deal!
*The Heat Is On, Get Ready for the New DLC!
An entirely new campaign offers you the same oil-drilling fun, but with challenging twists and interesting bonuses. The addition of magma in the underground creates danger but also offers opportunies. You can also find underground artefacts and sell them in the village, but collecting them all might be more profitable! Play card games in the saloon to earn even more money!

bluejetty:00061815:ios.description:
Veryable is an on-demand marketplace for manufacturing labor. Our platform provides tradesmen and tradeswomen access to flexible work, daily pay, and opportunities to build their skills. Veryable is helping create the Modern Tradesmen.
Find Work & Get Paid Daily With Local Warehouse and Manufacturing Ops.
Veryable can help you become an independent contractor today. The 9 to 5 jobs are a thing of the past. You deserve the right to choose when to work and how you work. Start finding work in our app today.
Veryable is an on-demand marketplace for daily workers who are looking for opportunities in manufacturing, logistics and warehousing. Veryable provides Operators (workers) immediate access to diverse work experiences, and offers them the ability to build their own flexible work schedule. Our Operators also have the ability to expand their skill sets and access daily payment options for the work that they complete. Try the Veryable app today to start getting daily gigs and flexible work opportunities. 
Whether you are looking for daily jobs, a flexible gig or any opportunity for work, Veryable is here to provide you a solution to find local opportunities so you can start working and earning money!
Join Our On-Demand Work Marketplace
Download the Veryable app, start bidding on opportunities or flexible work nearby and get paid daily. Easily set up your account in 3 steps and start looking for your next opportunity.
Find Steady & Flexible Work
Veryable provides workers immediate access to daily shifts, flexible work and temporary gigs in their area. When you download our app, you are three steps away from working and getting paid on your own schedule. This can take as little as 24 hours to get approved!
Choose Your Work
You decide where and when to work. Gain experience at multiple companies to find the right work for you.
Work and Get Paid
Complete the work assignment (Op) and get paid the next day! Your hard-earned money will go directly into your Vault account. You will automatically get a virtual card to use and will be able to order a physical card for your account as well!
Daily Gig Works & On-Demand Jobs
- Download the Veryable app, bid on flexible opportunities or gig work and start working today
- Get paid daily, even on holidays and weekends!
- Work on your schedule 
- Find flexible or independent work in manufacturing, distribution, warehousing labor fields
VERYABLE QUESTIONS & ANSWERS
How To Start Finding Ops Or Gigs 
There are three requirements to get started with Veryable: you must submit a Background Check, complete your Vault Payment Solution application, and fill out your Tax Form.
How To Prepare My Operator Profile?
When you submit a bid on an Op, your Operator Profile is displayed to the business. Your profile is the primary way businesses decide which bids to select to fill their Ops. Please make sure all your relevant skills and certifications are accurate to maximize your marketability when bidding on Ops.
Where are Veryable Ops Available?
We currently operate in Texas (Dallas, Houston, Austin, & San Antonio), Arizona (Phoenix), Georgia (Atlanta), Alabama (Huntsville, Birmingham), Arkansas (Little Rock), Tennessee (Memphis & Nashville), Florida (Tampa & Miami, Jacksonville), Indiana (Indianapolis), Michigan (Detroit), Ohio (Cleveland, Columbus), Colorado (Denver), Georgia (Atlanta), Kentucky (Louisville), Missouri (St. Louis & Kansas City), North Carolina (Charlotte, Asheville, Raleigh), South Carolina (Charlotte, Greenville, Charleston) Oklahoma (Tulsa), Utah (Salt Lake City), DC, New York (Buffalo), Pennsylvania (Erie, Pittsburgh, Scranton, Philadelphia)
This app uses background location to validate your location for the duration of your ongoing Op to resolve mistaken disputes and payouts. Continued use of background location may decrease battery life.

Veryable is an on-demand marketplace for manufacturing labor. Our platform provides tradesmen and tradeswomen access to flexible work, daily pay, and opportunities to build their skills. Veryable is helping create the Modern Tradesmen.

Find Work & Get Paid Daily With Local Warehouse and Manufacturing Ops.
Veryable can help you become an independent contractor today. The 9 to 5 jobs are a thing of the past. You deserve the right to choose when to work and how you work. Start finding work in our app today.

Veryable is an on-demand marketplace for daily workers who are looking for opportunities in manufacturing, logistics and warehousing. Veryable provides Operators (workers) immediate access to diverse work experiences, and offers them the ability to build their own flexible work schedule. Our Operators also have the ability to expand their skill sets and access daily payment options for the work that they complete. Try the Veryable app today to start getting daily gigs and flexible work opportunities. 

Whether you are looking for daily jobs, a flexible gig or any opportunity for work, Veryable is here to provide you a solution to find local opportunities so you can start working and earning money!

Join Our On-Demand Work Marketplace
Download the Veryable app, start bidding on opportunities or flexible work nearby and get paid daily. Easily set up your account in 3 steps and start looking for your next opportunity.

Find Steady & Flexible Work
Veryable provides workers immediate access to daily shifts, flexible work and temporary gigs in their area. When you download our app, you are three steps away from working and getting paid on your own schedule. This can take as little as 24 hours to get approved!

Choose Your Work
You decide where and when to work. Gain experience at multiple companies to find the right work for you.

Work and Get Paid
Complete the work assignment (Op) and get paid the next day! Your hard-earned money will go directly into your Vault account. You will automatically get a virtual card to use and will be able to order a physical card for your account as well!

Daily Gig Works & On-Demand Jobs
- Download the Veryable app, bid on flexible opportunities or gig work and start working today
- Get paid daily, even on holidays and weekends!
- Work on your schedule 
- Find flexible or independent work in manufacturing, distribution, warehousing labor fields

VERYABLE QUESTIONS & ANSWERS
How To Start Finding Ops Or Gigs 
There are three requirements to get started with Veryable: you must submit a Background Check, complete your Vault Payment Solution application, and fill out your Tax Form.

How To Prepare My Operator Profile?
When you submit a bid on an Op, your Operator Profile is displayed to the business. Your profile is the primary way businesses decide which bids to select to fill their Ops. Please make sure all your relevant skills and certifications are accurate to maximize your marketability when bidding on Ops.

Where are Veryable Ops Available?
We currently operate in Texas (Dallas, Houston, Austin, & San Antonio), Arizona (Phoenix), Georgia (Atlanta), Alabama (Huntsville, Birmingham), Arkansas (Little Rock), Tennessee (Memphis & Nashville), Florida (Tampa & Miami, Jacksonville), Indiana (Indianapolis), Michigan (Detroit), Ohio (Cleveland, Columbus),  Colorado (Denver),  Georgia (Atlanta), Kentucky (Louisville), Missouri (St. Louis & Kansas City), North Carolina (Charlotte, Asheville, Raleigh), South Carolina (Charlotte, Greenville, Charleston) Oklahoma (Tulsa), Utah (Salt Lake City), DC, New York (Buffalo), Pennsylvania (Erie, Pittsburgh, Scranton, Philadelphia)

This app uses background location to validate your location for the duration of your ongoing Op to resolve mistaken disputes and payouts. Continued use of background location may decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00098221:ios.description:
Face the path no one would walk. Believe in what was lost. Some truths are buried where only the high-hearted dare step.
“Legendary Tales: Map of Hope” is an adventure game in the Hidden Objects genre, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters, and complicated quests.
Lucia and her brother have spent years running and hiding from witches, with nowhere left to turn. But their old friend Skarlett brings news that dispels the looming despair: there may be a place where they can finally reunite with their own kind.
Unfortunately, Skarlett cannot join the journey. The risk of exposing herself among the witches is far too great. Lucia must walk this path alone.
Still, as ever, she and her brother won’t be truly alone. Along the way, they’ll find allies—some familiar, some unexpected—each helping them inch closer to that distant dream.
Will they finally find peace among their kindred?
Prove that the legends are true
Explore the magic world and its forgotten secrets
Gather fascinating collections and find dozens of morphing objects
Enjoy stunning locations and beautiful soundtracks
Solve dozens of puzzles and test your skills in exciting mini-games

Themify is made for anyone who wants a clean, aesthetic iPhone s
bluejetty:00020701:ios.description:
Personalize your iPhone with aesthetic themes, custom icon packs, widgets, and wallpapers—all you need for deep Home Screen customization and trendy Lock Screens in one app. 
Themify is made for anyone who wants a clean, aesthetic iPhone setup without the hassle of setting up each element manually. Switch styles instantly and redesign your Home and Lock Screens with all-in-one, ready-made iOS themes. Stay on trend with endless layout ideas for every season and mood. Mix and match background colors, icon styles, widgets, and wallpapers to create one-of-a-kind looks. 
With over 2.5K themes, 4K+ widgets, 2K+ icon packs, 5.8K+ wallpapers, and 1K+ lock screen themes, you’ll always have something new to try. 
Here’s what you get inside the app: 
THEMES 
Transform your Home and Lock Screens in one tap with 3-in-1 themes that apply matching icons, widgets, and wallpapers instantly. Pastel, anime, minimal, dark, seasonal—pick a vibe and enjoy fresh, aesthetic home screen ideas every day. 
ICON PACKS 
Refresh your apps with cohesive custom icon packs designed to elevate your setup. Explore thousands of styles—from cute and minimal to bold, neon, and premium. No more mismatched styles! Use the icon changer to change the icons on your iPhone in minutes. 
WIDGETS 
Enjoy thousands of widgets for Home Screen, Lock screen widgets, and StandBy widgets—aesthetic, functional, and perfect for keeping your iPhone useful even when it’s charging or idle. Use the widget maker for iOS to create widgets that show what matters: steps, sleep, water, weather, clocks, calendars, photos, quotes, and more. 
LIVE & STILL WALLPAPERS 
Browse a huge library of still and live wallpapers—anime, nature, liquid glass, holidays, pastels, cityscapes, gradients, and more. Match wallpapers with themes and icon packs for a complete aesthetic iPhone setup. 
THEME MAKER 
If ready-made isn’t enough, you can build your own! Customize wallpapers, widgets, icons, shapes, and colors to create a one-of-a-kind theme that reflects your style. 
APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION 
Sync your steps, sleep, water intake, and activity data directly from Apple Health and display it inside your aesthetically designed widgets. 
With Themify, you get everything you need to create an iPhone that feels truly yours—from instant makeovers to deep, playful customization. 
WHY USERS LOVE IT 
– Icons, themes, widgets, and wallpapers are all in one place—no more searching 
– Complete Home and Lock Screen themes apply in seconds 
– Deep customization works without any technical steps 
– Styles match any mood, season, or trend 
– New content drops regularly, so there’s always something fresh 
If you’re tired of default iOS icons and wallpapers, cluttered or mismatched home screen setups, or wasting time searching for matching themes and decent icon packs online, Themify is here to save the day. 
Download now and give your iPhone a complete makeover in minutes! 
UNLIMITED ACCESS MEMBERSHIP 
• Get unlimited access to all Themify features with a weekly or annual subscription. 
• Your subscription renews automatically based on your selected plan. 
Your personal data is protected according to our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy: 
https://aiby.mobi/widget/terms/
https://aiby.mobi/widget/privacy/

Convo is a social skills builder designed to help you speak better, connect faster, and feel confident in conversations.

How Convo Works
Short daily speaking exercises
Guided conversation practice
Real-world scenarios
Clear feedback on how you speak
Lessons designed to build confidence
No pressure. No awkward roleplay.
Just simple speaking practice that works.
What You’ll Practice
Conversation skills
Social skills & communication
Conversation starters
Speaking clearly & confidently
Charisma and presence
Social anxiety relief
Who Convo Is For
Anyone working on social skills
People with social anxiety
Professionals who want to speak better
Anyone who wants stronger conversations
Social Skills Are Learnable
Speaking well isn’t a personality trait.
It’s a skill.

bluejetty:00037391:ios.description:
EMBARK ON A HEARTWARMING JOURNEY WITH ANNE
Dive into the charming world of "Oh My Anne", where puzzles, fun, and adventure intertwine.
Experience Anne Shirley's endearing story in Green Gables, brought to life in a beautiful puzzle game that's both relaxing and stimulating.
A STORY FILLED WITH FRIENDSHIP AND SUPRISES
Follow Anne as she navigates the twists and turns of life in Avonlea.
From heartwarming friendships to unexpected turns, each chapter in Anne's life is a delightful mix of joyand challenge.
Help her foster relationships with the townspeople and witness her touching story unfold.
RENOVATE AND REVIVE GREEN GABLES
Unleash your creativity as you renovate and rejuvenate the Green Gables.
Engage in fun, match-3 puzzles to transform Anne’s home.
From mopping floors to choosing elegant decor, every choice spreads happiness and brings Anne's world to life.
PUZZLES GALORE: FUN, ENGAGING, AND RELAXING
Our game offers a variety of match-3 puzzles that cater to both puzzle veterans and newcomers.
With educational elements, these puzzles provide a fulfilling challenge.
Solve puzzles to progress in Anne’s story and unlock new chapters of fun and relaxation.
A ZEN-LIKE, RELAXING EXPERIENCE
"Oh My Anne" is not just a game; it's a journey of healing and joy.
Enjoy a zen-like atmosphere where every match and renovation brings a sense of accomplishment and serenity.
It's an ideal escape into a world of beauty and calm.
FOR EVERYONE: KIDS AND ADULTS ALIKE
Designed for all ages, "Oh My Anne" combines the joy of puzzle games with the charm of Anne’s story.
It's a perfect blend of education, fun, and the classic tale of Anne of Green Gables.
Bring your family together for a wonderful gaming experience.
CONCLUSION: A WORLD OF BEAUTY AWAITS
As Anne herself would say, "Isn't it wonderful that every day is a new beginning?"
Join us in this beautiful, puzzle-filled adventure and become a part of Anne’s extraordinary world.
"Oh My Anne" is not just a game; it's a heartwarming experience that stays with you.

bluejetty:00060722:ios.name: ABC Alphabet Learn & Draw Kids
bluejetty:00060722:ios.summary:
"ABC Kids: Alphabet Tracing" is a fun and creative learning app designed to help children explore letters, numbers, drawing, coloring, math, and more through engaging activities.
From learning the ABC alphabet to creating their own drawing
bluejetty:00060722:ios.description:
"ABC Kids: Alphabet Tracing" is a fun and creative learning app designed to help children explore letters, numbers, drawing, coloring, math, and more through engaging activities.
From learning the ABC alphabet to creating their own drawings, children can practice important early learning skills while having fun. With colorful activities, easy-to-use drawing tools, alphabet cards, number exercises, coloring pages, and guided step-by-step drawing lessons, there is always something new to discover.
### LEARN THE ABC ALPHABET
Make learning letters fun and interactive!
• Learn uppercase and lowercase letters
• Practice alphabet tracing and writing
• Recognize letters and alphabet objects
• Explore colorful ABC activities
• Develop early reading and writing skills
### STEP-BY-STEP DRAWING
Learning to draw is easier when you take it one step at a time!
Our guided drawing lessons show children how to create pictures using simple, easy-to-follow steps. Kids can start with basic lines and shapes and gradually complete a full drawing.
Discover step-by-step lessons for:
• ABC alphabet drawings
• Cute animals
• Toys for kids
• Shapes
• Everyday objects
• Fun characters and more
It is a great way for children to practice drawing while developing creativity, concentration, and hand-eye coordination.
### DRAW & CREATE
Give kids a space to express their creativity.
• Draw freely on the canvas
• Try different pens and drawing tools
• Choose from fun colors
• Practice lines and shapes
• Create unique artwork
### COLORING BOOK
Bring pictures to life with color!
Explore fun coloring activities created for children. Kids can choose colors, fill their favorite pictures, and enjoy creative play at their own pace.
### LEARN NUMBERS
Learning numbers can be creative too!
• Learn and recognize numbers
• Practice writing numbers
• Draw and trace numbers
• Enjoy number coloring activities
• Build early counting skills
### FUN WITH MATH
Introduce children to basic math through simple and engaging activities.
Kids can practice early mathematical concepts while building confidence with numbers and problem solving.
### ALPHABET CARDS
Explore colorful alphabet cards that make recognizing letters and related objects easier and more enjoyable.
Alphabet cards provide a simple visual way for young learners to become familiar with A–Z while expanding their early vocabulary.
### LEARNING + CREATIVITY IN ONE APP
ABC Kids: Alphabet Tracing combines educational activities with creative play, giving children different ways to learn and express themselves.
Whether they want to trace a letter, practice a number, solve a simple math activity, color a picture, create their own artwork, or learn how to draw something step by step, they can find it all in one place.

bluejetty:00182784:ios.description:
Brace yourself for an age of massive medieval war, where you will march over your rivals’ burning remains in an all-out quest to conquer!
Fortify your castle, forge an army and enter the ultimate MMO of global domination! But as your civilisation grows, you’ll clash with ambitious powers, and only one king can claim the throne! Do you have the strength to unify the land under your banner? Or will you watch your kingdom crumble before you?
◉ A KINGDOM IN YOUR HANDS
• Dispatch armies, construct buildings, clash with barbarians, conquer territories and reshape the balance of power every day. 
• Every inch of your realm comes to life with amazingly detailed graphics
◉ CHOOSE YOUR FACTION
• Choose to be a Shogun, a Highland King, a Northern Tsar or a Desert Sultan.
• Each army has a special advantage that emphasises a unique playstyle, whether you prefer to quickly build up your kingdom, strike with charging knights or fiercely defend your civilisation from invasion.
◉ TERRITORIAL DOMINATION
• Clash and conquer to grow your global influence daily.
• Unlock special powers and bonuses as more lands fall to your army.
• Fortify your defences to ward off enemy invasions.
• Fight your way to the throne to become High King over the entire realm!
◉ FORGE A CHAMPION
• Choose a unique Champion – ranging from those as noble as knights or as merciless as Vikings – to lead your army and help build your kingdom.
• Find and craft equipment to boost your Champion’s skills.
• Command heroes and adventurers to set off on quests for treasures that will pave your path to the throne.
◉ BUILD A THRIVING NATION
• Build regional structures that you and your many allies can benefit from.
• Establish thriving Trade Centres, forge sacred Temples, and clash over Stockpiles of treasure.
◉ TACTICAL MMO WARFARE
• A wise king chooses battle formations carefully! Cunning tactics hold more power than massive numbers.
• Time your commands wisely to take advantage of the ever-changing seasons.
◉ COMMAND A GLOBAL ALLIANCE
• The Alliance management system makes it easy to organise with allies.
• Intrigue will pave your path to the throne as you craft schemes with other Alliances. In this MMO world, there’s as much to gain from helping as there is from betraying.
• Chat with players to forge friendships or verbally clash with rivals.
◉ CLAIM THE SEATS OF POWER
• Capture the five highly fortified castles that hold the Seat of Domain, Seat of Heroes, Seat of War, Seat of Order and Seat of Accord.
• Each Seat grants its controlling Alliance unique perks and the ability to propose world-changing Policies.
• Every player can take part, as all Policies are voted on by the entire Realm’s player population!
• Enter a new level of diplomacy and intrigue as your Alliance must negotiate with rivals, and players at large, in order to win the votes needed to pass the Policies you want.
• At the centre of it all lies the Throne of Might, which only one player may rule to wield the greatest power of all!
Five castles hold the crucial thrones, each possessing a unique influence over the entire realm that only one Alliance can hold.
Download it now and forge your path to the throne!

bluejetty:00097943:ios.description:
Your daily beauty guide — for skincare and makeup that fits your face, not a trend.
EPICA starts with your data. A detailed face scan identifies your skin type, color archetype, undertone, face shape, and specific concerns. From there, everything is deeply personalized: your skincare routine, your color palette, your makeup style, and your learning path. No generic advice — just recommendations built around the face you actually have.
WHAT BEAUTY EXPERTS ARE SAYING
"The precision of analysis combined with trusted techniques." — Uli
"A makeup guide in your pocket." — Nensy
"Practical daily makeup that actually works." — Marta
TRACK YOUR SKIN PROGRESS
Spending money on serums but not sure they're working? EPICA's Daily Skin Tracker measures hydration, texture, pores, and early signs of aging — then tracks changes over weeks so you can see real trends, not just daily fluctuations. When you switch products or adjust your routine, your data shows clearly whether to continue or make a change. 93% of users noticed measurably improved hydration after just 4 weeks of consistent tracking.
FIND YOUR FACE SHAPE
EPICA identifies your face shape in 60 seconds and filters every recommendation through it — from blush placement and contouring zones to highlight areas and brow shaping. All guidance is built specifically for your proportions, not borrowed from someone else's tutorial.
KNOW YOUR COLORS
Your undertone changes which shades of clothing, makeup, and accessories complement you best. EPICA's Color Scanner reads your complexion in approximately 3 minutes and maps your unique color archetype — complete with a personalized palette, a curated moodboard, and celebrity matches who share your coloring. It takes the guesswork out of choosing foundation, lipstick, eyeshadow, and even wardrobe accents.
MAKEUP STYLES FOR YOUR FEATURES
EPICA generates personalized makeup styles based entirely on your scan results — your coloring, facial structure, and skin condition — then shows you exactly how to execute them step by step. Whether it's everyday natural looks, polished date-night styles, or bold creative experiments, every suggestion is tailored to what actually flatters you.
LEARN FROM PROFESSIONAL ARTISTS
EPICA's lessons — called Epics — are created by professional makeup artists and carefully matched to your archetype, skill level, and personal goals. Each focused 10–15 minute lesson is designed to deliver one real, visible result — whether you're a complete beginner learning basics or an experienced user refining advanced technique.
PROTECT YOUR SKIN DAILY
UV exposure is responsible for up to 80% of visible skin aging, including wrinkles, dark spots, and loss of elasticity. EPICA's UV Index tracks real-time sun intensity based on your location and gives you personalized SPF recommendations before you even have to think about it. Stay protected without the guesswork.
FACE MASSAGE & LYMPHATIC SYSTEM
Puffiness, dull skin, and jawline tension — these are signals your body is sending you. EPICA's guided face massage routines are designed to address muscle tension, support lymphatic drainage, and promote fascial release. Each routine comes with clear step-by-step video guidance that you can easily follow at home in just a few minutes a day.
A PLAN THAT ADAPTS WITH YOU
Your skin changes with the seasons, with stress levels, with hormonal shifts, and with age. EPICA understands this and prompts you to rescan every 4–8 weeks so your guidance always stays current and relevant. From teenage breakouts to mature skin concerns, your profile evolves alongside you.

listings.description:
Your daily beauty guide — for skincare and makeup that fits your face, not a trend.

EPICA starts with your data. A detailed face scan identifies your skin type, color archetype, undertone, face shape, and specific concerns. From there, everything is deeply personalized: your skincare routine, your color palette, your makeup style, and your learning path. No generic advice — just recommendations built around the face you actually have.

WHAT BEAUTY EXPERTS ARE SAYING
"The precision of analysis combined with trusted techniques." — Uli
"A makeup guide in your pocket." — Nensy
"Practical daily makeup that actually works." — Marta

TRACK YOUR SKIN PROGRESS
Spending money on serums but not sure they're working? EPICA's Daily Skin Tracker measures hydration, texture, pores, and early signs of aging — then tracks changes over weeks so you can see real trends, not just daily fluctuations. When you switch products or adjust your routine, your data shows clearly whether to continue or make a change. 93% of users noticed measurably improved hydration after just 4 weeks of consistent tracking.

FIND YOUR FACE SHAPE
EPICA identifies your face shape in 60 seconds and filters every recommendation through it — from blush placement and contouring zones to highlight areas and brow shaping. All guidance is built specifically for your proportions, not borrowed from someone else's tutorial.

KNOW YOUR COLORS
Your undertone changes which shades of clothing, makeup, and accessories complement you best. EPICA's Color Scanner reads your complexion in approximately 3 minutes and maps your unique color archetype — complete with a personalized palette, a curated moodboard, and celebrity matches who share your coloring. It takes the guesswork out of choosing foundation, lipstick, eyeshadow, and even wardrobe accents.

MAKEUP STYLES FOR YOUR FEATURES
EPICA generates personalized makeup styles based entirely on your scan results — your coloring, facial structure, and skin condition — then shows you exactly how to execute them step by step. Whether it's everyday natural looks, polished date-night styles, or bold creative experiments, every suggestion is tailored to what actually flatters you.

LEARN FROM PROFESSIONAL ARTISTS
EPICA's lessons — called Epics — are created by professional makeup artists and carefully matched to your archetype, skill level, and personal goals. Each focused 10–15 minute lesson is designed to deliver one real, visible result — whether you're a complete beginner learning basics or an experienced user refining advanced technique.

PROTECT YOUR SKIN DAILY
UV exposure is responsible for up to 80% of visible skin aging, including wrinkles, dark spots, and loss of elasticity. EPICA's UV Index tracks real-time sun intensity based on your location and gives you personalized SPF recommendations before you even have to think about it. Stay protected without the guesswork.

FACE MASSAGE & LYMPHATIC SYSTEM
Puffiness, dull skin, and jawline tension — these are signals your body is sending you. EPICA's guided face massage routines are designed to address muscle tension, support lymphatic drainage, and promote fascial release. Each routine comes with clear step-by-step video guidance that you can easily follow at home in just a few minutes a day.

A PLAN THAT ADAPTS WITH YOU
Your skin changes with the seasons, with stress levels, with hormonal shifts, and with age. EPICA understands this and prompts you to rescan every 4–8 weeks so your guidance always stays current and relevant. From teenage breakouts to mature skin concerns, your profile evolves alongside you.

Note: Deleting the app does not cancel your subscription.

Subscriptions Terms: https://epica-beauty.com/subscription-terms

bluejetty:00140388:ios.description:
Think you have what it takes to win the White House?
270 | Two Seventy is a political strategy game where every decision matters. Choose your candidate, build your campaign, and battle across the electoral map to secure the 270 Electoral Votes needed to become President of the United States.
Winning isn't just about taking the biggest states. Every state has its own campaign cost, Electoral Votes, and strategic value. Spend your resources wisely, build momentum in the right places, and outmaneuver your opponents on your path to victory.
BUILD YOUR PATH TO 270
There's no single road to the White House. Fight for battleground states, dominate key regions, or build an unexpected coalition your opponent never saw coming. Every election presents a new strategic challenge.
CHOOSE YOUR CANDIDATE
Take control of a huge roster of political figures from across American history and today's political landscape. Create dream matchups, replay political rivalries, and discover how different candidates can change your strategy.
WIN OVER KEY VOTING GROUPS
States are only part of the battle. Compete for powerful Geographic and National Groups that reward campaigns built around a smart nationwide strategy. Where you invest can be just as important as how much you spend.
TAKE ON THE AI
Build your campaign against computer-controlled opponents in single-player elections. Experiment with different candidates and strategies, sharpen your skills, and find new paths to 270 at your own pace.
CHALLENGE OTHER PLAYERS
Think you've mastered the electoral map? Put your campaign strategy to the test against other players. Anticipate their moves, battle over critical states, and prove you can build the better path to the White House.
PLAY BEYOND THE GENERAL ELECTION
Take the campaign in a different direction with Democratic and Republican Primary elections, or compete in special in-app Tournaments where players battle for a place at the top of the leaderboard. Replay famous political matchups, create elections that never happened, or see if your favorite candidate has what it takes to reach 270.
Every state matters. Every dollar counts. Every move can change the election.
270 | Two Seventy - Win the US Election
All Characters Subscription (optional):

Subscriptions will auto-renew within 24-hours prior to the end of the current billing period, at a rate of $7.49 unless auto-renew is cancelled through your iTunes account. Subscriptions may be managed by you, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00176709:ios.name: Idle Sports: Tycoon Games
bluejetty:00176709:ios.summary: Build stadiums, fill the stands and grow your sports empire! Idle Sports Stadium Tycoon is an idle tycoon game where you turn a small venue into a growing sports business. Hire managers, automate your stadiums and reinvest your in-game cash
bluejetty:00176709:ios.description:
Build stadiums, fill the stands and grow your sports empire! Idle Sports Stadium Tycoon is an idle tycoon game where you turn a small venue into a growing sports business. Hire managers, automate your stadiums and reinvest your in-game cash across 20+ sports.
Enjoy idle games and tycoon games? Take charge of the business behind the action. Upgrade sports venues, attract more fans and unlock new stadiums as you build your empire. From football stadiums to basketball courts and hockey arenas, your next expansion awaits.
BUILD YOUR STADIUM TYCOON EMPIRE
Start with a small stadium and expand into new sports venues. Build venues for American football, basketball, baseball, hockey, golf, tennis and more. Grow your sports business, improve your facilities and bring bigger crowds to your venues.
Combine stadium building with the steady growth of tycoon games. Choose where to invest your earnings, develop your stadiums and expand into new cities. Build a sports empire where every venue is another opportunity to grow.
HIRE MANAGERS AND AUTOMATE YOUR STADIUMS
Hire managers and automate stadium operations. Keep your venues earning without constant tapping while you focus on upgrades and expansion. Develop your characters and meet each venue's requirements to unlock automation.
Enjoy the steady progress of idle games as a stadium owner. Collect idle cash, improve your businesses and put your profits toward the next stadium. Your managers keep the business running while you plan your next move.
UPGRADE VENUES AND GROW YOUR PROFITS
Make your next investment count in this idle tycoon simulator. Spend your in-game money to bring in more customers, increase venue income and work toward upgrade milestones. Reinvest the profits to keep your sports empire growing.
Choose what to develop next as your stadium empire grows. Improve an existing venue or save toward another stadium. Build and upgrade your sports facilities as you progress. You run the venues, not the teams: focus on growing your empire rather than managing match tactics.
EARN IDLE CASH WHILE YOU ARE AWAY
Your automated stadiums keep earning between sessions. Return to collect your idle money, check your progress and choose your next upgrade. Build a business that makes progress even when you take a break.
Enjoy idle clicker games? Tap to boost earnings, or let your managers handle operations. Whether you like idle games for quick check-ins or tycoon games for building an empire, there is another investment waiting when you return.
TAKE ON THE SHADY SIDE OF SPORTS
Growing your stadium business is only part of the story. Meet corrupt commissioners, shady referees and over-the-top paparazzi as you expand your empire. Follow a playful storyline filled with unusual characters and sports-world troublemakers.
Bring a story-driven twist to idle tycoon games as you build your way through new cities. Protect your stadium business and keep your plans moving, even when the people around you have other ideas.
PLAY EVENTS AND STADIUM CHALLENGES
Join weekly events, work toward milestone rewards and climb event leaderboards. Take on limited-time challenges alongside your main sports business and put your management skills to work on new goals.
Take the owner's seat: run sports venues, automate income and keep your empire growing. Build stadiums while exploring events and challenges that give your next visit a new goal. Compete for leaderboard positions as you develop your event venues.
BUILD YOUR SPORTS EMPIRE
From your first venue to a collection of stadiums, every upgrade is part of a bigger plan. Combine the progress of idle tycoon games with stadium building, automated earnings and a humorous sports story.
Hire your managers, automate your stadiums and become a stadium tycoon. Start building your sports empire in Idle Sports Stadium Tycoon today!
Got ideas or issues? Contact us at sports.idle@kanoapps.com
Playing Idle Sports Stadium Tycoon requires an internet connection.

MOOVANCE – Walk More. Move More. Earn Rewards.
What if walking, cycling or commuting every day could improve your health, help the planet and earn you real rewards?
With Moovance, every step counts. Track your activity, stay motivated and get rewarded for moving more.
Join more than 1M+ users already using Moovance to walk more and live healthier.
TRACK YOUR HEALTH AND ACTIVITY
Moovance turns your daily movement into a powerful health and fitness tracker.
With Life+, monitor your progress and build a sustainable active routine.
Track key health metrics:
- Activity & effort tracking
- Calories burned
- VO₂ Max
- Resting heart rate
- Fitness age
- Personalized health improvement plan
- AI wellness coach
- Fitness challenges with friends
Moovance becomes your daily health and activity companion.
AUTOMATIC AND EFFORTLESS
Just move - the app does the rest.

- Friendly competitions
- Monthly prize draws with partner rewards

Your movement is rewarded.
