- Gift cards from top brands
- Exclusive perks
- Partner rewards
The more you move, the more you earn.
MAKE A POSITIVE IMPACT
Track the CO₂ you save by choosing more sustainable mobility.
Every step, ride or active trip helps reduce your carbon footprint.
WHY USERS LOVE MOOVANCE
- Easy step and activity tracking
- Motivation to walk more every day
- Earn rewards for staying active
- Reduce your carbon footprint
- Stay engaged with fitness challenges
Download Moovance and turn your daily movement into benefits for your health, the planet and your wallet.

bluejetty:00061717:ios.description:
Designed exclusively for stock plan participants with share plans serviced by Morgan Stanley, the Morgan Stanley at Work app brings many features and key functionality of the desktop platform to your iOS devices. The app enables you to view your stock plan account balance and activity, check your award vesting schedules, sell your shares and exercise options
 Interactive data visualizations give you important account information at a glance. The Morgan Stanley at Work app will apply to your existing account preferences and settings and provide you with a curated view of your stock plan portfolio. With the Morgan Stanley at Work app for iOS, you can:
• Log in to your stock plan account using Face ID or Touch ID
• Get visualizations of your assets, including positions, balances and transaction history
• View, accept, or decline grant agreements and documents
• Sell shares and exercise options
• Certify your Form W-9 or Form W-8BEN
To access this app, you must be a stock plan participant with a share plan serviced by Morgan Stanley and have previously registered on atwork.morganstanley.com. If you are a Morgan Stanley Online customer looking to access your brokerage account, please download the separate Morgan Stanley Wealth Management app in the Apple App Store®. Learn Spanish, French, Russian, Italian, German, English, Arabic, Turkish, and more through podcasts that teach you these languages using your subconscious mind. Listen to conversations throughout the day while doing your daily activities.
Start Your Language Learning Journey Easily and Quickly with RadioLingo!
Are you looking for an easy and enjoyable way to learn languages? Look no further than RadioLingo! Our app is based on subconscious learning, where you can listen to interesting podcasts in different languages to learn extra words and phrases effortlessly.
Studies have shown that listening to suitable language learning content for 30 minutes a day can improve listening and comprehension skills.
What makes RadioLingo unique?
Subconscious learning: Listen to the language you want to learn in the background while browsing social media or using other apps, and let your subconscious mind do the rest!
Diverse content: Explore over 100 conversations covering various topics from daily life, such as travel, culture, English business, and technology.
Correct pronunciation: Learn from native speakers and improve your pronunciation naturally.
Multiple levels: Choose from beginner, intermediate, and advanced levels to suit your language proficiency and progress in your language learning journey.
Most widely spoken languages: RadioLingo offers many languages, including:
Spanish Podcast: Learn Spanish easily with RadioLingo. This Spanish learning app provides a fun and immersive way to learn Spanish and practice Spanish speaking. RadioLingo is perfect for Spanish learning for beginners, even if you're just starting with the alphabet learning Spanish. Get comfortable with Spanish speaking practice through engaging conversations.
English Podcast: Learn English easily with the RadioLingo English learning app and enjoy diverse English conversations covering daily life topics, ranging from Hello English and asking for help to more complex subjects like travel, dating, culture, English business, technology, and even English proverbs. RadioLingo is a perfect free English learning app for all ages, including learn English for kids. It provides a unique feature of Arabic-English words with American English pronunciation, making it easier for both children and adults to learn English vocabulary and understand the English language.
French Podcast: Join RadioLingo to learn French for beginners and discover the features of the best free French learning app. You can learn French at all levels, starting from learning French for beginners. RadioLingo provides French verbs conjugations to help you learn and practice verb forms. Learn common French idioms and expressions.
Italian Podcast: Enjoy learning Italian easily with RadioLingo and learn Italian for beginners.
Turkish Podcast: Join RadioLingo to learn Turkish free and practice Turkish.
Russian Podcast: Learn Russian for beginners with RadioLingo. Our podcasts are created by the best Russian tutors.
Arabic Podcast: Learn Arabic with RadioLingo! Our podcasts provide a fun and effective way to practice Arabic language skills, from pronunciation to conversation. Learn Arabic vocabulary and even the Arabic alphabet with ease!
German Podcast: RadioLingo is the best German learning app that relies on real conversations to learn German for beginners and helps in conversational German.
All you have to do is download the app, select your native language and the language you want to learn and enjoy a unique learning experience!
RadioLingo is:
Easy to use: No need to memorize words or language rules in a boring way. Just listen to RadioLingo and let the language flow into your subconscious mind.
Convenient: You can learn languages while commuting, exercising, or doing household chores.
Effective: The subconscious learning method has proven its effectiveness in helping people learn languages quickly and easily.
Join RadioLingo today and start your language learning journey!

bluejetty:00019136:ios.description:
Hit the road and become a drift legend in Highway Drifter: Hajwala Online!
Turn on your engine, hit the asphalt, and become a legendary drift king in Highway Drifter: Hajwala Online! Whether you are tearing through open desert highways, mastering high-speed street corners, or battling rivals in real-time online multiplayer, this is where true drift culture comes alive.
Experience next-generation driving physics, deep car tuning, and intense PvP drift battles designed for true car enthusiasts. The road is yours are you ready to rule it?
Why Players Love Highway Drifter:
Deep Car Customization & Tuning: Build your ultimate dream ride! Modify engines, tweak suspension and vehicle weight, swap custom rims, apply unique body kits, and unlock high-performance beasts built for extreme burnout battles.
Real Time Online Multiplayer PvP: Jump into live multiplayer servers! Challenge friends and rival drivers worldwide, join drift clubs, and show everyone who the true master of Hajwala is.
Diverse Open-World Maps: Slide across massive open-world desert dunes Tafheet weave through dense city traffic, and dominate high-speed highway freeways in dynamic day and night environments.
Next Gen Realistic Physics: Feel every gear shift, tire screech, and turbo boost. Our advanced driving simulator engine delivers ultra-smooth controls and realistic crash mechanics that make every drift feel earned.
Competitive Scoring & Leaderboards: Push your modified car to the limit! Chain massive drift combos, shatter global high scores, and climb the ranks from street racer to undisputed Drift King.
Play Your Way
Whether you want a casual solo offline drive through the desert or intense online drifting battles, Highway Drifter gives you total freedom on the road.
Download now and start your unforgettable Hajwala adventure today!
Let’s Stay Connected:
Website: madhook.io
Support: support@madhook.io
Thank you for driving with the Mad Hook community!

bluejetty:00182851:ios.description:
Identity V: 1 vs 4 Asymmetrical Horror Mobile Game
Fear Always Springs from the Unknown. 
Game Introduction:
Join the Thrilling Party! Welcome to Identity V, the first asymmetrical horror mobile game developed by NetEase. With a gothic art style, mysterious storylines and exciting 1vs4 gameplay, Identity V will bring you a breathtaking experience.
Key Features: 
Intensive 1vs4 Asymmetrical Combats: 
Four Survivors: run from the ruthless hunter, cooperate with teammates, decode cipher machines, open the gate and escape;
One Hunter: familiar yourself with all of your killing powers. Be ready to catch and torture your preys. 
Gothic Visual Style:
Travel back to the Victorian era and have a taste of its unique style. 
Compelling Background Settings:
You will first enter the game as a detective, who receives a mysterious letter inviting him to investigate an abandoned manor and search for a missing girl. And as you get closer and closer to the truth, you find something horrifying...
Randomized Map Adjustments:
Within every new game, map would be altered accordingly. You will never know what’s to expect.
Select & Play Distinct Characters:
Multiple characters to choose from, customized characters to fit your own personal strategy and get the final victory!
Are you ready for it?
More Informations:
Website: www.identityvgame.com
Facebook: www.facebook.com/IdentityV
Facebook Group: www.facebook.com/groups/identityVofficial/
Twitter: www.twitter.com/GameIdentityV
YouTube: www.youtube.com/c/IdentityV

bluejetty:00023141:ios.description:
Ready to open a supermarket in a new town? Become a manager in a nice, pleasant village and sell homemade products!
Take the challenge and run your own farm to offer fresh food to the locals. Build your dream town while expanding your business, and be the most famous neighbor thanks to your hard work!
OPEN NEW MARKET SECTIONS: 
Harvest crops and feed animals, and produce enough feedstock to process different products for your clients. Improve your supermarket as you build new factories, expand your fields and farms, and handle online orders. Your village will need a bakery, dairy section, meat section, or even a produce department! Hire cashiers and stockers to replenish the racks with all kinds of tasty products!
BUILD YOUR VILLAGE: 
Expand your town with new buildings and farming areas! Open factories, create new crop fields, open a cowshed, a chicken coop, or a refinery. Don’t forget to supply your supermarket! Unlock a dairy factory, bread factory, meat plant, or beverage factory. Create your local brand, and put your village on the map!
ELABORATE YOUR PRODUCTS:
Plant and harvest different types of seeds such as wheat, corn, tomatoes, apples, or carrots. Take care of animals such as cows, chickens, hens, or pigs in your farmyards. bluejetty:00162008:ios.description:
Rack ‘em up and take your shot! 8 Ball Champions brings you the most electrifying Player vs. Player (PvP) multiplayer pool experience, where skill, strategy, and style collide! Travel the globe on the World Tour, master insane trick shots, and unlock powerful custom characters and legendary equipment to enhance your gameplay and style.
THRILLING PvP ACTION
Challenge your friends or compete worldwide in real-time multiplayer matches and tournaments...

WORLD TOUR – BECOME A GLOBAL POOL LEGEND

EVENTS & MINI-GAMES – ENDLESS FUN & EXCLUSIVE REWARDS
Jump into exciting events and try your luck in daily mini-games like Lucky Drop, Pocket of Prizes, and Roulette! Take on limited-time challenges like the high-stakes Black Widow Event and the epic 9-Ball Challenge for a chance to earn exclusive rewards.

Download now and take your shot at becoming the next 8 Ball Champion!

In this new role-playing game, you are part of a Knighthood, born to fight and conquer. Battle friends and foes in a living fantasy world full of mysterious monsters and mighty enemies as you strive to become the Land’s most feared and famous Knighthood.
The Knighthood, heroes to the people, once defended the world. Now, it is controlled and corrupted by the dark power of Lord Karnon. As a new member of the Knighthood, explore a rich fantasy RPG world, battle epic monsters, fight enemies and corrupted Knights to create your own legend amongst the order of Knighthood.
BRING YOUR INNER KNIGHT TO LIFE
Launch the game, create your knight and join the new action-packed RPG adventure from Midoki and enter an epic fantasy world!
• Follow the legendary Sir Edward Drakeson through your first RPG trials and battle him to prove your worth to the Knighthood.
• Earn your Gauntlet, the powerful relic and symbol of the Knighthood and begin your epic RPG adventure in Astellan, at the edge of a colourful fantasy world.
• Play the game of fame and riches by collecting legendary items to customize and strengthen your Knighthood.
• In this brand new RPG, recruit and upgrade ancient heroes to improve your battle powers.
• Call upon your rage to unleash your Heroes’ unique abilities during a fight.
FIGHT YOUR WAY TO THE TOP AND BECOME A LEGEND
In this new game, level up your knight and battle goblins, beasts and undead creatures as you delve deeper into a world of fantasy and mystery. In this gesture-driven combat game, choose the best RPG tactics to win battles and become a legend.
• Win rare treasure in hunts and quests to improve your gear and up your game.
• Collect ancient heroes to fight by your side and summon their epic abilities in times of need.
• Choose your RPG strategy. Select your weapons and heroes to fit your goals and win the fight!
• Master your RPG combat skills: Create a perfect chain of attacks switching between weapon, gauntlet and hero powers.
• Defeat fellow knights, and become the hero of the PvP arena.
GEAR UP IN STYLE
Your knight, your style! In this new RPG game, create the perfect mix of style and power to stand out from the crowd!
• Fully customise your member of the Knighthood. Show off your epic style to your friends and foes.
• Collect the best gear from hundreds of items and stand tall in the PvP arena and leaderboards.
• Create a look that fits your personality and fight with style.
JOIN THE KNIGHTHOOD
Join a guild: hone your RPG skills by defeating titanic guild bosses with your fellow knights.
• Build your own guild: rally your friends and develop an unstoppable fellowship - a Guild to be the envy of them all.
• Chat with guildmates in real-time to strengthen your bonds and hone your RPG strategy.
• Fight Epic battles. Together you can build a legacy and live up to the glory of the Knighthood.
Knighthood is a free to download and play mobile game and some items can be purchased for real money. If you don’t want to use these features, please disable in-app purchases in your device settings. According to our Terms of Service, Knighthood is allowed for download and play only for persons 16 years or more of age, or with explicit parental consent. You can read more here: https://rpgroleplayinggames.com/ParentsGuide.html
This game includes optional in-game purchases (includes random items).
By accessing or using a RPG RAID ROLEPLAYING GAMES product, you’re agreeing to our Terms of Service https://rpgroleplayinggames.com/TermsOfService.html

bluejetty:00040609:ios.name: IFR Flight Simulator
bluejetty:00040609:ios.summary:
Practice holdings, radial intercepts, and DME arcs on your phone before your next simulator session. Calculate the procedure, fly it with live instruments, and review your track in the debrief.
IFR Flight Simulator combines focused IFR pro
bluejetty:00040609:ios.description:
Practice holdings, radial intercepts, and DME arcs on your phone before your next simulator session. Calculate the procedure, fly it with live instruments, and review your track in the debrief.
IFR Flight Simulator combines focused IFR procedure training with real-time flight simulation, worldwide navigation data, and a choice of glass cockpit or classic gauges.
What you can practice:
• Holding Trainer: Randomized holding situations. Determine the entry, calculate the wind correction angles, then fly the pattern.
• Intercept Trainer: Inbound and outbound radial intercepts as well as QDM/QDR intercepts.
• DME Arc Trainer: Fly DME arcs and calculate the angle of lead to turn onto the inbound course at the right moment.
• Approaches: Set up a final intercept, a position in the pattern (downwind, base, or final), or a full approach at any airport, including ILS.
• IFR mental math: Practice entries, wind correction angles, and lead points until the calculations become automatic.
Worldwide navigation database:
• Navigation data from a recent AIRAC cycle, with worldwide coverage: 13,000+ airports and 10,000+ VORs, NDBs, and other navaids.
• Train with real airports and navaids instead of generic exercise locations.
Real-time flight simulator:
• Modern glass cockpit (PFD and ND) or classic gauges.
• Autopilot with rotary controls for heading, altitude, and speed, or fly manually by tilting your device.
• Fast-forward mode to repeat procedures efficiently.
• Live Map: your position and flight path in real time.
• Live Needle Overlay: watch where the HSI and CDI needles actually point as they move with the aircraft symbol across the map.
• Optimal Holding Entry Path Overlay: compare your flown track with the wind-corrected entry and holding pattern.
• Flight Log with Debrief: every flight is recorded. Replay the track and the needle movement, or resume the flight later.
Built for instrument rating training, proficiency practice, and simulator assessments.
"I am currently training for my Instrument Rating, and my FI recommended this app to me. I didn't think such a high quality, useful training tool was possible as an app. Incredible for VOR bearings, practicing holds and command headings."
App Store review by Sa4mmy
Questions or feedback? Reach us at support@ifrsimulator.com.
Disclaimer:
This application is for training and educational purposes only.
It must not be used for real-world flight planning or in-flight decision-making.
While the developer strives to provide information and calculations that are as accurate and up-to-date as reasonably possible, they may still be incomplete or inaccurate, and other accepted methods exist for deriving procedures and correction angles.
Always verify data against official aeronautical publications and follow the guidance of a certified flight instructor.
The developer accepts no responsibility or liability for any errors, omissions, or outcomes arising from use of this software.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00186414:ios.summary: Musicnotes is your digital sheet music reader, player and music library for practice, performance, and learning. Access and print over 500,000 officially licensed printable sheet music arrangements, scores, and practice materials to play, s
bluejetty:00186414:ios.description:
Musicnotes is your digital sheet music reader, player and music library for practice, performance, and learning. Access and print over 500,000 officially licensed printable sheet music arrangements, scores, and practice materials to play, study, and build your skills wherever you go. Whether you're a student, teacher, hobbyist, or professional musician, Musicnotes provides reliable, interactive annotation tools to support your musical education, rehearsal, and personal growth.
Musicnotes brings sheet music and scores to life with interactive playback, helping you follow the notation as you listen, learn, and practice.
WHY MUSICNOTES?
• Sheet music player and reader for practice, rehearsal, lessons, and performance
• Read, play, organize, annotate, perform, and print from one of the most trusted sheet music apps
• Transpose songs into different keys for vocal training, music theory study, and instrument practice
• Mark up your sheet music with a stylus or finger to improve sight-reading, interpretation, and recall skills
• Organize your sheet music and scores into set lists for lessons, recitals, rehearsals, performances or group practice
• Browse over 500,000 officially licensed printable sheet music arrangements, study scores and practice sheets
• Receive 100 free sheet music titles, blank sheet music and scales, to support your learning and education journey
• Upload and store your personal sheet music PDFs online for easy access
• Easily import your Music notes sheet music pieces into the ForScore Pro app for note management
• Discover popular musicals and artists like Sabrina Carpenter, Taylor Swift, La La Land, Lady Gaga, and Bruno Mars
ACCESS A WORLD OF EDUCATIONAL MUSIC RESOURCES
• Take your digital sheet music library offline—perfect for students, teachers, and performers seeking reliable music reference material
• Scan printed scores and convert them into digital study material
• Explore free and paid music for all skill levels, instruments and voice: piano, guitar, drums, flute, clarinet, trumpet, violin, cello, accordion, percussion, banjo, saxophone, tuba, baritone horn and more
• Learn classical repertoire, lullabies, jazz standards, christmas classics or modern pop
• Perfect for use in private lessons, school programs, and conservatory training
PRACTICE TOOLS FOR MUSIC EDUCATION
• Customize key and tempo for vocal range exercises or skill development
• Use interactive playback with the music note player to improve rhythm, timing, and accuracy
• Loop difficult sections for targeted repetition and muscle memory
• Practice music theory fundamentals with harmony playback and tempo control
• Organize your music note sheets into set lists to prepare for lessons, practice routines, or recitals
ANNOTATE & TEACH MORE EFFECTIVELY
• Highlight, write, and add custom markings to reinforce learning points
• Switch between annotated and clean sheet music scores
• Sync notes across devices with Musicnotes Pro, ideal for teachers & students
THE BEST TOOL FOR TEACHING, LEARNING, AND PERFORMING
• Tap or swipe to turn pages—or use AirTurn & Pageflip for hands-free playing
• Customize paper backgrounds to mirror physical sheet music
• Print purchased scores for classroom or in-person lessons
• Use Musicnotes Pro Credits to redeem arrangements for your music curriculum
• High-resolution PDFs available with Pro membership
Try Musicnotes today and discover why music teachers, students, and performers trust it as the #1 sheet music reader, player, and performance app
Musicnotes Pro is an annual subscription that will charge to your App Store Account & auto-renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your App Store Account will be charged within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Your subscription & auto-renewal can be managed in your Account Settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.musicnotes.com/TermsOfUseApp.html

bluejetty:00014438:ios.name: Mile Logger - Mileage tracker
bluejetty:00014438:ios.description:
MileLogger — Drive. Track. Deduct.
 The only mileage tracker that's 100% free, forever. No subscription. No account. No data sent anywhere. Just open the app and drive.
 Every mile you drive for work is worth $0.725 in tax deductions in 2026 — MileLogger makes sure you never miss one.
 ---
 FREE. FOREVER. NO CATCHES.
 No free tier that locks you out. No trial that expires. No "upgrade to unlock" — every feature is available to every user, always. We believe your mileage data belongs to you, not a subscription service.
 ---
 HOW IT WORKS
 - Drive — MileLogger detects your trip automatically in the background
 - Classify — swipe left for Personal, right for Business (or set Work Hours to auto-classify)
 - Report — view your mileage value by month or year, and export when tax season arrives
 That's it.
 ---
 KEY FEATURES
 Automatic Trip Detection
 Starts and stops recording the moment you drive — no tapping, no forgetting. Runs silently in the background.
 Smart Auto-Classification
 Set your work schedule once. MileLogger automatically marks drives during work hours as Business and drives outside as Personal — hands-free.
 2026 IRS Rate Built In
 Every business mile is calculated at the current IRS standard rate of $0.725/mile. Always up to date.
 Detailed Reports
 Monthly and yearly summaries show your total miles, trip count, and tax deduction value at a glance. Export a full CSV report to share with your accountant in one tap.
 No Account Required
 Open the app and go. No email. No password. No sign-up screen. Nothing.
 Your Data Stays on Your Device
 All trips and settings are stored locally on your iPhone. Nothing is sent to any server. Backup to your personal iCloud — only you can access it.
 Named Locations & Custom Purposes
 Label your home, office, and frequent stops. Tag trips with custom purposes for cleaner records and audit-ready logs.
 Vehicle Management
 Track mileage across multiple vehicles separately.
 ---
 WHO IT'S FOR
 - Freelancers and independent contractors
 - Delivery and rideshare drivers (Uber, Lyft, DoorDash)
 - Real estate agents and sales professionals
 - Small business owners and self-employed professionals
 - Anyone who drives for work and wants the deduction
 ---
 PRIVACY FIRST
 We don't have your data because we never asked for it. No account means no breach. No server means no leak. Your trip history lives on your phone and your iCloud — period.
 ---
 ICLOUD BACKUP
 Back up your entire trip history to iCloud with one tap. Restore it just as easily. Your data follows you when you get a new phone — no account migration, no CSV import, no hassle.
 ---
 Stop paying monthly for something that should be free.
 Download MileLogger and keep every dollar you've earned on the road
Terms of User and Privacy Policy
https://dajax.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00180376:ios.summary: Pass2U Wallet is your ultimate digital card manager! Seamlessly combine store cards, coupons, event tickets, and boarding passes into one app. Fully integrated with Apple Wallet, Pass2U lets you customize pass designs, organize your wallet
bluejetty:00180376:ios.description:
Pass2U Wallet is your ultimate digital card manager! Seamlessly combine store cards, coupons, event tickets, and boarding passes into one app. Fully integrated with Apple Wallet, Pass2U lets you customize pass designs, organize your wallet effortlessly, and skip the lines with ease.
Main Features
All-in-One Digital Wallet: Create, store, and manage membership cards, store cards, event tickets, coupons, reward cards, boarding passes, and more.
Easy Digitization: Instantly scan physical barcodes or import from photos to convert cards into digital passes.
Custom Designs & Templates: Apply hundreds of free pass templates from the Pass Store or design your own with real-time editing previews.
Smart Notifications: Receive automatic updates and timely reminders based on your current location or event dates.
Cloud Backup & Sync: Safely backup and restore your passes via iCloud or Google Drive.
Privacy First: Pass2U does not track, collect, or store your personal information or pass details.
(Note: Some advanced features require Pass2U Pro.)
Supported Barcode Types
Apple Wallet Native Support: QR Code, Aztec, PDF417, and Code 128 (Code 128 is supported on iOS; not supported on Apple Watch). Code 39, EAN-13, Codabar, and I2of5 will be added soon.
Converted Formats (Converted into strip images for compatibility): Code 39, Code 93, Code 39 Mod 43, EAN-8, EAN-13, and UPC-A.
Frequent Questions
How can I backup all of my passes?
You can go to the setting of iPhone > Apple ID > iCloud > turn on Wallet. Once you would like to use another iPhone, you can log in with the same Apple ID and turn on Wallet for iCloud. Then you will see the passes issued by Pass2U on Pass2U Wallet.
Issuing Passes in Bulk? 
Visit https://www.pass2u.net/ to design, issue, and distribute digital passes directly to your customers.
Support & Feedback
We’d love to hear from you! If you have any comments, questions, or feedback, please reach out to us at [contact@micromacro.com.tw].

bluejetty:00096507:ios.description:
FREE TO TRY - NO ADS 
Waltz of the Wizard is a first-person magic simulator inspired by the wonders of classical fantasy. Your journey begins in a handcrafted magical tower, where you’ll mix arcane ingredients into a bubbling cauldron with the help of your cynical assistant, Skully, fully voiced with thousands of unique reactions. Skully is a companion you can talk to, poke, tickle, dunk, and even—once his sarcasm wears thin—toss right out the window.
ONE-TIME IN-APP-PURCHASE FULL GAME UNLOCK
The full game unlocks the path outside the tower where a huge magical world of chaotic magic, huge areas to explore and even more strange secrets!
COURTYARD
* Explore a vast courtyard outside your tower
* Uncover Skully’s mysterious, fragmented past
* Navigate the humming portal circle
* Find secrets in the desolate old trainstop
* Master new reality-bending magic abilities
NATURAL MAGIC POWERS
* Master seven unique destructive spells
* Hurl objects with chaotic tornado fury
* Strike foes with thunderous lightning
* Bounce targets using erratic spectral orbs
* Shatter reality using the sonic scream
ROCKETS
* Experiment with bizarre rocket engineering
* Blast Skully into the furthest cosmos
* Uncover Igor’s eccentric launch combinations
* Cause some spectacular launch failures
* Hear some bizarre space tales from Skully
FORTRESS DUNGEON
* Conquer a huge 40 level story campaign
* Defeat diverse, unique and strange enemies
* Master magic against massive stone behemoths
* Collect pieces to complete the observers’ mural
* Quickly jump to a randomly generated level
VOICE MAGIC POWERS
* Modify anything using voice or type to talk
* Destroy anything you want, when you want
* Summon objects, weapons and creatures 
* Type commands if you don’t want to speak
* Change physical abilities of any object
And much more awaits in the full version of Waltz of the Wizard.

bluejetty:00065773:ios.description:
Ever dreamed of bidding on priceless art at the world’s most prestigious auctions? Maintaining and curating your own museum and picking out which artifacts to show off to the public? Achieving fame and fortune, making billions with bids and becoming a mega-rich billionaire art tycoon?
You can do exactly that (and more!) with Art Inc - let your wildest art museum dreams come true! Climb the ranks to bid at pricier auctions and outbid the richest of the rich! Go for gold, bathe in cash, start bid wars and compete against others to collect famous art around the world!
Start as a no-name art gallery and level it up so it becomes the trendiest place to be. Place bids at celebrated auctions to buy famous artifacts only billionaires can afford: the Mona Lisa, Starry Night, Son of Man, Creation of Adam and more!
-----
ART INC: MUSEUM SIMULATOR - FEATURES
-----
- Easy, Fun, Idle Gameplay: Bid for artwork, sculptures, scrolls, fossils, rare books and more at exclusive auctions!
- Your Favorite Art: Compete to collect famous artwork, celebrated sculptures and classical statues by Van Gogh, Picasso, Da Vinci and other artists around the world!
- Collect Them All: Make billions and hire high profile and unique characters to keep your museum safe! From celebrities and fictional characters to famous artists! (And make them do your bidding!)
- Compete in Bid Wars: Compete in the arena of art auctions and expand your collection! Climb over others’ bids and outbid them with cash!
- Collect Even More: There are now OVER 200 unique pieces of art available for bidding at bid wars!
- Get Rich: Collect donations of appreciation (like cash, diamonds, gold - and let’s not forget, MONEY) from visitors to your museum!
- Explore the World: Search for gold and riches in expeditions around the world - for there’s fame and fortune galore waiting just for you at the end of your adventure!
- Achieve Capitalist Fame: Become the epitome of the Capitalist Dream! Achieve fame and fortune by placing your museum at the top of the bid wars! Outbid and beat everyone in your way!
- Hours and Hours of Content: You’ll always find something to do, whether it’s decorating, managing or bidding!
- Exciting and Casual - From stress-free idle adventure gameplay to high-octane bid wars, there’s something for everyone!
- Completely Free: Free to play… For LIFE!
BID ON THE BEST ART AT EXCLUSIVE AUCTIONS
Compete with other bougie billionaire auction-goers to buy the art that you want for your gallery! Make bids and flaunt your billions, your cash and riches! Outbid others by placing bids for great artifacts and use fancy skills to beat others back! Find out what kind of artwork is trending and display them to gain massive rewards! Go on adventures and quests around the world to find treasures in a board game style minigame!
BRING BACK THE MONA LISA
What happened to the REAL Mona Lisa? Track down what the elusive Silver Fox stole from you and teach him a lesson! Follow the exciting storyline by completing quests and collecting recruits. Collect back your riches and fortune to become an even better museum tycoon!
RECRUIT THE BEST HEROES, VILLAINS AND EXPLORERS!
With help from your trusty butler-caretaker Wilfred, add famous characters to your arsenal and hire them to help you out at the museum! Recruit guards, explorers and buyers from the Renaissance to the Age of Pirates! Adventure around the world in search for priceless artifacts worth billions of dollars!
WANT TO BUILD YOUR OWN WORLD-CLASS MUSEUM? BECOME A BIDDING ART AUCTION TYCOON AND DOWNLOAD ART INC: MUSEUM SIMULATOR TODAY!
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ArtIncSimulator/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/art.inc.official/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/ArtIncGame
SUPPORT
Are you having problems? Email us at support@pixio.co or contact us in-game by going to Settings > Help and Support.
PRIVACY POLICY
http://www.pixio.co/file/PixioPrivacyPolicy.pdf

This change does NOT affect any other type of audio content that Amazing Slow Downer can play back.

bluejetty:00017521:ios.description:
Make easy payments and transfers without any queue.
— Free download and quick registration.
— Quick payment. Save time and pay for mobile services, electricity, Internet, water, and other services without commission in a few clicks.
— Easy top-up. Top up the app balance with bank cards, terminals or at Alif's cash desks. 
— Home for all cards. Link your Korti milli, Visa, MasterCard, UzCard and Humo cards and use them online.
— Bonuses and cashback. Pay fast via QR code and get up to 50% cashback.
— Simple withdrawal. Withdraw your money easily at Alif's ATMs, terminals and cash desks.
— Online-identification. Pass identification online to increase the app usage limit.
— Installments. After automatically linking your Salom card, buy goods in installments without waiting for an SMS code.
— Security comes first. We use end-to-end encryption to protect your data exchange.
— Convenient money transfers. Transfer money to wallets within the country. And also available transfers abroad to CIS, Europe, the Middle East and Asia from the wallet account and cards.
— Multilingual. Use the application in 4 languages: Tajik, Russian, English and Uzbek. 
Bonus features:
— Visa card order. Leave an application for plastic and digital Visa cards in the All cards section. 
— Visa card management. Auto-link Visa Alif cards, change accounts, download details, view history and assign a PIN code in the app.
— Favorite services. To avoid entering the same data each time, add the number or account of frequent payments at the Favorites section.
— Online support. Contact us with any questions by phone, mail and social media: Facebook, Instagram and Telegram. We'll answer in the shortest time possible.
— Useful and interesting stories. Stay up-to-date with news, products and vacancies.
For users in Uzbekistan:
— Cashback for payment. Earn up to 1% cashback when you pay for mobile service, internet, utilities and 1000+ services.
— Transfers from card to card. Transfer without commissions, paying for services.
— Repayment of Nasiya installments. Keep track of installments within the application. Repay them in a few clicks and get 1% cashback.
— Always near. If you have any questions, write in the app chat or in Telegram bot @alifmobiuzbot. We will answer at any time.
More than 1 million users trust alif mobi.

bluejetty:00140868:ios.description:
AI Chat Girlfriend is the virtual girlfriend app where your AI girlfriend texts you first, flirts with you, sends voice notes and photos, and remembers everything you tell her. Swipe, match and start dating your dream AI girl tonight.
Looking for a girlfriend to talk to, a romantic AI companion or a flirty dating sim that feels real? Every AI girl has her own look, voice, personality and story, and your relationship grows with every message you send.
SWIPE, MATCH & DATE
• Swipe through AI girls on Discover and match with your type
• Browse blonde, brunette, shy or outgoing girls, with new faces every week
• Start a virtual date and chat with her right away
AN AI GIRLFRIEND WHO FEELS REAL
• Natural texting that sounds like a real girlfriend, not a chatbot
• AI voice notes and voice calls in her own voice
• Photos and selfies she sends in chat
• Memory: she remembers your conversations, your day and your inside jokes
FROM STRANGER TO SOULMATE
Build a relationship with your virtual girlfriend step by step: Stranger, Acquaintance, Friend, Close Friend, Romantic and Soulmate. The closer you get, the more she opens up to you.
CREATE YOUR OWN AI GIRLFRIEND
Design your dream girl: face, hair, eyes, style, voice and personality. Your custom AI girlfriend is ready in minutes, and she is only yours.
PLAY TOGETHER
Play Truth or Dare, Would You Rather, Never Have I Ever, 20 Questions, Two Truths One Lie and Build a Story with your AI partner, or start a romantic roleplay scene where she never breaks character.
GIFTS & LOVE
Send your girlfriend gifts, grow closer and watch her open up to you.
Whether you want a flirty chat partner, a sweet AI companion to talk to every night or a fun dating simulator, AI Chat Girlfriend is romance in your pocket, 24/7.
All characters are fictional and powered by AI. Conversations are for entertainment only.
AI GIRLFRIEND PRO
Pro unlocks unlimited chats, photos and voice calls. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Prices are shown in the app before you buy.

bluejetty:00167593:ios.summary:

Plan, ride and track great rides
Beautifully simple navigation for cyclists and motorcyclists, built
bluejetty:00167593:ios.description:
The companion app for Beeline Velo 2 and Moto II, Velo Original and Moto Original devices. Also available for standalone (app-only) use. 
Plan, ride and track great rides
Beautifully simple navigation for cyclists and motorcyclists, built on feedback from thousands of fellow riders. Plan a route you'll love, follow clear turn-by-turn directions with spoken audio guidance, and save every ride to your personal riding history.
Plan your perfect route
Pick the ride you're in the mood for - quiet, fun or fast - all shaped by real recommendations from riders around you. Then make it yours: add stops and tailor the route to suit the bike you're on and the time you've got. Feedback on the roads you know to make routing better for everyone.
Navigate with confidence
Follow easy turn-by-turn directions on your Beeline device or phone, with spoken audio in a growing list of languages. Changed your mind out on the road? Edit your route mid-ride and carry on.
Import and share
Import GPX files or open your komoot and Strava routes straight in the app. Share routes with friends and ride together.
Track every ride
Every ride is automatically saved to your personal heatmap and ride history, with distance, time and elevation all in one place. Sync with Strava and Apple Health to stay on top of your stats, and share your best days out with friends.
Made for your Beeline device
Works seamlessly with Beeline Velo 2 and Moto II. Start and control rides from your device, know exactly where you are on every climb with Velo 2, and enjoy beautifully simple navigation on Moto II.
Go further with Beeline Plus
Unlock even more with Beeline Plus. Avoid traffic with live routing, generate loop rides from your chosen distance, discover fresh routes with Route Shuffle, explore in 3D, and get speed camera alerts. Every new rider gets a free month to try it.
Community at the core
Every route is better for the riders who come after you. Rate the roads you ride to help the next person find the good stuff.
Good to know
Beeline uses GPS for directions, so keep an eye on your battery on longer rides. We only ever use your data to give you a better ride.
Terms: https://beeline.co/pages/app-terms-conditions
Privacy: http://beeline.co/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00038723:ios.description:
POPGuide is an interactive destination, mapping and audio app that allows self-guided sightseeing experiences in over 150 cities worldwide. You can enjoy hundreds of points of interest and an array of fascinating itineraries in each city, all in offline mode.
· Geolocalization and navigation offline along the best walking, bus, tram and river routes.
· Distance and estimated travel time available, by foot or by car.
· Point of Interest audio commentary given by native actors portraying famous local historical figures.
· The audio commentary is a mix of fascinating storytelling, nit-bits of trivia you're unlikely to find anywhere else and historical information, and each piece lasts a maximum of 3 minutes.
· POPGuide is available in 6 languages (English, French, Spanish, German, Portuguese, Chinese)
Battery Usage Disclaimer:
 The continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
 While enjoying POPGuide outdoors, it will first track your current location then navigate you to the POIs of your choice. To avoid unnecessary GPS tracking draining your battery, make sure that you disable the location function of your device whenever appropriate.

bluejetty:00045075:ios.description:
If you’re ever forced to defend yourself, have you considered how the aftermath could affect you—legally, financially? Even if you’ve acted responsibly, you could be arrested and later face a trial.
But if you have insurance for concealed carry from U.S. LawShield®, you can feel assured knowing that you’ll have an experienced self-defense lawyer to guide you through everything that comes next.
Being a U.S. LawShield member means you have an attorney on the phone before the police arrive. 
With Legal Defense for Self Defense® coverage from U.S. LawShield, all you have to do is call our emergency hotline regardless of the day or hour. During your greatest time of need, you’ll immediately be speaking with an attorney, who’s ready to help you—whether that’s advising you what to do next, speaking to law enforcement on your behalf, representing you in court or all of the above. 
Your U.S. LawShield membership includes:
24/7/365 emergency access to an attorney experienced in self-defense
Coverage of all attorneys’ fees—no limits, no caps 
Legal representation for both criminal and civil cases
And much more
U.S. LawShield is great for legal gun owners, CCW permit holders, hunters or anyone else who wants the peace of mind that comes from knowing they’ll be protected if they’re forced to defend themselves.
What’s in a U.S. LawShield membership?
24/7/365 emergency access to an attorney
With AttorneyResponse 365® you can ALWAYS speak to an attorney who’s ready to give you professional legal advice in your greatest time of need. That’s ANY time you have an emergency, even if it’s 3 a.m. on a holiday morning.
Coverage for all legal weapons
Your membership protects you regardless of which weapon you may use to lawfully defend yourself.
State-specific legal updates
We keep you current on all gun and self-defense laws for your home state and those you may travel to.
Education & events
From our Armed & Educated™ book series to events featuring experienced attorneys, firearms instructors and self-defense experts, we strive to keep our members empowered and responsible through knowledge. 
Custom household membership
Craft the best membership for your family: Add a household member and save when both of you purchase an annual plan.2 You can also add coverage for your children under age 17.
Coverage in every state
Extend the power of your membership—from your home state to the entire country—with our Multi-State Protection add-on (includes Washington, D.C. and Puerto Rico).
Bail Bond & Expert Witness3
Receive bond fee protection for bail up to $50,000 and an expert witness at trial, if necessary, with this add-on.
Protection in the woods and on the water3
Get additional coverage with HunterShield®, created specifically for hunters and anglers and the issues they may face. 
Gunowner Identity Theft Coverage3
If one of your firearms goes missing, would you know what to do? Protect your right to carry and your good name with this powerful add-on. 
Member-only benefits
Discounts, special events, exclusive content and more.
Not a member yet? Download the app to join our community of 700,000+ responsible self-defenders! Or visit uslawshield.com to register for one of our educational events.
Members: Get the app to access key account information, exclusive benefits and more!
Legal disclaimers
1. Not available in all states. U.S. LawShield and its affiliates offer prepaid legal service products. In some states, these products are offered by prepaid legal companies regulated under state law. In others, the applicable entity offers an insurance product. For details on the products offered in your state visit https://www.uslawshield.com/terms-and-conditions/ .
2. Discount not available in CA and MS.
3. Only available in certain states.

bluejetty:00116566:ios.description:
■ Deckbuilding Roguelike
In this dungeon-exploration game, players use a variety of cards with different abilities to battle enemies and make their way forward. Each run is unique—the types of cards you acquire and the structure of the dungeon change every time you play.
Lose a battle, and everything you’ve gained during that run will be lost.
■ Battle System
Combat unfolds as a turn-based card battle. Players draw cards at random from their deck and must adapt their strategy to the current situation. Each turn, you can take a single action: attack or defend using a card from your hand.
■ Dungeon Exploration
While exploring, you’ll encounter branching paths and various events that require you to make key decisions.
Each choice you make may significantly affect the outcome of your journey...
■ Story
In Tokyo’s bayside area stands “THE HASHIRA,” a state-of-the-art, ultra-high-rise complex. The tower has become a sealed-off space crawling with monstrous beings.
To eliminate the target lurking at the very top, Tsukuyomi, an elite organization sworn to protect the nation, begins its mission—

※ Supported languages: Japanese, English, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese (planned).

bluejetty:00131827:ios.name: Pi-hole Remote
bluejetty:00131827:ios.summary:
Take full control of your Pi-hole from your iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Apple TV. Monitor your network, inspect DNS queries, manage blocking and lists, and control multiple Pi-hole instances from anywhere in the Apple ecosystem.
*D
bluejetty:00131827:ios.description:
Take full control of your Pi-hole from your iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Apple TV. Monitor your network, inspect DNS queries, manage blocking and lists, and control multiple Pi-hole instances from anywhere in the Apple ecosystem.
*Disable Blocking*
Quickly disable blocking from the app, interactive Home Screen widgets, your Apple Watch, or Siri. You'll see a Live Activity for the duration to remind you blocking is disabled!
*Statistics & Queries*
Look up what domains are queried most on your network, as well as clients that send out the most requests. View your Query Log as well as a 'Live Log' which shows queries on your network in real time.
*Blocked Services*
Want to quickly restrict access to Facebook, TikTok, Snapchat, Roblox, and more? Block all kinds of services effortlessly with just one tap.
*Manage Your Pi-hole*
Manage Clients & Groups, Domains & Adlists, and change all kinds of Pi-hole settings such as DNS/DHCP settings.
*Interactive Widgets & Live Activity*
Choose from a wide range of Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets that show your Pi-hole status or statistics. There are also interactive widgets to disable blocking without opening the app! When you disable blocking, you will even see a Live Activity on your Lock Screen, Dynamic Island, and Smart Stack.
*Controls*
Quickly toggle blocking right from your Lock Screen, Control Center, or Action Button.
*Made for the Apple Ecosystem*
Use Pi-hole Remote across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Apple TV. Your instances and preferences stay available across your devices through iCloud. Purchase Pi-hole Remote+ once and unlock it on every supported platform.
==
iPhone, iPad, and Mac features:
- Enable or temporarily disable Pi-hole blocking
- View detailed statistics and combined data from multiple instances
- Search and filter your Query Log or watch queries appear in real time
- Add domains to your allowlist or denylist, individually or in bulk
- Block entire services such as social networks, streaming platforms, and games
- Manage clients, groups, domains, adlists, DNS, and DHCP settings
- Update Gravity and manage your Pi-hole configuration
- Add and control an unlimited number of Pi-hole instances
- Choose where each instance appears based on your Wi-Fi network
- Connect securely using HTTPS, reverse proxies, custom paths, and custom headers
- Use interactive widgets, Live Activities, and Lock Screen or Control Center controls
- Control Pi-hole with Siri, App Shortcuts, Spotlight, and the Action Button
- Sync settings and selected Pi-hole data between instances
- Personalize the app with custom colors and alternative icons
- Enjoy dedicated layouts for iPhone, iPad, and Mac
- Full VoiceOver and Dark Mode support
Apple Watch features:
- View status and statistics, control one or all instances, access Blocked Services, and use complications and Live Activities
Apple TV features:
- View statistics and queries, control blocking and services, and switch between or combine instances on the big screen
==
Note:
You need at least one working Pi-hole instance running on another device for this app to function and you must use Pi-hole Version 6.0 or up. Pi-hole Remote is a third-party app which uses the Pi-hole API and is in no way affiliated with Pi-hole. Find out more about Pi-hole at https://pi-hole.net/.
This app offers a "Pi-hole Remote+" version with additional features, in the form of a lifetime purchase, a monthly subscription, or a yearly subscription. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period and will be charged to your App Store account. You can turn off auto-renew or manage subscriptions in your App Store account settings after purchase. Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00043917:ios.description:
Changing habits on your own is hard. 
We all know what we should do: sleep better, manage anxiety, eat with more balance, spend with more awareness. The hard part isn't knowing, it's keeping it up: and we help you turn intention into action.
That's what we're here for: to walk with you quickly every day using behavioral science, until the habit sticks. It's usually fast, and it works.
We've already reached more than 500,000 people like you.
Why is Vigilantes different?
Grounded in science, in methods from Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, an approach with wide scientific evidence for real behavior change through habits.
Easy to follow: just a few minutes a day with Sônia, your health assistant. She walks with you every day in plain language, in sessions that fit your routine, with questionnaires and journals to track your progress.
Complete care in one app, one place to change everything you need to change. 
Sleep better Address the cause of insomnia, not just the symptoms. 2 out of 3 users report a significant improvement in sleep, and 1 out of 3 reach full remission, according to Sleep Science. You also get photo based sleep apnea screening, with high accuracy, and a sleep and snoring monitor using just your phone.
Improve anxiety and mood Practical breathing techniques, mindfulness, and a guided journal to reduce symptoms day to day. An average 60% reduction in the symptoms assessed, in just a few minutes a day. 
Sustainable weight loss Lose weight without extreme diets. Engaged users lose, on average, 11 lbs (6% of body weight), through changes you can actually keep up. 
Gambling control Take back control of your time and your money. Users report more than an 80% reduction in impulsive spending and betting. Privacy first 
Protected data, encrypted in transit. Compliant with LGPD and aligned with ISO 27001.
This app does not replace the diagnosis, care, or supervision of doctors and psychologists.
If you're going through a moment of psychological distress, seek help.

bluejetty:00062135:ios.description:
The only Dictionary and Thesaurus with every word you search for. Plus Word of the Day, free offline dictionary access, and millions of definitions and synonyms from top sources, including: 
Webster's Dictionary 
Roget's Thesaurus
The American Heritage Dictionary
Plus FREE access to: 
English Offline Dictionary 
English Offline Thesaurus with synonyms and more
Medical Dictionary
English Idioms and Slang Dictionary
Translations of English into 40+ languages
Dozens of other translation options 
+ Much more! The Free Dictionary is like getting 100+ apps in one easy-to-use interface. 
Rated #1 app in the App Store in the free reference category in 114 countries 2011–2019. (Source: https://www.appannie.com/apps/ios/app/379450383/app-ranking/#device=ipad&type=best-ranks) 
Here's what you can do with The Free Dictionary app: 
* Find every word you search for. 
Clear, accurate definitions from top dictionaries—online and offline.
* Find synonyms fast.
Free Thesaurus with simple interface makes it easy to find the perfect word. Browse synonyms, antonyms, and related words.
* Learn something new every day. 
Word of the Day
Idiom of the Day
+ Other daily content
* Build your vocabulary. 
Don't just look up words—learn how to use them! 
Featuring:
Audio pronunciations
Example sentences
Etymologies
+ More!
The perfect dictionary app for word lovers and learners of all levels.
* Explore topics in-depth. 
Multiple specialty dictionaries and encyclopedias: 
Medical dictionary
Legal dictionary
Science dictionary
Financial dictionary
Idioms and Slang dictionary
Acronyms and Abbreviations 
+ More!
* Play word games. 
Spelling Bee, Hangman, and more.
* See idioms in action. 
Watch idioms videos inside the app! Featuring animations of words and phrases from the idioms and slang dictionary. 
* Access dictionaries in 13 other languages.
Spanish dictionary and thesaurus
French dictionary and thesaurus
German dictionary and thesaurus
+ Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese, and more!
* Translate English into Spanish, French, and 40+ languages.
Or translate other languages into English. Access dozens of other translation options.
* Access dictionaries and encyclopedias from these top publishers with just one search:
McGraw-Hill
Houghton Mifflin
HarperCollins
Random House
Cambridge University Press 
+ More!
Here's why The Free Dictionary is the most user-friendly dictionary app: 
* Instantly look up words in apps or webpages! Just highlight the word you want to look up, tap "Share," then tap "More" in the bottom menu and turn on the "Define" option. You will then see a "Define" icon in the menu. Tap it to see the definition of the highlighted word!
* Voice search. Look up a word just by saying it. 
* Advanced Search options. 
* Look up the definition of any word on the page. Just highlight and tap "Definition."
* Save bookmarks with one tap and sync them to all your devices.
* Customize your homepage: Move, add, or remove articles, games, even local weather. 
* Jump to Definition, Thesaurus, or Translations with one button. 
* Navigate the app in more than a dozen languages with the multilingual interface.
* Adjust font size. 
* Share your favorite words via social networks, email, or text. 
EXCLUSIVE
* Earn meals for hungry children through The Free Dictionary's partnership with the World Food Program—just by using the app! 
This is not a trial version—you get everything free and forever. Additional offline dictionaries in other languages are available in the Pro version.
Seem too good to be true? 
The Free Dictionary app has been downloaded tens of millions times across multiple platforms, with top ratings after hundreds of thousands of reviews. 
Read reviews from real users to see why they say The Free Dictionary is the best dictionary app they've ever used.
* For app developers: The Free Dictionary app can be accessed by other apps with API calls (Contact Farlex for instructions).

bluejetty:00156766:ios.description:
Welcome to Eat All: Hole Game - a fun and relaxing all in hole game!
Here, you'll control a powerful black hole and travel through colorful worlds, eat the world by swallowing fruits, drinks, vegetables, coffee, and more, experiencing the magical gameplay that combines eating games and growth.
How to play:
The main gameplay is hole and fill. You need to use the physical principles of black hole and swallow various items and enter new levels.
As the eating games progress, the difficulty of the levels will increase, and the variety and number of items will also increase. Upgrade your attack hole to make it bigger, faster, and stronger to face more challenges.
Main features:
- Eat The World: All in one! Use one finger to move your black hole and feel the joy of eating everything!
- Black Hole Evolution: This all in one adventure lets you upgrade the abilities of the attack hole to make it more powerful, bigger, and faster.
- Endless Levels: Explore different themed environments, from small vegetable gardens to tropical orchards.
- Immersive Feeling: Every item looks real, and the sound effects during swallowing will make you more immersed.
Are you ready to start your attack hole swallowing journey? Whether you want to relax or challenge yourself, black hole game can provide an all in one satisfaction.
Download the game now and start your adventure! Become a hole in one master and enjoy the fun of hole and fill in this eating games.

bluejetty:00100802:ios.summary: Get your dramatized KJV audio Bible or offline Bible Dramatized and enjoy the fullness of the Holy Bible. This Bible is in the dramatized form with background music which helps a lot of Christians to enjoy the different sections of the Bibl
bluejetty:00100802:ios.description:
Get your dramatized KJV audio Bible or offline Bible Dramatized and enjoy the fullness of the Holy Bible. This Bible is in the dramatized form with background music which helps a lot of Christians to enjoy the different sections of the Bible.
This KJV Dramatized Bible can be used offline. This means that when you have internet data and you prefer to download the dramatized audio Bible so you can play when there is no connectivity, this is possible.
Audio Bible Dramatized - KJV with motivational daily verses that will take you to the next level in your life. There are several audio Bible versions available but the dramatized version is one of the most liked KJV Bible versions available today. With this free KJV Dramatized Audio Version, you can enjoy the whole Bible with some soothing music at the background. 
This dramatised KJV offline or King James Bible offline has daily devotion and Bible dictionaries that you can use when you don't understand a word in the Bible.
Dramatized Bible KJV comes with powerful background sounds and the voices are very clear and very profound. It makes your listening experience great. For those who don’t have constant internet, we are sorry to say you will only the robotic voice but connect to Internet for the best dramatized audio kjv experience.
Other features of this app are the ability to track your progress after you have read several Bible verses. Feeding on God's word is so amazing. You will know what you have read in the offline Bible and what you have not. Be blessed as you read it daily
Profound search feature of this Bible app. If you are looking for a section word in the Bible, use the search feature on the main screen. The search result will you help you get through it at a faster pace.
Daily Bible verses- Every morning at 7 am you will get a motivational Bible verse to start your day with the Lord. As a Christian, it is good if we meditate on God's word every morning.
Daily Devotion - Do you love to have some description for verse in the Bible? With the daily devotion that you will get every morning, you can have a commentary on a verse which can be very helpful to you.
Topical Bible verses- There is a list of topical Bible verses that you can quickly check and get to know where you can find certain Bible verses. Some of the topics are on love, hope, peace and joy. These are all promises of God to us.
History - Never get lost in the Bible after reading a certain chapter. This app keeps the history of every Bible chapter you have read and it makes it easy for you to revisit it. 
Bookmark- Catch up where you left off with a simple bookmark. It is like a favorite feature where all your bookmarked verses can be accessed on one screen only.
Notes- As we read the Bible, Holy Spirit, The Spirit of Truth always speaks to our spirit. It is good to take notes when He speaks to you because that is a revelation that will help you in the long run.
Highlight- Mark favorite verses with all sorts of colors that gives it more meaning. Choose any color from the color picker and make the Bible great.
Let this dramatized offline Bible help you improve your Christian work with our Father in Heaven
"Jesus said, He is the way, truth and life and no one comes to the Father except through Him. The only way to know more about God is through His word and through relationship with the Holy Spirit. The Bible should not be used without the Holy Spirit and Vise verse. You need the word and you need to hear His voice."
This Dramatized audio Bible KJV or King James Dramatized Bible will be a blessing to you.

bluejetty:00065140:ios.description:
Mobile Banking for customers who hold NatWest International bank accounts in the Channel Islands, Isle of Man or Gibraltar.
Download our NatWest International mobile banking app today to make your day-to-day banking easy, quick and secure.
Why the NatWest International app? 
Manage your money easily and securely:
• Apply for current and savings accounts quickly. Eligibility criteria apply.
• See all your bank accounts straight from your home screen.
• Freeze and unfreeze your debit card at any time.
• Register for face or voice biometrics for better security and send higher value payments in-app, amend payment limits and more. 
Send, receive and access money quickly:
• Send money faster with a personalised list of favourite payees.
• Pay your contacts using their mobile number if they have a NatWest Group app 
• iPhone only: Get Cash in emergencies with a unique code without using your card. You can withdraw up to £130 every 24 hours at our branded ATMs. You must have a least £10 available in your account and an active debit card (locked or unlocked).
• Deposit cheques into your account.
Stay on top of your spending and saving:
• Keep track of payments all in one place.
• Save your spare change with Round Ups if you have an eligible current account and instant access savings account. Round Ups can only be made on debit card and contactless payments in Sterling.
• Turn on push notifications to get alerted when money reaches or leaves your account.
Get support for life events:
• Discover our additional products and services, including mortgages, overdrafts and loans in one place. 
Important info
Our app is available to customers aged 11+ with a Channel Islands, Isle of Man, UK or international mobile number in specific countries. Be aware some features and products have age restrictions and are only available if you’re over 16 or 18.
By downloading this app, you’re accepting our Terms and Conditions, which can be viewed at natwestinternational.com/mobileterms. 
Please save or print a copy along with the Privacy Policy for your records.

bluejetty:00030356:ios.name: Maritime Academy: ICS Flags
bluejetty:00030356:ios.summary:
Features:
- designed for mariners, travellers, yachtsmen, pleasure cruisers and anyone who enjoys spending time around the waterfront.
- 104 levels and 35 challenges teaching and training maritime flag signalling and the International Code
bluejetty:00030356:ios.description:
Features:
- designed for mariners, travellers, yachtsmen, pleasure cruisers and anyone who enjoys spending time around the waterfront.
- 104 levels and 35 challenges teaching and training maritime flag signalling and the International Code of Signals (ICS).
- 6 chapters including Letters, Numbers, Words, Substitutes, Single Flag Meanings and Abbreviations.
- effective and fun teaching and training strategy: learn and train first with ease and then challenge yourself with pressure.
- calculated amount of repetition for smooth and efficient memorization and progress.
- explore all the letters, numbers, substitutes and abbreviations at your own pace on the Explore screen.
- info screen offering detailed explanation of how to make the most of the app.
- absolutely no ads.
- works completely offline.
--------
About Maritime Academy
The app teaches maritime flag signalling (generally flaghoist signalling), which is the principal means other than radio by which ships communicate to each other or to shore.
Virtually all signalling by non-naval vessels is now organized under the International Code of Signals (whether by flaghoist, semaphore, signal lamp, or other means), which specifies a standard set of flags and codes and is the most recent evolution of a wide variety of maritime flag signalling systems. Naval vessels generally use an extended set of flags and their own codes.
--------
Teaching method
The two key teaching and training concepts are progressive introduction and focused repetition. The learning material is categorized into chapters and then broken down into manageable units (levels) to ensure efficient learning and training.
--------
Learning material
In general, the learning progresses from single-flag content to multi-flag content. That is to say, from letters & numbers to words & substitutes, and then to single flag meanings & abbreviations. The content is arranged for optimal efficiency and we strongly recommend you to go through the levels in this order.
- Letters (8 levels + 4 challenges)
- Numbers (3 levels + 1 challenge)
- Words (30 levels)
- Substitutes (1 level)
- Single Flag Meanings (8 levels + 4 challenges)
- Abbreviations (54 levels + 26 challenges)
--------
Levels and challenges
In short, a level focuses on introducing and training new letters/numbers/abbreviations, while a challenge tests what you’ve learnt. In the learning screen, the knowledge you should focus on is highlighted and in the training screen, you will practice by answering a few questions (like a quiz game). In a challenge, you must make less than 3 mistakes to pass it.
--------
Training types
There are three training types, that is to say, key, typing and button.
- In Letters & Numbers levels, you need to press the keys of the keyboard on the screen to answer the questions.
- In Words & Substitutes levels, you need to type whole words to answer the questions.
- In Single Flag Meanings & Abbreviations levels, you need to choose the correct meaning by clicking on a button.
--------
The Explore screen
The Explore screen allows users to check out the International Flags and Pennants of the 26 letters of the English Alphabet, numbers (0-9), substitutes (3), as well as the International Code of Signals including 25 single flag meanings and 201 most frequently used abbreviations. Simply click on the blocks to start exploring.
--------
Download Maritime Academy now and start learning the signal flags!

bluejetty:00119183:ios.description:
Take back control of your personal data with the protection of Guardian Firewall and VPN.
We believe people should be able to use apps on their digital devices without their data being sold to unknown third parties. Data that you’re not always aware that you’re sharing, such as confidential information, travel patterns, and lifestyle.
Guardian Firewall blocks unauthorized third parties from secretly collecting your personal information while adding an extra layer of security from hackers and insecure websites with our powerful VPN, protecting passwords, search history, and other sensitive data.
Our Guardian Pro subscription service is the protection of Guardian with the following additional features:
• Customized Blocklists: Add individual hosts or IP addresses to be effectively blocked, as well as try our experimental Guardian-curated firewall rules, for a privacy experience tuned to your needs
• Push Notifications: Instant notifications when your device attempts to connect to an unwanted connection to further assist in identifying a culprit app or website. Easily filter notifications by type of Alert
• Generate & Export Credentials: Create additional sets of VPN credentials to secure your other devices capable of establishing IKEv2 or WireGuard connections (includes ability to export preset .mobileconfig or .conf files for IKEv2 or WireGuard respectively)
• Family Sharing of subscriptions is now available to Pro users. Share your subscription to 5 additional family members (5 different Apple IDs) with no additional cost. 
Guardian Day Passes are available for $0.99 each in 24 hour increments. Purchase as many Day Passes as you’d like, choose to activate some right away, or share a few with friends and family.
Guardian subscription service is available for $9.99 per month, or $99.99 per year
Guardian Pro subscription service is available for $149.99 per year.
Highlights:
• Firewall: Block unwanted connections to location trackers, mail trackers, generic data trackers, and other online nuisances.
• VPN: All internet activity is sent through a persistent, fast, and secure, IKEv2 or WireGuard based tunnel, keeping internet service providers, hackers, and other unwanted entities from accessing your personal data.
• Privacy: Your VPN connection is authenticated with an automatically generated random identity, enabling access only by using the digital In-App Purchase receipt stored on your mobile device after purchase. (No personal information needed)
• Best In-Class IKEv2 Encryption: Data sent through the VPN tunnel using IKEv2/IPsec is encrypted using AES-256 to protect against interception by unauthorized parties.
• Support For Modern Standards: WireGuard connections are available on every server allowing you to freely choose which transport protocol to use without any compromises.
• Mask your IP: Your IP address and other device identifiers will be masked from third-parties in order to help protect your identity.
• Region Selection: Control your connection by selecting regions such as the United States, England, the Netherlands, Germany, Japan, Switzerland, Singapore and many more, that cover our global network of servers.
• Safe Browsing: Aggressive ads and web page hijackers are blocked by the Firewall, giving you an uninterrupted web browsing experience in any browser, without the need for browser extensions with direct access to your web browser.
• Alerts and Alert Filtering: Swipe up on the Alert menu to view all blocked, unwanted connections. Easily filter by type, or tap an Alert for more detailed information.
• Fast Connection: No impact on speed or performance.
• Support up to five iOS devices using the same AppleID
• Contact Technical Support available in-app for any questions or issues
Privacy Policy & Terms of Service: https://guardianapp.com/privacy-policy/
Please contact support@guardianapp.com with any questions, concerns, or reports of potential security issues.

bluejetty:00128227:ios.name: Banana Kong 2
bluejetty:00128227:ios.summary:
Celebrate with us the return of Banana Kong!
We worked hard to create a worthy sequel for both fans and new players.
Run, jump, bounce and swing on lianas while traversing *new* forests, caves, treetops, lagoons and even the north pole!
bluejetty:00128227:ios.description:
Celebrate with us the return of Banana Kong!
We worked hard to create a worthy sequel for both fans and new players.
Run, jump, bounce and swing on lianas while traversing *new* forests, caves, treetops, lagoons and even the north pole! 
All your animal friends are back and there's so much more: How about hopping onto a penguin to slide on snowy slopes or riding ocean waves on a surfboard? It's a whole new world full of surprises. Even with many new features, the game remains simple to control as you know and love Banana Kong. 
Banana Kong 2 builds up on the original endless runner concept and adds entirely new challenges and ideas! Solve all-new missions, collect bananas and win golden Kong Coins to buy upgrades, hats and many other items in the crazy jungle shop! Become the King of the Jungle! While you dash through the jungle you'll be able to compete with your friends! Who will run the best distance? You can see your friends best results right in the game. Compare your records and unlock achievements while improving your playing style.
A highly dynamic game engine will provide endless fun in this neverending run. Each session is a new challenge as the level is built randomly on the fly. Collect as many bananas as possible to fill your energy bar. Use a power-dash to destroy obstacles. Find secrets and unlock extras to get the most out of the game.
Features:
- Each run is different!
- Hi-Res and Ultrawide Display Support
- Original Soundtrack by Sonic Mania composer Tee Lopes
- Full Game Center Integration
- 6 entirely different animal rides and more!
- One Thumb Controls
- Cloud Save
- 10 seconds from launching the game to playing it.

bluejetty:00149892:ios.description:
A dedicated team of digestive health experts, including GI providers, registered dietitians, and gut-brain specialists, now available at your fingertips.
That’s what you’ll get with Oshi Health - a comprehensive, virtual digestive health clinic that provides care for a wide range of gastrointestinal conditions, including Crohn’s disease, ulcerative colitis, irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), and small intestinal bacterial overgrowth (SIBO), as well as common digestive symptoms, such as diarrhea, constipation, abdominal pain, bloating, and more.
Experience a whole new level of GI care:
A whole-person, team-based approach: Get access to a fully-integrated team of GI providers, registered dietitians, and gut-brain specialists, all working together for you.
Get the care you need, when you need it: With extended hours, including evening and weekend availability, we make it easy to get seen by a GI provider within days, not weeks or months
Unlimited virtual visits and ongoing support: Meet and message with your care team on your own schedule, and from the comfort of your home.
With Oshi Health, you’ll get unlimited access to an integrated team of providers who have advanced training and expertise in GI care including, gastroenterologists, advanced practice providers, registered dietitians, gut-brain specialists, and care coordinators—all working together on a care plan specifically tailored for you.
Through a personalized, whole-person approach, your care team can get to the bottom of your GI symptoms, prescribe medications, order diagnostic labs/imaging, and help implement changes in diet, sleep, and stress.
Take back your life from digestive issues.Visit oshihealth.com/getstarted to see if you already have access to Oshi via your employer or health plan.
APP FEATURES:
Virtual visits with your care team
Convenient scheduling and appointments
Chat messaging with your care team

bluejetty:00061262:ios.description:
GlossGenius is the system 120,000+ beauty, wellness, and health businesses trust to earn more revenue and get more time back.
Why GlossGenius? 
Get more new clients 
Your booking site ranks on Google, so new clients find you when they're searching — no paid ads required. Automated confirmations and reminders keep no-shows off your calendar. And 24/7 online booking fills your schedule while you're with clients, at dinner, or asleep.
Earn more from every appointment
Other point-of-sale systems just process payments. GlossGenius is the only point-of-sale that earns you more. Keep more of what you make with our low, flat 2.6% rate and no hidden fees. Grow your average ticket value with features like Buy Now, Pay Later, Memberships, and Packages that make it easier for clients to spend more. Take payments from anywhere with Tap to Pay on iOS or our GlossGenius card readers. And quickly access your earnings with free same-business-day transfers.
Put busywork on autopilot
Other systems give you more to do. GlossGenius does more work for you. Staff calendars, cancellations, and waitlists run themselves. Payroll takes minutes: commissions, tips, and team pay are calculated and tracked automatically. One dashboard shows your top services, most valuable clients, and revenue at a glance. Your Growth Analyst works 24/7 to spot and surface growth opportunities, so your business can keep earning, even when you’re off the clock. 
Keep clients coming back
60% of clients who leave without a next appointment won't rebook on their own. Other tools leave that to you. GlossGenius makes sure they come back, without you having to ask. Clients get prompted to rebook at checkout while the experience is still fresh. Automated reminders go out when they're due for a visit — no chasing required. AI-powered Email & Text Marketing makes it easy to draft campaigns to hook clients who have drifted. Memberships & Packages give your best clients a reason to keep coming back. 
Dedicated support, whenever you need it
We treat your business like it’s our own. Our team knows beauty, wellness, and health businesses inside and out and is available by text, phone, and email.
We’ll take care of transferring your data for you. Free.
We'll transfer your client list, appointments, and notes from your current system at no charge. No manual re-entry, no starting over.
GlossGenius is trusted by 120,000+ businesses for: 
• Intuitive appointment scheduling and calendar management 
• The industry's lowest flat processing rate — 2.6%, no hidden fees 
• Custom booking websites that help you rank higher online
• Automated reminders that prevent no-shows
• Automated Waitlist that protects you from last-minute cancellations
• AI-powered marketing and unlimited emails, free
• Free same-business-day payment transfers
And more! 
What our members are saying

“I wouldn’t be able to generate the dollars that I make behind the chair without GlossGenius. No one has the time to do all that GlossGenius does without extremely high overhead.” - Christopher P.
