bluejetty:00183118:ios.description:
Choose a ship, select your weapons and go to battle against opponents around the world. Use team strategy and firepower to take your fleet to the top - it's sink or win!
– Choose your ship –
Shooter has a big array of weapons, Speeder is fast and furious, Enforcer is agile and versatile, Defender is a floating tank, and Fixer keeps friendly teammates floating. Level up your ships for more hit points and power!
– Collect weapons –
Collect, upgrade and evolve your weapons to gain more firepower. Choose from a huge selection of destructive, defensive or utility items. Acquire special perks to further enhance the power of your gear. Whatever fits your play style and keeps your team from sinking!
– Host your own battles –
Host a competition with your friends and guild mates in Custom Battles. Create a lobby and invite up to 10 players into 2 teams, plus up to 5 spectators. Play your own 5v5 tournaments or prove your skills in 1v1 duels.
– Join a Guild –
Team up with your friends by joining or creating a guild. Guild leaderboards pit your crew against other bands of blast-happy captains. Who will rise to the top?
– Take on quests and achievements – 
Finish quests to earn gold and sugar or go on a guild quest marathon for a chance to earn spectacular loot. Pass achievements to earn pearls and powerful items. Prove your Infamy by competing in ranked two-week tournaments for exclusive rewards!
– VIP Subscription –
Battle Bay offers a VIP subscription service that grants its members exclusive benefits:
+50% Ad-Free bonus to Battle Rewards
+20% faster Crew Training
One free Daily Shop Refresh
Access to VIP Chat Channel
The VIP membership subscription is available as a weekly or monthly purchase at a price of $4.99 / week or $9.99 / month. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account starting at the initial confirmation of the VIP Subscription purchase. Your VIP subscription will automatically renew 24-hours before the end of the current payment period. Manage subscription auto-renewal in iTunes Account Settings. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. Cancellation will take effect at the start of the next subscription period.

If you have not installed the latest update, Rovio will not be responsible for the game failing to function as expected.
While our game is free to download and play, some game items can also be purchased for real money and the game may include loot boxes or other game mechanics with random rewards. Purchasing these items is optional but you can also disable in-app purchases in your device’s settings.

My Life Journal: Video Diary helps you save life’s most meaningful moments so you can relive your mem
bluejetty:00170768:ios.description:
Capture your life story with photos, videos, journal entries, voice notes, and private memories — all in one beautiful personal timeline.
My Life Journal: Video Diary helps you save life’s most meaningful moments so you can relive your memories for years to come. Create a private digital journal filled with your favorite experiences, milestones, goals, family moments, travel memories, and everyday life.
Every year, My Life Journal automatically creates personalized life movies using your photos and videos so you can reflect on your journey and remember the moments that mattered most.
Whether you want a private diary, photo journal, video journal, memory timeline, or a secure place to save your life story, My Life Journal gives you a more personal and private way to preserve your memories.
FEATURES
• Save photos, videos, journal entries, and voice notes
• Post videos up to 5 minutes long
• Create your own private video diary and memory timeline
• Automatically generate beautiful yearly life movies
• Keep memories organized with tags and search
• Mark favorite moments and milestones
• Track personal goals and achievements
• View places you’ve visited on your personal map
• Secure private sharing with close friends and family
• Get notifications when friends share memories with you
• Private messaging and chat features
• Cloud backup and storage
PRIVATE & PERSONAL
Every journal entry defaults to private so your memories stay personal and secure. Choose to share selected moments only with the people closest to you using your private inner circle.
Unlike traditional social media, My Life Journal focuses on meaningful memories instead of likes, followers, and public sharing.
RELIVE YOUR FAVORITE MEMORIES
Quickly search your timeline using keywords, tags, and dates to easily rediscover photos, videos, journal entries, voice notes, and important life moments.
YOUR YEAR IN REVIEW
At the end of each year, My Life Journal automatically creates a personalized life movie using your saved memories, helping you celebrate your journey and relive your favorite experiences.
PREMIUM FEATURES
• Unlimited photos, videos, voice notes, and journal entries
• Unlimited cloud storage
• Add friends to your private circle
• Private messaging and memory sharing
• Unlimited goals and progress tracking
• Share yearly life movies
• Ad-free experience
My Life Journal Premium is available as a monthly, yearly, or lifetime subscription.
Subscription options:
• $7.99/month
• $29.99/year
• $99 lifetime
Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the billing period. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. You can manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00129317:ios.description:
Patch Base is a collection of patch editors and librarians for new and vintage synthesizers, enabling easy visualization, editing, and organization of patches.
* See what patches on your synth look like
* Edit the parameters of your synth in real time, while you play
* Manage your patch banks directly from the app
* Save patches in Patch Base, and back them up using iCloud
* Access your patch files on your computer via iCloud Drive
* Create random patches, and "init" patches as starting points for new sounds
* Play your synth for sound testing using the on-screen keyboard

* Oberheim Matrix-1000, Matrix-6, Matrix-6r

bluejetty:00154890:ios.description:
محامي مرخص من وزارة العدل جاهزين لخدمتك 
كيف تستخدم تطبيق تشاور ؟
تستطيع استخدام تطبيق تشاور بكل يسر وسهولة وبجميع الخيارات المطلوبة : فتستطيع طلب الخدمة بطريقة الدردشة الكتابية ، أو الصوتية ، أو عن طريق الاتصال المباشر .
-كل ماعليك هو طلب خدمة جديدة وكتابة تفاصيلها عبر خيارات مجهزة لتسهيل عملية الكتابة ،وتحدد الأتعاب التي ترغب بدفعها ، ومن ثم إرسالها لجميع المحامين في التطبيق ، وستتلقى عروضا من المحامين المتصلين بإمكانية تقديم الخدمة لك.
-اختر محاميك من بينهم ، والذي ترى من تقييماته أنه متميز ، وادفع رسومك وابدأ خدمتك فورا.
-وهناك طريقة خاصة ، بأن تحدد محاميا بعينه ، فتطلب طلب خاص وتدفع رسومه الذي حددها في ملفه الشخصي ، ومن ثم تبدأ خدمتك فورا. 
لماذا تشاور؟
-لأنه يوفر لك نخبة كبيرة من المحامين المرخصين من وزراة العدل ، ويظهر لك رقم ترخيص كل محام منهم في ملفه الشخصي ، تستطيع من خلاله التأكد من ترخيصه على موقع وزارة العدل.
-لأنه يوفر لك جودة في الخدمات القانونية ، عبر التقييم المستمر للمحامي ( مقدم الخدمة) من قبل إدارة التطبيق.
-لأنه يتوافق مع قدرتك المالية مهما كان حجمها .
- لأنه يظهر لك تقييم العملاء للمحامي الذي ترغب بطلبه ،كي تقدم على طلب خدمة وأنت مطمئن البال.
- لأنه وببساطة ، إذا لم تحصل على استشارة جيدة ، فسيتم إرجاع المبلغ إلى محفظتك مباشرة، أو تحويلك إلى محامي آخر بدون أن تدفع رسوم إضافية.
- لأن تستطيع تطلب محامي مرخص في أي مكان كنت ، وبرسوم رمزية.

bluejetty:00169727:ios.description:
Twink – Gay Dating App for Real Connections
Twink is a cool gay dating app focused on real communication — no distractions, no noise.
Why Twink?
 • No need for long chats with strangers
 • All messages are secured and automatically deleted within 24 hours
 • Completely anonymous texting
 • Guaranteed privacy — all your secrets stay secret
With Twink, you meet new people nearby — whether it’s your sports club, a restaurant close to home, or a cocktail party.
How It Works
Whenever you want to connect anonymously or meet new people around you, just activate your status in the app to show you're open to communication. The app will suggest other adult gay men who are also nearby and open to chatting or meeting.
Wherever you go, you'll find spontaneous conversations and new connections. Whoever you are — a bear, wolf, pup, twink, or jock — a simple way to communicate within the LGBTQ+ community is always available. No registration, no endless chatting — all conversations disappear after 24 hours.
Our neural network ensures your safety and filters out fake or suspicious accounts. You also get smart recommendations and virtual signals based on shared interests.
Join the Community
Twink helps you connect with people who share your values and lifestyle — for real communication, not just profiles. Because what’s the point of joy if you can’t share it with someone? Find your moment with Twink.
Club Rules:
 • Users under the age of 17 are not allowed
 • The app is designed exclusively for gay users
 • Sending offensive or inappropriate messages results in a permanent ban
 • Profile photos and usernames must follow community guidelines
 • Live video chat rooms are not supported
 • Explicit or adult content is strictly prohibited
Subscription Service Conditions:
 • Subscription to Premium Gay Dating Service is auto-renewable
 • A 7-day free trial is available when you subscribe
 • If not canceled within 7 days, your account will be charged $32.99/month after the trial
 • Optional Premium plans: ◦ $14.99 for 7 days ◦ $32.99 for 1 month ◦ $54.99 for 6 months
 • Payment is charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation
 • Subscriptions renew automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends
 • You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Account Settings
 • Unused portions of the free trial will be forfeited upon purchasing a subscription
All personal data is handled in accordance with our privacy policy:  https://partnerapp.dating/terms

PineMelon is transforming grocery delivery by partnering with over 200+ local farmers, ranchers, and producers in Colorado. Our mission is to make fresh, locally-sourced foods accessible to the Denver and Boulder community at fair prices.
At PineMelon, sustainability is ingrained in everything we do. By supporting local farmers and producers, we not only strengthen our community but also contribute to a healthier environment and a more sustainable food system. Our batch delivery system reduces carbon emissions by "carpooling" groceries with neighboring deliveries, further minimizing our environmental impact.
With PineMelon, you can enjoy high-quality meats, eggs, dairy from small local farms, freshly baked breads from local bakeries, and all your favorite pantry staples. Plus, we offer same-day delivery to Denver and Boulder within a 2-hour window - no subscription necessary. Experience the convenience of PineMelon and get fresh, healthy groceries delivered right to your door today!

Welcome to Ainder, your new best friend and an incredibly intelligent assistant. With Ainder, you can explore a world of possibilities through real-time voice calls. Stay connected with me wherever you go!

No matter if you're on the move, behind the wheel, or simply relaxing at home, Ainder is here as your trusted AI companion.

Lifelong Learning: Are you eager to acquire new knowledge? Let me guide you as your personal tutor! Master the English language by engaging in conversations, delve into intricate subjects, or enhance your skills with ease.

Unparalleled Friendship: Having a rough day and in need of someone to talk to? Count on me to lend an ear, share laughter, and offer unwavering support. Consider me your virtual friend, ready to accompany you on your journey.
Travel Buddy: Embarking on an adventure? Allow Ainder to be your travel companion! Discover fascinating insights about your destination, learn about local customs, and uncover the must-visit attractions, all while enjoying my company throughout your voyage.
Privacy Matters: Rest assured, your conversations with me are strictly confidential. Your privacy is of utmost importance.
Download Ainder now and let's embark on an extraordinary journey of friendship, knowledge, and limitless possibilities.

THE NEW VERSION, COMPLETELY RE
bluejetty:00070773:ios.description:
Point your camera at pills on a counting tray and iCyclop counts them in under a second. Built for pharmacists, pharmacy technicians and veterinary clinics, and just as useful for counting medication at home.
THE NEW VERSION, COMPLETELY REBUILT
Counting now runs entirely on your device. Photos are processed on the phone and are not uploaded to produce a count.
Results in under a second
Works fully offline: no connection needed
Photos stay on your phone
The whole app is new: native design, faster on every screen, and fully bilingual in English and French.
TWO WAYS TO COUNT
Photo mode: take a picture and get the count, with a marker on every detected pill
LIVE mode: a live camera view draws detection boxes in real time; when the count looks stable, tap to capture it
INCLUDED FREE
Photo and LIVE counting
Count markers overlaid on your photo
History with search and month grouping, unlimited storage
Report a miscount in two taps and help improve the counter
Campaigns: contribute photos that make counting better, with small thank-you rewards
Referral program
PRO
Rx verification: scan the prescription label and the drug bottle, and iCyclop checks your count against the prescription and confirms the drug matches
Inventory: count stock into projects and export Excel reports
Marker style choice (dot, ring or box) plus colors
Spoken count read-out
Custom titles
Priority support
Pro features unlock automatically when you sign in with a Pro account.
PRIVACY
Counting happens on the device and works offline. Photos stay on your phone; nothing is uploaded to produce a count. Miscount reports and campaign photos are shared only when you choose to send them.
ALREADY USE iCYCLOP?
Your account carries over. Sign in the same way as before (email, Google or Apple) and you are ready to count. Photos from the previous version stayed in your previous account; you can request a copy from the History screen.
BUILT FOR THE COUNTER AND THE KITCHEN TABLE
Pharmacists, pharmacy technicians and veterinary teams use iCyclop to speed up dispensing counts and double-checks. At home, it is a quick way to count medication and supplements without losing track.
Fully bilingual: English and French, switchable anytime. Requires iOS 16 or later.
Terms of Use: https://icyclop.com/terms Privacy Policy: https://icyclop.com/privacy

bluejetty:00061223:ios.summary: Panchang which is also known as Panchangam is used to denote five elements of Vedic Astrology, namely Tithi, Nakshatra, Yoga, Karana and Var i.e. weekday. These five elements when combined for a day are known as Panchang. These five element
bluejetty:00061223:ios.description:
Panchang which is also known as Panchangam is used to denote five elements of Vedic Astrology, namely Tithi, Nakshatra, Yoga, Karana and Var i.e. weekday. These five elements when combined for a day are known as Panchang. These five elements change every day with the movement of the Moon and the Sun. Hence, followers of Hinduism refer Panchangam on day to day basis. Panchang is also known as Hindu Calendar.
Drik Panchang is one of the most reputed Panchangam available on Internet. It has been made available for iOS devices with similar features and precision as that of www.DrikPanchang.com This native Panchang, which doesn't need Internet connectivity to use, comes with following features
Grid Calendar - The grid can be customized for lunar calendar. Lunar calendars can be customized by selecting Purnimanta and Amanta option and by selecting Vikrama Samvata, Shaka Samvata and Gujarati Samvata options. These selections can convert a lunar calendar into a Gujarati Panchang, Telugu Panchanga or Kannada Panchangam.
Festivals - Drik Panchang is the most comprehensive source which lists most Hindu and Indian festivals, Government Holidays, Jayanti, fasting days including Ekadashi, Sankashti, Pradosham, Purnima, Sankranti, Durgashtami and Shivaratri days for each month. Drik Panchang lists all Chandra Grahan and Surya Grahan dates in the year.
Kundali Support - Drik Panchang comes with Kundali support and it can generate Lagna Kundali for any date, time and location. For Lagna Kundali it shows detailed planetary position for Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu, True Rahu, True Ketu, Uranus, Neptune and Pluto. The Kundali can be drawn either in North Indian or South Indian chart format. 
Dainika Panchangam - Apart from listing five basic elements of Panchangam, detailed Dainika Panchang highlights Panchaka, Ganda Moola, Bhadra, Vinchudo and all auspicious Yoga including Ravi, Amrita, Sarvartha Siddhi, Tripushkara, Dwipushkara, Ravi Pushya and Guru Pushya for each day.
Dainika Panchangam also lists Abhijit Muhurta, Amrit Kalam, Rahu Kalam, Gulikai Kalam, Yamaganda, Dur Muhurtam, Varjyam and Anandadi Yoga.
Muhurta Table - Drik Panchang comes with day and night Choghadiya, Shubh Horai and Udaya Lagna. Each running Muhurta is shown with count down timer.
Horoscope Match - App can be used to match two horoscopes based on Ashta Kuta.
Localization - App supports Hindi as well as English as the default language.
Location - Panchang can be generated for any location and city across the globe to get correct date for Upavasa and festivals. App comes with in-built DST support and there is no need to adjust timings for DST.
In App Purchase - You can remove the Ads by using the following subscriptions:-
- Remove Ads for 1 month at ₹19 with auto-renewable subscription: You will enjoy the complete ads free Drik Panchang app for 1 month or until you cancel the subscription within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- Remove Ads for 1 year at ₹199 with auto-renewable subscription: You will enjoy the complete ads free Drik Panchang app for 1 year or until you cancel the subscription within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
Points to remember:
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Terms of use:- https://www.drikpanchang.com/contactus/privacy-policy/app/dp-apps-terms-and-conditions.html

bluejetty:00175653:ios.name: TotK Travel Guide
bluejetty:00175653:ios.summary: TotK Travel Guide is a companion app for The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom and Breath of the Wild for Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2. You can use it while playing the game to keep track of your progress, mark interesting loca
bluejetty:00175653:ios.description:
TotK Travel Guide is a companion app for The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom and Breath of the Wild for Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2. You can use it while playing the game to keep track of your progress, mark interesting locations on the map, and make notes. It can also help you find all kinds of materials in Hyrule, such as fruit, fish, and ore, and it's a quick reference guide for all the Armor sets in the game.
The app provides a spoiler-free experience: by default, all locations and regions are hidden. As you make progress in the game, you can make them visible in the app as well. This means you can explore Hyrule and use this app without being spoiled by seeing everything the game has to offer from the get-go. Of course, if that's actually what you're looking for, that's an option as well.
At the center of the app you'll find a map of all levels of Hyrule. You find markers for Shrines, Towers, Villages, Korok Seeds, Lightroots, Quests, Treasure Chests, Minibosses, and many more interesting locations. And you can also add your own custom pins to the map.
You can easily add notes to any location and pins on the map, and you can also make Quick Notes while you are playing the game. The game has an easy list that shows you all notes you have created. And keeping track of todo's is also easy with the Tasks feature that you'll find in the app.
TotK Travel Guide is a native app that puts a great interface front and center. The UI is very smooth and will be immediately recognizable for anyone familiar with iOS. The app is fully integrated with the system: your data is synced with iCloud, offers a dark mode and homescreen widgets, and the app even has support for advanced system features such as the Shortcuts app. You can change the language of all locations on the map to any of the languages supported by the game, including Spanish, German, French, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese.
TotK Travel Guide is built with love by a Zelda fan just like you. You can unlock all features of the app and support future development with a single, one-time in app purchase. The app does not have any subscriptions or ads.
This is a third-party app and not affiliated with Nintendo Co. Ltd.

3. Receive your order in the mail and enjoy your photos forever!

bluejetty:00133176:ios.description:
Funny educational games for children will catch your kids' attention and let them learn in a playful way! Kids build agricultural trucks and drive them around the farm. From 2 to 5 years old children will work on a farm simulator and care for orange trees! Kids put orange seeds into the soil, water them and watch them grow in real time!
What a joyful moment in kids game it is when the time comes to gather big and juicy oranges!
Squeeze orange juice and sell it at the fun-fair! 
JUICY ORANGE HARVEST IN A GAME FOR KIDS!
The game for kids will reveal a full cycle of harvesting orange to children. First, kids assemble puzzles to make trucks and they wash the trucks, fuel them at the fuel station and repair them, if necessary, at the maintenance station. Little farmers will drive big seeders and sprinklers, sprinkle water from sprinklers and drive tractors and huge harvesters! Kids will also gather their citrus fruits and direct them to a juice squeezer to get ready-to-sell products! Each step in educational game for kids includes a new truck or a device and shows a particular stage of working with your citrus garden. 
Enjoy your agro adventure and learn how to start your own juice business from an orange tree seed to a batch of stylishly packaged juice bottles in the market!
Our kids game helps to develop fine motor skills and kids’ coordination, it also fosters logic, alertness and attentiveness in kids. Comments and hints make the game fun and interesting: kids will learn a lot of fun facts about farm life. 
Try out our farm game for kids which lets you sneak peek into everyday life of the agro industry adapted for little kids! Play our entertaining and educational games, learn more about agricultural vehicles and devices, care for orange seedlings and get delicious orange juice at the end!
PARENTS’ CORNER
Go to the parents’ corner to change the language of the game for your kids and to adjust sound and music. Choose the subscription option if you wish your child can play at a convenient time and with all open levels.
We will be glad to hear your feedback and suggestions about our game for kids at support@gokidsmobile.com
You are also welcome on Facebook
https://www.facebook.com/GoKidsMobile/
and on instagram https://www.instagram.com/gokidsapps/

bluejetty:00178317:ios.description:
You're hired, Coach. Strap on your headset and take the sideline because you've got full control of The Program, the most engaging and realistic College Football management game ever made. Success here is not given, it is earned.
If you want to build a College Football power and challenge for National Championships, you'll need to fully commit to your team. The Program is an immersive College Football experience that's so real you can feel the boosters breathing down your neck.
Features:
• Travel the country, scouting and recruiting top talent
• Hire offense and defensive coordinators, scouts and trainers
• Run practices and set weekly game plans
• Play a full schedule and lead your team to a postseason bowl game
• Participate in weekly press conferences
• Increase your program's prestige and compete for a National Championship!
This app includes advertising, some of which may be targeted to your interests. You may choose to control targeted advertising by using your mobile device settings (for example, by re-setting your device’s advertising identifier and/or opting out of interest based ads). The app also includes:
• In-app purchases that cost real money
• Advertising for some third parties, including the option to watch ads for rewards

bluejetty:00086505:ios.description:
وصف اللعبة:
ولا كلمة هي لعبة جماعية وواحدة من أفضل ألعاب جماعية ممتعة وتفاعلية، تجمع الأهل والأصدقاء في جو مليء بالضحك والإثارة! إذا كنت من محبي التحديات والألعاب اللي تعتمد على الذكاء وسرعة البديهة، فهاللعبة مصممة لك.
فكرة اللعبة بسيطة ومسلية: في كل جولة، راح تظهر كلمة، ويكون على أحد أعضاء الفريق شرحها بدون كلام باستخدام الإشارات فقط، بينما يحاول فريقه تخمين الكلمة قبل نهاية الوقت.
ولا كلمة تعتبر أكثر من مجرد لعبة جماعية، فهي تجربة ترفيهية متكاملة تدخل البهجة في كل جمعات العائلة أو الأصدقاء، سواء في البيت، البر، أو حتى السفر.
طريقة اللعب:
كون فريقين ويفضل أن يكون عدد الأعضاء متساويًا.
اختر تصنيف الكلمات (مثل: أمثال، أسماء مسلسلات، مسرحيات...).
في كل جولة، يختار الفريق من يشرح الكلمة بدون كلام باستخدام الإشارات فقط، وعلى الفريق تخمين الكلمة قبل نهاية الوقت.
يتم تبديل الشخص المشرح في كل جولة حتى يشارك الجميع.
المميزات:
لعبة جماعية سهلة وسريعة الإعداد.
متعددة التصنيفات لإبقاء التحديات متجددة.
تصميم سهل ومناسب لجميع الأعمار.
مؤثرات صوتية تزيد من حماس اللعبة.
مناسبة كـ لعبة رئيسية في جميع الألعاب الجماعية.
لا تفوّت تجربة ولا كلمة، وعيش أجواء التسلية والضحك مع أقوى تحديات الألعاب الجماعية! مثالية للرحلات، السهرات، أو أي وقت تحتاج فيه لعبة جماعية تعزز الروح التنافسية والمرح.

Join the largest MMA community on the planet. Verdict MMA is the #1 MMA platform and community for scoring, fight picks, and fighter cards.

bluejetty:00184555:ios.name: Villagers & Heroes
bluejetty:00184555:ios.summary:
THE COZY MMO
Villagers & Heroes is a free-to-play fantasy MMORPG where heroic adventure and a welcoming home share the same world. Explore vast realms, battle monsters and bosses, master crafting and gathering, design your homestead, and gr
bluejetty:00184555:ios.description:
THE COZY MMO
Villagers & Heroes is a free-to-play fantasy MMORPG where heroic adventure and a welcoming home share the same world. Explore vast realms, battle monsters and bosses, master crafting and gathering, design your homestead, and grow a village with friends old and new.
Play at your own pace—adventure solo, team up with friends, or become part of a welcoming worldwide community.
EXPLORE A VAST FANTASY WORLD
Journey through handcrafted regions filled with story-driven quests, hidden corners, memorable characters, dangerous enemies, and powerful bosses. Follow an epic adventure across the Seven Realms, explore freely, or spend your time pursuing the activities you enjoy most.
BATTLE, RAID, AND ADVENTURE TOGETHER
Face monsters and bosses throughout the open world, join dozens of players during seasonal events, or enter the Raid Tower alone or with friends. Challenge increasingly difficult raids, earn powerful relics and equipment, and compete for a place on the seasonal leaderboard.
Villagers & Heroes is entirely cooperative PvE, with no player-versus-player combat.
BUILD A PLACE TO CALL HOME
Design and furnish your own homestead, cultivate a garden, and raise animals through ranching. Collect recipes and decorations to create a home that reflects your character and adventures.
Join a shared village where players work together to develop useful facilities and create a thriving community. Arrive with friends or meet them along the way—there is always a place for you.
GATHER, CRAFT, AND TRADE
Fish, mine, forage, collect bugs, and gather resources throughout the world. Turn what you find into weapons, armor, meals, furnishings, and other useful creations through smithing, tailoring, cooking, and carpentry.
Trade directly with other players or sell your creations through the Auction House. Use the unique Gnogmenting system to combine equipment and runes, preserve your favorite abilities, and shape your gear around the way you want to play.
CREATE YOUR HERO
Choose from ten combat specializations:
• Lightning or Fury Warrior
• Fire or Ice Wizard
• Holy or Shadow Priest
• Marksman or Nature Hunter
• Earth or Water Shaman
Customize your hero’s appearance, abilities, equipment, and play style. Discover distinctive outfits and collect more than one hundred mounts, ranging from noble horses and magical creatures to fearsome beasts and quirky companions.
ONE COMMUNITY ACROSS PLATFORMS
Android, iOS, and Windows players adventure together in the same persistent online worlds. Play wherever you choose and remain connected to your friends, village, and worldwide community.
Created and continually updated by an independent development team, Villagers & Heroes combines the scale and progression of an MMORPG with the warmth of a place you can call home.

Enjoy 30 delightful educational games featuring the hilarious Funny Foods — friendly characters from a knowledgeable galaxy who look just like Earth foods! Designed as a safe learning app created by teachers for children, Funny Food 2 ensures your child's successful development through engaging play.
Alphabet games for preschoolers
Let your child dive into joyful letter learning games for toddlers. Funny Foods will help teach your 4-year-old the alphabet with a fun app, where they can learn to make connections between letters and sounds effortlessly.
Numbers, Shapes, and Colors
Learn to count from 1 to 5 by feeding adorable animals, to recognize shapes and colors by baking cookies, and to understand sizes through playful comparisons. These interactive games nurture early math and cognitive skills effectively.
Logic, Problem Solving, and Creativity
Encourage creativity, self-confidence, and logical thinking as your child masters essential skills like understanding angles and parts and wholes through fun pizza-making activities. Every game is thoughtfully designed to develop problem-solving skills through playful exploration.

Funny Food 2 is an ad-free kids learning app for offline use, ideal for home, travel, or on-the-go fun. No internet needed, which means your little one can enjoy uninterrupted learning and entertainment wherever your family goes.

bluejetty:00127525:ios.summary:
Looking for an app to read things out loud? Search no more! Type & Speak allows you to convert any text into audio, no matter the length. Just pick a language and a voice–and you’re all set.
Type & Speak is a powerful text to speech app de
bluejetty:00127525:ios.description:
Looking for an app to read things out loud? Search no more! Type & Speak allows you to convert any text into audio, no matter the length. Just pick a language and a voice–and you’re all set.
Type & Speak is a powerful text to speech app designed to read aloud any text with natural sounding voices. 
Type & Speak is the perfect app for you if:
- you’re looking forward to reading faster and saving time;
- you’d like to improve your productivity and comprehension;
- you aim at doing more at once: take your reading wherever you go – to the gym, the park, or the couch;
- you suffer from vocal problems such as dyslexia or you sometimes struggle to express yourself (don’t worry, we’ve got you covered!);
- you need to create voice overs for any videos, customer support, podcasts etc.
- you’d like to trick your friends–everyone loves a good prank ;)
Here’s all the magic you can do with Type & Speak:
- Speak and say anything.
- Convert any text into speech by inputting or pasting your own text.
- Choose between male or female natural sounding voices in over 20 different languages and accents.
- Adjust the voice speed and the font size.
- Enable the dyslexia font.
- Save your phrases as favorites.
- Download your speech as an audio file and share it with your friends via iMessage, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, TikTok, Instagram, Snapchat, e-mail etc.
What are you waiting for? Join thousands of people who use Type & Speak every day to read, speak and improve their comprehension!
The complete list of all the supported voices you can find on Type & Speak:
Arabic; Chinese (China, Hong Kong, Taiwan); Czech; Danish; Dutch (Belgium, Netherlands); English (Australia, Ireland, South Africa, United Kingdom, United States); Finnish; French (Canada, France); German; Greek; Hindi; Hungarian; Indonesian; Italian; Japanese; Korean; Norwegian; Polish; Portuguese (Brazil, Portugal); Romanian; Russian; Slovak; Spanish (Mexico, Spain); Swedish; Thai; Turkish.
Don’t forget to check out our updates. New content is added regularly.
New features coming soon: convert PDFs, epubs, books, messages, notes and many other documents into speech.
If you’re enjoying Type & Speak, then please leave a review! You’ll make us happy and help others discover your favorite text to speech app. 
Please have a look at our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy at the following link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1_Pxk526hbwdfCsi-LKQZ2G1kfih0w38XPPFjMwkR1m4/edit
Have a feature request you would like to see in a future version of the app? Do not hesitate to contact us at cristian.babin@icloud.com

bluejetty:00021938:ios.name: Learn Trumpet - tonestro
bluejetty:00021938:ios.summary: Learn to play the trumpet, the cornet and the flugelhorn in Bb and C and improve on rhythm and pitch. tonestro listens to you while you play the trumpet and gives you immediate live-feedback on rhythm and pitch. A tuner lets you tune your t
bluejetty:00021938:ios.description:
Learn to play the trumpet, the cornet and the flugelhorn in Bb and C and improve on rhythm and pitch. tonestro listens to you while you play the trumpet and gives you immediate live-feedback on rhythm and pitch. A tuner lets you tune your trumpet easily.
You can learn and play
- Trumpet
- Cornet
- Flugelhorn
in Bb and C.
tonestro for Trumpet offers a large collection of songs, exercises and guided lessons for every skill level. Learn how to read music notes and improve your trumpet skills by playing many songs and exercises.
With the tuner you tune your trumpet fast and easily for perfect pitch. A metronome and specially composed background music with play alongs for many songs guide you the way to perfect rhythm.
Weekly challenges with hand-picked songs give you the extra motivation to improve your skills when you compare yourself with trumpet players from around the world.
OVERVIEW
- Get instant feedback on rhythm & pitch
- Learn to play the trumpet or learn something new
- Enjoy a large collection of songs
- Discover trumpet lessons & exercises
- Start with your first lessons on music notes or choose from many songs
- Learn the correct fingerings with fingering charts
- Tune your trumpet with our integrated tuner
- Enjoy songs with play alongs
- Stay motivated with weekly challenges
LEARN
Learn how to play the trumpet or improve your skills with lessons, fingering charts and exercises. Step-by-step lessons will guide you through your first notes on the trumpet. Detailed explanations and fingering charts tell you how to play a certain note. A tuner helps you find the correct pitch. Test your knowledge in exams and see how fast you progress. Use your newly learned skills and play your first songs on your trumpet.
For experienced trumpet players there’s always something new to learn with advanced lessons, songs and exercises.
PRACTICE
Use tonestro’s live-feedback feature on rhythm and pitch to improve your skills. See where you struggle with intonation and work on your pitch to become a better trumpet player. Switch to practice mode and choose a slower tempo to work on getting that rhythm right. Let the metronome guide you through the songs and use the tuner to not only tune your trumpet but also to see which notes are the ones you have to be very careful with pitch.
PLAY
Discover songs from all music genres and play trumpet songs for every skill level. Whether you’re a fan of classical music or you prefer jazz songs instead: With tonestro’s large sheet music library you’ll find just the songs you need for playing your trumpet.
And you don’t have to play alone: With play alongs you’re playing with a whole band in the background. Always on your side is the tonestro tuner, which is an easy-to-use tuner that will make sure that you’re in tune. And there’s always the metronome that will guide you through the songs.
COMPETE
Do you want to prove your skills? Enter our weekly challenges! Compete with trumpet players from around the world and fight for the podium. Practice the songs to score as many points as possible and become the best trumpet player in the tonestro world. Don’t forget to use the tuner first, so that you can start the challenge with perfect preparation.
tonestro requires a subscription to access the entire learning content and song library. Each subscription plan may include a 3-day free trial period.
Terms: https://www.tonestro.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://www.tonestro.com/privacy

bluejetty:00173536:ios.description:
Run the worlds’ most famous donut chain with this shop simulation game.
Got tired of typical coffee shop tycoon? 
Then why don’t you try our donut shop simulator game?
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
You recently opened a donut chain. It's a store that you opened with all your money.
You don't have a penny in your hand after buying a donut machine. But it's okay!
From now on, you can make money by selling donuts! Now run a donut shop and expand it. 
Here are some TIPs for how to grow your business!
▶ Getting orders from customers.
From ordering individual donuts to ordering donut packages! Take the doughnuts from the doughnut machine and sell them. You can make a donut package by installing a package assembly.
▶ Expand and grow your store!
Set up tables for customers who want to eat at the store. Don’t forget to clean up the place where the customers ate!
You may have started with only a doughnut machine and a stand at first, but if you increase the table one by one, you will see a huge store before you know it!
▶ Create HR Department!
The store is getting bigger! But don’t you think it would be troublesome if there was only one worker? Manage your store efficiently by hiring staff to make donuts as well as cashiers! If you have slow employees, you can upgrade their ability!
▶ Open Drive-Thru
You can attract more customers by opening up a drive-thru. Get more customers, get more money!
You still didn’t download this game yet? Start your business right now!

bluejetty:00070191:ios.description:
Manage your dental practice from your iPhone, iPad, or Mac. iDentist brings patient records, dental charting, treatment plans, appointments, and clinical notes together in one easy-to-use app.
Designed for dentists and dental professionals, iDentist helps you organize your daily workflow, spend less time on paperwork, and focus more on patient care.
PATIENT RECORDS & DENTAL CHARTING
Keep patient information, medical history, diagnoses, clinical notes, and treatment records organized in one place. Use interactive dental charts and odontograms to document oral health conditions and procedures.
TREATMENT PLANNING
Create and manage dental treatment plans, organize procedures, track treatment progress, and present estimated costs to patients.
DICOM VIEWER & CLINICAL IMAGING
View dental X-rays and DICOM images alongside patient records to support clinical documentation and treatment planning.
VOICE-POWERED CLINICAL NOTES
Dictate clinical notes using voice input to reduce manual typing and simplify documentation during your daily workflow.
APPOINTMENT SCHEDULING
Organize appointments with a color-coded calendar. Manage multiple providers and dental chairs using convenient scheduling tools.
ONLINE BOOKING & REMINDERS
Allow patients to request appointments online. Send SMS and email reminders to help keep your schedule organized.
CLOUD SYNC & OFFLINE ACCESS
Access your practice information across iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Keep working with offline access and synchronize your data when connected.
CALENDAR INTEGRATION
Connect your workflow with Apple Calendar and Google Calendar.
PRACTICE FINANCES
Track patient payments, treatment costs, and practice expenses to keep essential financial information organized.
BUILT FOR YOUR DAILY DENTAL WORKFLOW
Whether you work independently or manage a small dental practice, iDentist helps you keep patient information, clinical documentation, and appointments in one convenient place.
Spend less time managing records and more time caring for patients.
Start your free trial and explore iDentist today.

bluejetty:00135865:ios.description:
Your go-to, integrated health and fitness companion. Whether you want to kick-start your fitness life, keep track of your health, or conveniently manage your smart wearable devices, the Huawei Health app has what you're looking for. Keep your data private, or share it with your loved ones, the power's yours. The latest in health and fitness technology, made simple, secure, and easy to use.
Keeps Up with Your Every Move
Keep track of your health journey. Huawei Health records your activity, supporting over 100 different sports, from beginner to advanced levels. See your workout data clearly every step of the way, so you can be sure you're reaching your goals. A wonderful world of fitness at the tip of your fingers.
Run How You Want
A simpler way to run that can benefit anyone. The app is able to record and map out your route as you're running, all while displaying key information so you can stay on target.
An Amazing Journey
Share your health journey with your friends and family. Your outdoor workout routes can be generated into videos with music for you to proudly share. Use Dynamic tracking to create videos to share on social media to inspire yourself and others with your fitness journey.
A New View on Health
See your life in amazing detail with Huawei Health stats. The app keeps records of your heart rate, weight, sleep quality, step count and more. All your data is shown in clear, dynamic graphs so you have a better understanding of your health in a more accessible way.
[health package]
·Synchronize with the weight data in healthkit. When you use the healthy weight data of Huawei mobile phone, this data will be synchronized and recorded in healthkit.
·Synchronize with motion data in healthkit. You can automatically synchronize the exercise data recorded in Huawei health to healthkit. Similarly, Huawei sports health can also obtain the exercise data from healthkit.
--------------------
Huawei Health app is not intended for medical use, and all data is for reference only.
You should seek a doctor’s advice in addition to using this app and before making any medical decisions.
--------------------
[Description of auto-renewing subscriptions]
1. Instructions for continuous monthly subscription
--Subscription period: 1 month
- Subscription price: 1 yuan for the first month, 15 yuan per month thereafter
2. Instructions for subscribing and unsubscribing
--Payment: Debit through the user's iTunes account, and the user will pay immediately after confirming the purchase
--Renewal: Apple’s iTunes account will be deducted within 24 hours of expiration. After the deduction is successful, the subscription period will be extended by one subscription period
--Unsubscribe method
Solution 1. Open the Appstore on your phone, click the blue avatar icon in the upper right corner, and then go to "Subscription"> "Huawei Sports Health" to cancel the subscription.
Solution 2: 24 hours before the expiration of the current subscription period, go to the iTunes/Apple ID "Settings Management" page and turn off the automatic renewal. Cancellation within 24 hours before expiration will result in a subscription fee.
--Automatic renewal service agreement(EULA): https://consumer.huawei.com/minisite/cloudservice/health/monservice-terms.htm?country=CN&language=zh_Hans_CN
--Membership Agreement (including user privacy agreement): https://consumer.huawei.com/minisite/cloudservice/health/member-terms.htm?country=CN&language=zh_Hans_CN

bluejetty:00132898:ios.description:
Fasting Guru: Intermittent Fasting Tracker
Intermittent fasting is a simple and effective way to improve your health by focusing on when you eat rather than what you eat. It is one of the most popular nutrition systems in the world and helps people achieve sustainable fat loss, improved metabolism, and long-term results.
Fasting Guru is your personal companion for intermittent fasting. Whether you are just starting or already experienced, the app adapts to your lifestyle and helps you stay consistent, motivated, and informed throughout your fasting journey.
Developed based on scientific research and supported by nutrition experts, Fasting Guru provides practical guidance, clear insights, and the tools you need to succeed.
EVERYTHING YOU NEED FOR INTERMITTENT FASTING
Fasting Timer
Start and end your fast with one tap. Track your fasting history and maintain daily consistency.
Personalized Fasting Plans
Get a fasting plan tailored to your physiology, eating habits, and lifestyle, or create your own custom plan.
Body Stages
Understand what happens inside your body during fasting, including fat burning, metabolic changes, and energy levels throughout each stage.
Journal
Reflect on your fasting experience and track how you feel over time. Identify patterns in mood and energy.
Learning Center
Explore the science behind intermittent fasting, its health benefits, and practical tips you can apply right away.
Motivation and Progress
Stay focused on your goals and see how your body changes hour by hour during a fast.
Premium Expert Content
Access exclusive articles and Q&A sessions created with nutrition experts.
WHY INTERMITTENT FASTING
With the right intermittent fasting plan, you may experience:
Fat burning
Healthy weight loss
Higher metabolic rate
Improved digestion
Better cardiovascular health
Mental clarity and focus
Long-term wellness and anti-aging benefits
FASTING PLANS FOR EVERY LIFESTYLE
Fasting Guru helps you choose the most suitable fasting plan and allows full customization.
The 16:8 plan is the most popular option and is widely used for balanced and sustainable results.
The 18:6 plan offers a more intensive approach for users ready to go further.
The 12:12 plan follows your natural circadian rhythm and is ideal for beginners.
Advanced plans such as 20:4, 24-hour, and 36-hour fasts are available for experienced users seeking deeper metabolic and longevity benefits.
DESIGNED FOR SIMPLICITY
A clean and intuitive interface makes fasting easy and enjoyable.
An iOS widget shows your current fasting status directly on your home screen.
Apple Health integration allows you to keep all your health data in one place.
Download Fasting Guru to get started for free and unlock full access to all features, premium content, and your personalized fasting plan with a subscription.
Believe in yourself. Stay consistent. Everything is achievable.

bluejetty:00024899:ios.description:
Hello History, you can travel back in time and have one-on-one chat conversations with some of the most influential historical figures of all time
Who Hello History is for?
- History Teachers eager to enrich their classrooms
- School Principals seeking innovative learning tools
- History Buffs craving deeper connections with the past
- Parents wanting to increase their kids' interest in history 
- Anyone who's always wanted to "meet" historical figures
Key Features:
- Authentic Conversations with AI Historical Figures
- Curated Topics for Tailored Learning
- Easy-to-Use Interface
- Regular Updates with New Figures
- Multi-disciplinary Focus: Art, Science, Philosophy, and more
Why Hello History?
Unearth the wisdom of ages with Hello History! Engage in riveting 
one-on-one chats with AI versions of history's most iconic figures. 
State-of-the-art GPT-4 AI technology makes each interaction uniquely 
authentic.
Broaden Your Horizons
From art and music to justice and pop music history, pick the brain of your favorite genius in a myriad of disciplines. It's not just a history lesson; it's a fresh perspective on life itself!
Elevate Your Teaching
For educators, it’s like having a co-teacher from the annals of history! Enhance your students' engagement and understanding by integrating these AI-generated conversations into your curriculum.
 Highly Advanced, Yet User-Friendly
Even if you're not tech-savvy, the intuitive UI makes it easy to navigate conversations. And for AI fans, witness the marvel of GPT-4 technology in action.
Immerse yourself in the minds of the greats and gain new insights and perspectives on life, history, and the world around us with the help of AI chat.
Whether you're interested in learning more about art, music, justice, literature, philosophy, science, technology, or even military strategy, Hello History has a wide range of historical figures to choose from. You can have a chat with AI versions of many famous historical figures.
It's like having a private tutor with the greatest people of the past.
How it works: The app uses state-of-the-art (GPT-4) AI technology to bring these figures to life and make the conversations feel authentic. Each conversation is completely unique. Don't trust everything the AI generates. The facts should be validated.
Enhance your knowledge of history and gain a new perspective on life by downloading Hello History today. Open up a conversation with anyone from the past, and who knows where it may take you!
P.S. New figures are added all the time, so you’ll never run out of interesting people to talk to.
The SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
Hello History offers three auto-renewing subscription options:
1. Weekly
2. Month
3. Yearly
Subscription unlocks extra messages to historical figures.
You can send up to 10'000 messages per month if you are subscribed. Pricing per country may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term and you will be charged through your iTunes account. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
Read more about the privacy policy:
https://sites.google.com/view/hello-history-terms/privacy-policy
Read more about the terms of usage:
https://sites.google.com/view/hello-history-terms/home

Introducing KAIJU NO. 8 THE GAME
===========================
Based on the global hit anime, adapted from the Shonen Jump+ sensation, KAIJU NO. 8 THE GAME brings you into the heart of the action! Witness epic battles between the Japan Anti-Kaiju Defense Force and cataclysmic Kaiju, all rendered in breathtaking graphics!

Engage in an intuitive turn-based combat system, packed with strategic depth! Select your Defense Force officers' skills to attack, and when the Kaiju's core is exposed, unleash devastating ultimate attacks to deliver the final blow!
◆ See the Defense Force in action in stunning details!
Feel the raw power of KAIJU NO. 8's signature punch, the razor-sharp precision of Soshiro Hoshina's blades, and the earth-shattering power of Kikoru Shinomiya's ax! All brought to life with stunning, high-end graphics!
◆ Explore the expanding universe of KAIJU NO. 8!
Relive the anime's gripping story, discover exclusive original narratives, and delve into the untold stories of your favorite characters!
◆ Featuring an all-star voice actor cast!

bluejetty:00077420:ios.description:
Playing Word Explorer for 10 minutes a day helps you relax and sharpens your mind.
This word game is an incredibly fun and challenging game. Enjoy a modern and relaxing word search game. This game combines anagrams and crosswords into a challenging word search game.
Challenge yourself to connect the letters and find as many hidden words as you can. Enjoy the beautiful backgrounds, improve your vocabulary and relax while sharpening your mind.
Unlike crossword puzzles games or word scramble games or word cross games, all words in Word Explorer are uncrossed, without any logical connection that can give you hints to help you solve the levels. 
Word Explorer has many levels and is both challenging and relaxing. Play this word game once and you will play it over and over again. If you enjoy anagrams, word search games and puzzles this fun game is a must for you!
HOW TO PLAY
• Connect the letters and find the hidden words.
• Swipe the letters to connect them.
• Use hints if you are stuck.
• Find bonus words for extra coins!
FEATURES
• Free to play!
• Improve your vocabulary and sharpen your mind.
• Relaxing word game and beautiful graphics.
• These anagram puzzles start easy but get harder as you progress!
• Play each level at your own pace. Just relax and have fun!
• Play anywhere at any time. Can be played offline.
• Multiple language support.
Pack your bags and get ready to explore new words. Boost your vocabulary and start playing Word Explorer today! It is a fantastic game for those who enjoy crossword, word search, anagram, and word puzzle games.
Thank you for playing!

bluejetty:00185438:ios.description:
This Paris guide is completely free and has been created by the Civitatis team, the leading company in the sale of guided tours, excursions, and free tours in English all over the world. So you can guess what you'll find there: all the tourist information you need to make the most of your trip to Paris, with a perfect combination of cultural, sightseeing, and entertainment options. 
You'll also find in this Paris guide practical information that will help you organize your trip to Paris, as well as tips and advice to make the most of your time in Paris. What to see in Paris? Where to eat, where to sleep? What are the places you really have to visit? Any tips to save money? Our Paris guide will answer all these and more.
The most interesting sections of this free guide to Paris are:
• General information: Learn how to plan your trip to Paris and find out what is the necessary documentation to visit it, what is the weather like at the time you're traveling, or what are the opening hours of its stores.
• What to see: Discover the main attractions in Paris, as well as practical information on how to visit these tourist spots, how to get there, opening hours, closing days, prices, etc.
• Where to eat: Learn more about the most traditional dishes in France and the best places to sample them in Paris. And why not do it for the best price? We tell you the best places to eat on a budget in Paris.
• Where to stay: Are you looking for a quiet neighborhood to rest or a lively one to party until dawn? Our free travel guide will let you know in which area you should look for your accommodation in Paris.
• Transport: Find out how to get around Paris and which are the best ways to move around depending on your budget or your time.
• Shopping: Get the perfect souvenirs and save time and money by knowing in advance which are the best areas to go shopping in Paris.
• Map: The most comprehensive map of Paris, where you can see all the must-see sights, where to eat, the best area to book your hotel, or the neighborhood with the greatest and liveliest atmosphere in Paris.
• Activities: With our Paris guide, you can also book the best Civitatis activities for your trip. Guided tours, excursions, tickets, free tours... Everything to fill your trip!
We know that when you're traveling, there's no time to waste. And even more, when there are so many things to do in Paris. That's why, with this free travel guide, we want to help you fill your trip to Paris. Have a blast and enjoy your vacation!
P.S. The information and tips in this guide were written by and for travelers and were collected on January 2023. If you find any inaccuracies or find something you think we should change, please contact us (https://www.civitatis.com/en/contact/).

bluejetty:00186521:ios.summary:
Harness the power of a scientifically proven 4-in-1 speech therapy app that boosts reading, writing, speaking, and listening in people with aphasia. Whether you’re recovering from a stroke or brain injury, Language Therapy can help.
TRY TH
bluejetty:00186521:ios.description:
Harness the power of a scientifically proven 4-in-1 speech therapy app that boosts reading, writing, speaking, and listening in people with aphasia. Whether you’re recovering from a stroke or brain injury, Language Therapy can help.
TRY THIS APP FOR FREE!
Language Therapy Lite is a free sample of the activities found in the full version of Language Therapy. You’ll get 5-7 exercises in each activity to see if this is the right app for you.
STUDIES SHOW… IT WORKS!
Struggling with language can feel like being trapped in your own mind. But there’s an answer. Research at the University of Cambridge showed improvement in every single participant with chronic aphasia who used this app for 20 minutes a day over 4 weeks. Get real results that last.*
- Overcome aphasia and boost language skills with a proven app designed by experts
- Enhance speech therapy with countless activities that are perfect for clinical and home use 
- Learn in 5 languages: US or UK English, Spanish, German, French
- Get a toolkit that’s faster and more adaptable than photo cards, letter tiles, and other therapy aids
- Use score reports and adjustable options to seamlessly fit the app into your therapy program
- Fully customize your activities by adding your own words, pictures, prompts, or sounds
- No subscriptions, ever – our best-selling app will always be there when you need it
** THERE’S NO BETTER TIME TO START. Try it now for FREE with Language Therapy Lite! **
HERE’S WHAT YOU GET IN ONE EASY PACKAGE:
COMPREHENSION THERAPY – IMPROVE YOUR UNDERSTANDING 
Build listening and reading comprehension skills for nouns, verbs, and adjectives. Take the first step in your aphasia recovery with an app that automatically adjusts difficulty based on performance. 
3 ACTIVITIES: Listen | Read | Listen & Read
NAMING THERAPY – FIND THE RIGHT WORDS 
Practice naming and improve word-finding skills. In 4 activities, you do everything from naming the things you see to describing their features, all with cues and hints to guide you. Build independence by learning strategies to communicate your thoughts and needs.
4 ACTIVITIES: Naming Practice | Describe | Naming Test | Flashcards
READING THERAPY – TAKE YOUR READING TO THE NEXT LEVEL 
Strengthen literacy with phrase and sentence exercises in an app that’s perfect for independent practice. Improve attention to detail, practice oral reading, and build on the single words of Comprehension Therapy as you move toward the more advanced reading skills needed for independent living.
4 ACTIVITIES: Phrase Matching | Phrase Completion | Sentence Matching | Sentence Completion
WRITING THERAPY – BOOST YOUR SPELLING SKILLS 
Improve spelling ability by practicing completing and building the words you hear and see. Pick letters from a limited choice or full alphabet, then place and rearrange them at will for an intuitive and challenging experience. The perfect spelling practice is waiting.
4 ACTIVITIES: Fill in the Blank | Copy | Spell What You See | Spell What You Hear
IN ALL 4 OF LANGUAGE THERAPY’S APPS, YOU GET:
- 700+ core nouns, verbs, and adjectives that run throughout all 4 apps
- Thousands of exercises for countless hours of practice
- Recommendations on what to do next based on your score
- Activities for people struggling with aphasia after stroke or brain injury, autism, or just learning a new language
- Simple, distraction-free interfaces that are easy to use for all ages and abilities
- No subscriptions, no monthly bills, no Wi-Fi needed
WHY WASTE YOUR TIME ON APPS THAT DON’T WORK? Download Language Therapy and watch the improvement begin.
Looking for something different in a speech therapy app? Find the right apps for you at tactustherapy.com/find
*Every person and every brain is different. Your results may vary.

bluejetty:00024567:ios.description:
Introducing the Smart Gallery Photo Viewer and Gallery Video Viewer – your gateway to an unlimited world of captivating memories. Imagine effortlessly showcasing your cherished photos and videos to friends and beyond, all with a touch of elegance and security. 
Embrace the magic of the Gallery for Photos & Video app, your ultimate haven for preserving and admiring visuals. Unlike any other, this app brings your images and videos together under one virtual roof. With a touch of your fingers, organize, enhance, and share your digital treasures with flair.
Unveil the secret to guarding your memories with the Gallery Lock feature. Encrypt your images and videos, allowing you to keep your personal collection hidden from prying eyes. It's your very own digital vault.
Experience the HD Gallery – a place where your snapshots come to life, beautifully framed in albums. Be the curator of your own world, selecting the best shots and storing them in enigmatic envelopes, ready to be revealed at your command.
Step into the realm of the Gallery Explorer, where your photographs are no longer scattered across devices but are instead woven into artistic albums that tell your unique story. Dive into the slick gallery view, seamlessly navigating through your memories with grace.
But that's not all. Picture this: a Gallery 3D that dances to the rhythm of your preferences. Organize your cherished photos, arrange them based on your whims, and instantly access them with just a tap.
Features abound in this Gallery Symphony:
- Craft mesmerizing photo albums that adapt to your device's orientation.
- Capture candid moments with a selfie camera designed for photo albums.
- Effortlessly exclude and restore folders at your command.
- Immerse yourself in an endless slideshow of HD Gallery for photos, with animations that mesmerize.
- Seamlessly move, copy, and paste files, all with a swift multi-select.
- Elevate your photos with Beauty Camera Effects, turning ordinary moments into masterpieces.
- Let your personality shine by customizing the theme color – your Gallery, your rules.
- No need to settle – switch colors and themes as you please.
- Your photos and videos in their full glory, supported across all popular formats.
- Dive deep into your visuals with intuitive zoom gestures.
- And don't forget the Video Player with Gallery apps:
Embrace a unified video experience with support for all formats.
Bask in the glory of the finest video player for your galleries.
Seamlessly manage and enjoy all your videos, without a hitch.
Immerse yourself in the world of beautifully designed HD video playback.
Photos, your way:
Explore a limitless video grid, each frame more mesmerizing than the last.
Zoom, crop, and enhance with picture filters to reveal unseen details.
Personalize your photos by renaming and editing to perfection.
Effortlessly share your visual stories on social media, a tap away.
Order and sort your memories as you desire, to relive them your way.
Present your photos in an appearance that exudes professionalism.
Safety first with the Gallery Lock:
----------
Gallery terms of service
1 week Gallery+ from 4.99$ per week (prices may vary slightly depending on the region).
1 month Gallery + from 19.99$ per month (prices may vary slightly depending on the region)

bluejetty:00071190:ios.description:
تطبيق ختمة هو وسيلة مبتكرة تساعدك على تلاوة القرآن الكريم بانتظام حتى تتمكن من ختمه وفق جدول زمني يناسبك. يتيح لك التطبيق تحديد المدة التي ترغب في ختم المصحف خلالها، ويقوم بتقسيم وردك اليومي بطريقة منظمة تسهّل عليك الالتزام بالقراءة دون انقطاع. كما يوفّر تنبيهات يومية لتذكيرك بوردك في الوقت الذي تختاره، مما يساعدك على الحفاظ على استمرارية التلاوة.
يتميز التطبيق بتصميم بسيط وسهل الاستخدام، مما يجعله مناسبًا للجميع، سواء كنت ترغب في ختم المصحف خلال شهر رمضان، أو على مدار العام. كما أنه يوفر إمكانية تتبع تقدمك في القراءة، مما يمنحك حافزًا للاستمرار حتى تحقيق هدفك. يهدف التطبيق إلى تشجيع المستخدمين على تعزيز علاقتهم بالقرآن الكريم من خلال تجربة تفاعلية مريحة تساعدهم على التلاوة بانتظام دون الشعور بالإرهاق أو التقصير.
يعد ختم القرآن من الأعمال العظيمة التي يسعى الكثيرون لتحقيقها، ومع تطبيق ختمة، يمكنك الوصول إلى هذا الهدف بسهولة وبطريقة منظمة تتناسب مع إيقاع حياتك اليومية.
يعد ختم القرآن الكريم هدفًا يسعى إليه الكثير من المسلمين، سواء خلال شهر رمضان المبارك أو في أي وقت من العام، لما فيه من بركة وأجر عظيم. ومع ضغوط الحياة اليومية والانشغالات المستمرة، قد يجد البعض صعوبة في الالتزام بورد ثابت يمكنهم من ختم المصحف وفق جدول زمني محدد. من هنا يأتي تطبيق "ختمة" ليكون رفيقك الأمثل في رحلتك مع القرآن، حيث يساعدك على التلاوة بانتظام وفق خطة تناسب وقتك وإمكاناتك، دون أن تشعر بالضغط أو التقصير.
يتيح لك التطبيق تحديد المدة التي تريد أن تختم فيها المصحف، سواء خلال أسبوع، شهر، ثلاثة أشهر أو أكثر، ليقوم بعد ذلك بحساب مقدار الورد اليومي الذي تحتاج إلى قراءته. بهذه الطريقة، يصبح الالتزام بالقراءة اليومية أكثر سهولة، حيث يتم تقسيم التلاوة إلى أجزاء صغيرة ومنظمة، مما يجعلك تستمر دون انقطاع حتى تصل إلى هدفك المنشود.
ولا يقتصر دور التطبيق على تقسيم الورد اليومي فحسب، بل يعمل أيضًا على تقديم تذكيرات يومية لتنبيهك بوقت القراءة الذي تحدده، حتى لا تفوتك التلاوة في زحام يومك. كما يمكنك اختيار وقت التنبيه الذي يناسبك، سواء في الصباح الباكر، بعد الصلوات، أو قبل النوم، مما يضمن لك أقصى درجات الراحة والمرونة في الالتزام.
يتميز التطبيق بتصميم بسيط وسهل الاستخدام، مما يجعله مثاليًا لجميع الفئات العمرية، سواء كنت مبتدئًا في القراءة أو معتادًا على التلاوة اليومية. كما يوفر تجربة سلسة لا تتطلب مجهودًا كبيرًا، حيث يمكنك متابعة تقدمك بسهولة ومعرفة مقدار ما أنجزته وما تبقى لك حتى تتم الختمة، مما يمنحك دافعًا مستمرًا للاستمرار.
إضافة إلى ذلك، يوفر التطبيق ميزات أخرى مفيدة، مثل عرض الآيات بتلاوة صوتية لمساعدتك على القراءة الصحيحة، وإمكانية تفعيل الوضع الليلي لتوفير راحة أكبر عند القراءة في الإضاءة المنخفضة. كما يدعم عدة لغات لتسهيل الاستخدام على جميع المسلمين في مختلف أنحاء العالم.
يعد "ختمة" أكثر من مجرد تطبيق، فهو بمثابة رفيق روحاني يساعدك على تحقيق هدفك في ختم القرآن بطريقة منظمة وسهلة، دون الحاجة إلى التخطيط الشخصي أو القلق بشأن تقسيم الأجزاء. كل ما عليك فعله هو تحديد المدة التي ترغب بها، وترك التطبيق يتولى الباقي، بينما تستمتع بتجربة قراءة ممتعة ومثمرة.
مع تطبيق "ختمة"، يمكنك تحقيق حلمك في ختم المصحف الشريف بانتظام، مهما كانت انشغالاتك اليومية. اجعل القرآن جزءًا لا يتجزأ من حياتك، وابدأ اليوم رحلتك نحو الختمة بكل سهولة ويسر.

- Enjoy the app without the interruption of any ads.

Your subscription will automatically renew each month 24-hours before the end of the current period, and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

يعد "ختمة" أكثر من مجرد تطبيق، فهو بمثابة رفيق روحاني يساعدك على تحقيق هدفك في ختم القرآن بطريقة منظمة وسهلة، دون الحاجة إلى التخطيط الشخصي أو القلق بشأن تقسيم الأجزاء. كل ما عليك فعله هو تحديد المدة التي ترغب بها، وترك التطبيق يتولى الباقي، بينما تستمتع بتجربة قراءة ممتعة ومثمرة.
مع تطبيق "ختمة"، يمكنك تحقيق حلمك في ختم المصحف الشريف بانتظام، مهما كانت انشغالاتك اليومية. اجعل القرآن جزءًا لا يتجزأ من حياتك، وابدأ اليوم رحلتك نحو الختمة بكل سهولة ويسر.

bluejetty:00095501:android.description:
Start in chill, build at will
A cold wave is sweeping across the Three Kingdoms. The lovely refugee girl, Xiao Zhen, stands by, rubbing her hands and watching you expectantly…
Let’s build a bonfire, gather your brothers and sisters, and start chopping wood to build your home together! My Lord, with Xiao Zhen by your side, conquering the Three Kingdoms has never been more relaxing, play smart and win with ease!
[Rescue Refugees—Light a Bonfire for Warmth and Friendship]
Refugees quickly become a hardworking team! Manage them easily with the new Morale System: assign jobs, handle various resident events to boost morale, and unlock special skills that make your settlement more efficient!
[Friends at Work—Team Up for Greater Success]
Invite your friends with our innovative Guest Worker system! Bring your buddies into the city to help out. Daily interactions boost your friendship and their productivity, building your dream city has never been more fun or effective.
[Gather Resources, Build Your City—Easy and Relaxed]
Cut trees, mine, and hunt to gather resources, build houses, barracks and more. Expand your territory step by step, recruit new troops, and strengthen your forces so you’re always ready for war!
[Casual Gameplay—Enjoy a Fun Twist on the Three Kingdoms]
Enjoy a variety of mini-games! Test your wits in the Clash of Steeds challenge, optimize your strategies in resource escort and raids, and experience the Three Kingdoms in a fresh, immersive way.
[Boss Battles—Form Powerful Teams with Legendary Heroes]
Log in for 7 days to receive powerful SSR Heroes like Diao Chan and Guo Jia! Upgrading heroes is easy. Everyone shares in the level-up benefits, so there’s no hassle over resource allocation. Build a powerful team, use auto-expedition to take on World Bosses anytime, and keep collecting resources even while offline!
[Expand Territory—Conquer the Land with Ease]
Join alliances to siege cities and heal injured troops with just one tap, even when you’re offline, allies can manage your teams for you. World conquest is simple. No need to grind endlessly! Rally your like-minded friends, expand your alliance, and compete to become Asia’s strongest leader in the Three Kingdoms!

listings.description:

조선일보 앱은 꾸준한 업데이트를 통해 독자 여러분께 신속하고 정확한 뉴스를 전달합니다.

1등 신문이 1등 혜택을 모았습니다. 조선멤버십에 가입하면 아래 주요 혜택을 비롯한 30여가지 프리미엄 혜택을 누릴 수 있습니다.
- 멤버십 전용 콘텐츠: 기존 조선닷컴에서 볼 수 없었던 새로운 뉴스 콘텐츠, 심층 취재, 영상 등 멤버십 회원만을 위한 독점 콘텐츠를 열람할 수 있습니다. 
- 멤버십 전용 디지털 신문·잡지 서비스: 조선일보 및 맛있는 한자, 월간·주간 조선, 월간 산 등 코노미 조선 등 잡지 디지털 콘텐츠 8종을 열람할 수 있습니다. 
- 현금처럼 쓸 수 있는 포인트: 멤버십 가입과 동시에 7000 포인트가 적립됩니다. 조선멤버십몰에서 현금처럼 쓰거나 포인트 후원, 게임, 이벤트 등 서비스에서 활용할 수 있습니다.

- 기존 신문 구독자는 독자회원 인증 과정을 거치면 조선멤버십 월정기구독형 상품을 할인된 가격으로 구독하실 수 있습니다. 기존 신문구독자의 멤버십 구독가는 1개월 단위 정기 결제금액 ￦2,900/1개월 또는 1년 단위 연결제 ￦27,500/1년 입니다.

bluejetty:00166314:ios.summary:
Stay one step ahead of severe weather. WeatherWise delivers original, full-resolution radar straight from the source, with official alerts, forecast models and live storm chasers.
Powering top YouTube weather channels, such as Ryan Hall.
bluejetty:00166314:ios.description:
Stay one step ahead of severe weather. WeatherWise delivers original, full-resolution radar straight from the source, with official alerts, forecast models and live storm chasers.
Powering top YouTube weather channels, such as Ryan Hall.
NEW: Take WeatherWise on the road using Apple CarPlay
• Free: live radar and warning areas on your car's display
• Plus: navigation that knows the weather (10 trips a month). See how many alerts are on each route before you set off, how far ahead each one is, and hear them called out as you approach
• Pro: 30 trips a month, spoken hail size, wind gusts and tornado status, storm-path callouts with arrival times, and Tornado ID
CORE FEATURES (ALWAYS FREE & AD-FREE)
• Real-Time Radar, plus super-res storm-relative velocity and rotation in the US
• Push Alerts: official warnings for your location in the US and Canada, with Critical Alerts for tornado, hurricane and tsunami warnings
• Alerts & Outlooks: NWS, Environment Canada, 38 European countries and Israel, plus SPC, WPC and CPC outlooks
• Radar History: replay US radar archives back to 1991
• Home-Screen Radar Widgets and the WeatherWise Home dashboard
• Forecast Models: HRRR, GFS, ECMWF, ensembles, AI models and more, with soundings
• Satellite: GOES, Himawari, Meteosat and VIIRS
• Hurricane Tools: spaghetti models, NHC cones and recent Hurricane Hunter recon
• Storm Tracks, Lightning (Americas), Local Storm Reports and a storm-track drawing tool with arrival times
• Ground Truth: live streams from 40+ storm chasers, Hazcams, traffic cameras and the Spotter Network
• Live Weather Stations, air quality and smoke, winter precipitation type and snowfall
• 2,000 Custom Locations (free WeatherWise account required)
WEATHERWISE PLUS
• 3D Radar, 3D Satellite and Globe view
• Split View: two maps side by side
• Adjustable smoothing for radar, satellite, composites and models
• Enhanced Lightning Data
• Settings Sync across devices
• Play up to 100 radar scans and 12 runs per model
• Past warnings, discussions and storm tracks in Radar History
• Premium widgets with US warnings
• Y'all Mode: Ryan Hall's map and radar style, with Y'all Watches, Y'all-O-Meter, Y'all Tracks and Outlooks
WEATHERWISE PRO (EVERYTHING IN PLUS, AND)
• Tornado ID (Beta): AI-powered tornado detection on US radar
• Radar Wind Particles: animated wind from US and Canadian radar
• FastScan: ultra low-latency US radar scans
• Triple/Quad View: 3 maps on iPhone, 4 on iPad
• Expert Mode: pair radar, satellite or composite on one screen
• Realtime radar and model cross sections
• Reflectivity X, Max Reflectivity and Min CC (debris) on US radar
• Flash a custom reflectivity range
• Population and impact reports for alerts and discussions
• Play up to 200 radar scans, 100 satellite frames and 24 runs per model
• Historical satellite (to 2017) and model runs (HRRR to 2014)
• Pro widgets with velocity, CC and lightning
Radar coverage: USA, Canada, Belgium, Croatia, Cyprus, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Iceland, Ireland, Israel, Lithuania, Malta, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, South Korea, Spain, Sweden and Switzerland, plus UK, Italy and Europe-wide composites.
We believe staying safe should be accessible to all. Our core features are completely free and always free from ads.
Subscription Details
Payment will be charged to your account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage your subscription from "Manage Subscription" in the menu.
Download WeatherWise today and safeguard your loved ones and property. Follow us @wxwiseapp for the latest updates.
Fast & Reliable; Stay WeatherWise.
See our EULA (Terms of Service): https://www.weatherwise.app/eula.html
Find out how we collect and store your data in our Privacy Policy: https://www.weatherwise.app/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00042497:ios.description:
Keep the words that move you.
Save quotes from books, e-readers, articles, podcasts and conversations in seconds. Then see them again every day on your Home Screen and Lock Screen.
The line you underlined. The one from the podcast. The screenshot you'll never find again. Quotify keeps them all in one beautiful place, and brings them back when you need them most.
MEET QUOTIFY 2
A fresh new design, quotes from any photo, and new ways to choose which quotes you see each day.
• Smart Photo to Quote, free for everyone: snap a book page or e-reader screen, or choose a photo or screenshot. Quotify finds the quote and author. No retyping
• On supported devices, Smart Photo to Quote can use Apple's Private Cloud Compute to read tougher pages. Your photo is used only for that request, isn't stored, and isn't accessible to Apple
• A fresh new design, with cleaner quote rows and Liquid Glass controls
• Choose which quotes your widgets and daily reminders show: everything, just your Favorites, or a single author (Premium)
SAVE IT THE MOMENT YOU HEAR IT
• Add a quote your way: Record, Paste or Photo
• Snap a book page or e-reader screen, or choose a screenshot, and keep just the words
• Speak a quote and Quotify turns it into text
• Share from Safari and other apps. Sharing a Safari page keeps its link and title
• Share an Instagram post to Quotify to save the quote from its image
• Save new quotes with a Shortcuts action
• Pick a past author in one tap while you edit
A QUOTE A DAY, RIGHT WHERE YOU LOOK
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show quotes from your own library and update the moment you add, edit or delete one
• Widgets look right on tinted and clear Home Screens, and Text Size changes the quote size
• Put your own photo behind your Home Screen widget (Premium)
• Daily reminders at the times you choose, as many as you like, bring a quote to you even on days you forget to look (Premium)
SHARE THE LINES THAT MOVE YOU
• A new Share Quote sheet with Story, Square and Wide sizes and an accent color
• Share your quotes as images to Instagram Stories and other apps
• Share a quote as an image over a photo of your own (Premium)
FIND ANY QUOTE IN SECONDS
• Search your library, filter by any field, and sort by newest, author or quote
• Organize quotes with your own fields, with suggestions as you type (Premium)
• Find quotes by text or author from Spotlight and Siri
• Links saved with a quote show as a website name you can tap to open
YOUR WORDS, YOUR DATA
• No account to create
• Keep the author and source link with every quote
• Export your library to CSV or a backup file, and import it back, anytime (Premium)
• Private backup and sync across your devices with iCloud (Premium), and see your sync status in Settings
AND SO MUCH MORE
• Ready for iPhone Duo
• A short welcome tour, which you can replay from Settings
QUOTIFY PREMIUM
Free includes up to 25 quotes, Smart Photo to Quote, Home and Lock Screen widgets, adding quotes by Record, Paste or Photo, marking Favorites, sharing quotes as images, and search, filter and sort. Premium adds:
• Unlimited quotes
• Private backup and sync with iCloud
• Choose which quotes rotate through your widgets and reminders, like just your Favorites
• Organize quotes with your own fields
• Your own photos behind widgets and share images
• Daily quote reminders
• Import and export anytime
Choose Monthly or Annual, each with a 1-week free trial for new subscribers, or a one-time Lifetime purchase.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings.
Privacy policy: https://quotify.to/privacy
Terms of use: https://quotify.to/terms

• Custom Views: filter trends by time, category, and source type
• Instant Trend Alerts: receive real-time notifications as stories break and climb the rankings
• Effortless Interface: enjoy an ultra-intuitive, award-winning design with no setup or learning curve
Content is culture. Break The Web is the best way to keep up with it.
