bluejetty:00049213:android.summary:
Zypp Electric, we're on a Mission Zero Emission by accelerating the EV adoption in Last Mile and building a Sustainable Future while creating the Largest Electric Shared Mobility EV-as-a-Service Platform.
As priority 1, we at Zypp Electric
bluejetty:00049213:android.description:
Zypp Electric, we're on a Mission Zero Emission by accelerating the EV adoption in Last Mile and building a Sustainable Future while creating the Largest Electric Shared Mobility EV-as-a-Service Platform.
As priority 1, we at Zypp Electric are on a mission to solve pollution by making same day deliveries go electric. Idea is to disrupt and transform the future of logistics with right EVs, IOT, Charging infrastructure, AI, ML Technology for thousands of hyperlocal stores as well as large e-retail customers. In essence, we're building the largest EV Logistics ecosystem in India and beyond.
Vision: Zypp's vision is to build the Largest Full Stack 
Asset Light, Tech Enabled Shared Electric Mobility (eMaaS) Platform making delivery, mobility affordable and sustainable.
Mission Zero Emission in India by 2030.
ZYPP Electric is in the Electric Mobility space with a mission to "Make all Last Mile Go Electric". It serves several large partners with Electric Vehicles (2W) and trained riders to reduce the carbon footprint in the country and is making deliveries affordable and eco-friendly. The e-scooters are IOT powered which can be GPS tracked and locked/unlocked by scanning QR code using this App. Our services include E-Scooters Rentals, Last Mile Delivery and much more.
Get Rental Scooters: Pick & Drop any e-scooter by taking it on rent from Zypp Electric Hubs which are spread across the city on affordable rental plans and switch from fuel to EVs
Get Essentials Delivered: We at Zypp are serving the clients to deliver the daily essentials, such as vegetables, medicines, dairy, groceries and more at your doorstep within minutes.
Get Food Delivered: With online delivery across many cities, get your food delivered along with improving the quality of air with the use of Electric Vehicles for delivery.
Carbon Free Deliveries: Zypp using Electric Vehicle for Last Mile Deliveries to reduce the carbon footprint in the environment and making it more eco-friendly. Each order delivered through Zypp, contributes to the cleaner environment.
Intending to deliver Happiness (Parcel delivery, food delivery, medicine delivery, Grocery Delivery and more) we work with the motto of Khushiyon Ki Delivery for our clients, merchants & our riders whom we call as Zypp Pilots.
Zypp e-scooter rental plan - How it works:
1. Download the app: Login with your credentials and verify by OTP
2. Update KYC: Validate KYC with your Aadhar card and Driver's License
3. Scan Scooter: Go to nearest Zypp hub and scan scooter to avail the plan
4. Choose Rental Plan: Deposit Security amount (Refundable) and Rental plan via App
5. Extend Plan: Extend plan as per usage on the app before expiry
6. Scooter Deposit: After usage, deposit scooter back to the Zypp hub only and get security amount refunded after deduction of any extra breakage or usage charges
Our services are available in Gurgaon, Noida, Delhi, Ghaziabad, and expanding fast to more cities in India. 
We have attractive B2B plans to grow your business by hiring our end to end last mile delivery with a dedicated rider along with e-bike option. To get Delivery services or to know more about Zypp, please send an email at help@zypp.app or visit www.zypp.app
Zypp is building the Future of shared electric mobility which is connected, affordable & electric. Zypp Electric - Mission Zero Emission.
Use code: ZYPPTEN to get your 10% OFF on your 1st Rental plan.

• ON EVERY DEVICE: easy synchronization across multiple devices and platforms!
Learn more about the game and stay in the loop!

bluejetty:00186478:ios.description:
Ready to have real conversations? Mango Languages prioritizes real language, real culture, and real progress. Our comprehensive learning platform offers conversational language lessons in 70+ languages, teaching vocabulary, pronunciation, grammar, and culture simultaneously.
From preparing for vacation or working abroad, to personal development and academic growth, our language courses are designed to take you wherever you wish to go.
HOW DOES MANGO WORK?
Learn languages from native speakers with courses that feature thousands of real recordings.
Enhance comprehension with interactive listening and reading activities and bolster your learning with personalized daily reviews.
Refine speaking skills with phonetic spellings, natural and slow pronunciations, and our pronunciation comparison tool.
Sync progress across all platforms and NO ADS, so you can learn anywhere, at any time, with no distractions.
WHY CHOOSE MANGO?
Practical, Authentic Content: The outcome of using Mango is the ability to speak and communicate in real conversations.
Linguist-Approved Language Courses: Each course is designed by expert linguists to provide high-quality instruction that produces real results.
Placement Tests: Not sure where to start? Use our placement tests in select languages to identify the best starting point.
Individualized Review: Our intelligent review system helps you retain knowledge through spaced repetition and adapts to your progress.
Practice with Flashcards: Supercharge your vocabulary with built-in flashcards or take it a step further and create your own lists!
On-The-Go Learning: Download lessons to your phone for offline access and take advantage of our hands-free audio feature!
HOW CAN I START?
When you sign up, you can find free access through a subscribing organization, like a public library, or you can subscribe with a 14-day free trial. Cancel at any time.
Serious about language learning? Our paid subscriptions include: 
Individual Plan: Access to all of our languages in one learning profile.
Family Plan: Access to all of our languages for you and up to five additional family members.

bluejetty:00135339:ios.name: Moonlight Blade
bluejetty:00135339:ios.summary: Moonlight Blade Mobile is a fascinating open world MMORPG in the traditional Chinese style. The game presents a magnificent world of martial arts, containing a different combination of techniques and features, with high-quality art technolo
bluejetty:00135339:ios.description:
Moonlight Blade Mobile is a fascinating open world MMORPG in the traditional Chinese style. The game presents a magnificent world of martial arts, containing a different combination of techniques and features, with high-quality art technology, so that every blade of grass, every tree, hills and clouds are in front of your eyes.
12 unique schools, with their own characteristics and advantages in PVP and PVE games. There are many professions in the game to help you develop and improve: cooking, fishing, hunting, etc. You also expect a variety of images and the opportunity to create a unique appearance for your hero, up to 600 character customization!
=====Features=====
■ Multiplayer Games ■
One of the highlights of Moonlight Blade Mobile is its robust multiplayer feature. Join forces with friends and form powerful guilds to conquer challenging raids and take down formidable bosses. Coordinate your strategies and unleash devastating combos to dominate the battlefield. With real-time player interaction, you can team up with players from around the world and forge new friendships in the virtual realm.
■ PVP Multiplayer■ 
PVP enthusiasts will find Moonlight Blade Mobile to be a haven for competitive gameplay. Engage in thrilling arena battles and prove your skills as the ultimate warrior. Participate in intense guild wars, where strategic coordination and teamwork are essential for victory. Rise to the top of the leaderboards and earn exclusive rewards, fame, and recognition.
Compete against renowned warriors from around the world in a PVP system.
A combat system that gives you the freedom to continuously combine skills. Support for a variety of PVP formats including 1 on 1 or 5 on 5 groups, including Guild Wars and Battle Royale modes that stand out from other open world MMORPG formats.
■ AAA Graphics ■ 
The graphics of Moonlight Blade Mobile are nothing short of breathtaking. The meticulously designed world is filled with stunning landscapes, detailed character models, and breathtaking special effects. Each battle is brought to life with smooth animations and dynamic combat mechanics, making every encounter a visually stunning spectacle.
Picturesque weather with four seasons - spring, summer, autumn and winter.
Full HD when playing on a computer with a refresh rate of up to 120Hz.
■ Customization ■ 
Customization options are abundant in Moo

bluejetty:00187168:ios.name: Mileage AutoTrack: Swift Miles
bluejetty:00187168:ios.summary: Swift Miles automatically tracks every trip so you never miss a mile — or a tax deduction. Remove the hassle of manual logging, and simplify your logbook. Perfect for ride-share drivers, contractors, freelancers, and small business owners.
bluejetty:00187168:ios.description:
Swift Miles automatically tracks every trip so you never miss a mile — or a tax deduction. Remove the hassle of manual logging, and simplify your logbook. Perfect for ride-share drivers, contractors, freelancers, and small business owners.
Our AI-powered app automatically tracks your mileage in real time with efficient battery use, ensuring you never miss a trip or potential deduction. Save time and money with hassle-free trip logging and detailed tax reports!
Key Benefits 
- Automatic Trip Detection 
Our AI technology automatically detects and logs your trips, so you don’t have to worry about missing any. Just start driving, and Swift Miles will handle the rest in the background.
- Seamless Mileage Tracking 
Mileage is accurately tracked for every trip you take, with no manual input required. Keep the app running in the background, and we’ll do the work for you! 
- Maximize IRS Tax Deductions 
Swift Miles uses the latest IRS mileage rates to calculate deductions automatically. Easily create and send trip deduction reports in PDF or CSV formats with just one tap. 
- Accurate Route Maps 
Swift Miles provides precise route mapping for every trip you take, so you have a detailed record of your journeys. 
- Smart Auto-Classification Automatically classify trips as Business, Charity, Medical, or Personal based on your usage patterns. You can even customize classifications for added convenience.
- Expense Tracking with Receipts 
Easily track your trip-related expenses, including fuel and tolls, and attach image receipts directly within the app. 
- Custom Reports for Taxes 
Generate detailed, IRS-ready reports with a single tap. Swift Miles simplifies the process, making tax season stress-free. 
Battery Efficiency 
Swift Miles is designed to minimize battery usage by optimizing GPS tracking algorithms, so you can keep the app running in the background without draining your phone's battery.
Subscription Info
Swift Miles, our paid subscription product, is paid per year for annual subscriptions, per month for monthly subscriptions, and per week for weekly subscriptions.
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period an annual subscription, monthly subscription, and weekly subscription, as the case may be.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription, where applicable.”
Privacy policy and terms of use
https://tektontek.com/termsofuse.php

bluejetty:00129372:ios.description:
Why guess where to find fish? See exactly where they’re hiding with STRIKER™ Cast portable fishfinder and the STRIKER Cast app. This app lets you pair your mobile device with the sonar device and start fishing in minutes. Cast from shore, dock or watercraft, and reel back in to locate and display fish on your iPhone or iPad. With the STRIKER Cast GPS model, you can even create your own custom maps with 1’ contours. 
This app is not intended to be a standalone fishing or sonar app.
• Sonar streams wirelessly from up to 200’ away
• Displays fish and structure in crisp, easy-to-interpret detail
• Choose from easy-to-understand traditional 2-D sonar and ice fishing flasher modes
• Includes automatic setting adjustments for gain, range and more
• Access maps with up to 1’ contours from the Garmin Quickdraw™ Community or create your own
• Mark your favorite fishing spots so you can easily find your way back
Make your first cast a STRIKER Cast.
Please note: Continuous use of GPS can shorten battery life.

bluejetty:00129552:ios.summary:
Grow with purpose. Think before you plant:
Each vegetable has planting rules. Space is tight. Can you figure out how to grow everything you need for tonight’s dinner?
A cozy logic game for mindful players.
Tend your tiny garden, one though
bluejetty:00129552:ios.description:
Grow with purpose. Think before you plant:
Each vegetable has planting rules. Space is tight. Can you figure out how to grow everything you need for tonight’s dinner?
A cozy logic game for mindful players.
Tend your tiny garden, one thoughtful move at a time. Each level is a relaxing puzzle where you’ll plant vegetables with care, each following its own set of rules. The goal? Harvest just enough to prepare something special.
Puzzle your way to quiet joy.
For fans of slow games, mindful moments and unwinding experience.
Features:
-72 handcrafted levels - calm, clever puzzles across three difficulties.
-Strategic gardening - plan carefully, space is limited.
-Lo-fi soundscape - soft beats and ambient comfort.
-Cozy aesthetic - soothing 3D visuals and gentle animations.
-Simple tap controls - intuitive for all ages.
-Offline play - perfect for winding down anytime, anywhere.
-Optional haptic feedback.
-Game Center & leaderboards to track the amount of your vegetables planted.
-No ads. No in-app purchases. No tracking. Just peace.
-NEW: Hints. Just tap the hints icon to display one of the ways to solve the level.
Made with love by a solo developer.
If you enjoy Plant with Care, be sure to check out my other cozy, handcrafted games.

bluejetty:00087182:ios.description:
Your Home is the Train! Move around the world on rails, explore New Locations, defend your Home from zombies, crush them at full speed!
Stop only to get resources and create items for survival, but remember this is a risk to your Life! Along the way, you are sure to face many dangers. We promise you it will be fun!
GAME FEATURES
- Build and upgrade your Train and crafting stations
- Hunting for wild animals and zombies
- Crafting resources to survive
- Search for items needed to survive in abandoned cities
- Survival fight with zombie bosses
- Defend your home from waves of zombies
- A fascinating storyline, hardcore and the struggle for life!
You have to get to a safe place and figure out what is the reason for the sudden appearance of a crowd of the dead.
TRAIN CONSTRUCTION
The train is your only home. You can't stop and leave the train for a long time. Upgrade and strengthen your shelter.
You must always be ready to fight for your Life and the lives of your Friends!
CRAFT WEAPONS AND DEFENSIVE GEAR
Craft stations to process resources, craft workbenches to produce materials. Get rare materials in abandoned cities. Build a reliable Survival Home!
EXPLORATION AND SURVIVAL
This game has a lot of abandoned cities, dense and scary forests, dangerous mountains, explore them to stay alive. But remember, they are all inhabited by deadly enemies - zombies!
ZOMBIES, MUTANTS, DEAD, MONSTERS, UNDEAD!
Only you, your Friends and millions of monsters are left everywhere in the World. Zombies are waiting for you in the most unpredictable places. Be ready to attack or defend at any moment! Develop your hunting skills to destroy all enemies on your way!
What are you waiting for? Welcome to the Zombie Apocalypse World!
Game premium access gives valuable game bonuses:
- free unique survival mode
- 50 coins every day
- inventory expanded with 5 free slots
- hunger and thirst speed decreased by 50%
- 2 unique weeapons every day
You can take advantage of the 3 day free trial period to evaluate premium access.
The cost of a weekly subscription is $7.99. Premium Access will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off 24 hours before the end of the current subscription. Subscription renewal fees are charged to the account 24 hours prior to the expiration of the current subscription.
Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal turned off by going to your Account Settings after purchase. You cannot cancel the current subscription after the start of its validity period. If you purchase a subscription, the unused portion of the free trial period will be forfeited.
Please read our:
- Privacy Policy https://privacy.playdarium.com/
- EULA https://eula.playdarium.com/
Customer Service mail: supprort.playdarium.com

bluejetty:00180666:ios.description:
Enabling healthcare providers to perform telemedicine consults anywhere, safely and conveniently – from any mobile device.
For Patients:
No more driving to the doctor or sitting in waiting rooms. With Amwell Touchpoint, you can connect with your medical providers to help you feel better faster.
Your provider will send a request to connect with you for a video consultation. You simply tap your invitation link to go straight into your video call with the Touchpoint app. No login is required for users accessing this video call functionality.
For Providers:
For providers with a health system login, Amwell Touchpoint app provides the ability to:
• Launch secure, HIPAA-compliant video consultations using Amwell Connect
• Receive automated notifications when new cases are assigned
• Review case details and the patient’s medical history
The Amwell Touchpoint mobile app is a component of our comprehensive telehealth suite that enables:
• Video calling, including both simple SMS/email guest invites to patients at home as well as controlling video endpoints within the hospital.
• Coordination across multiple point-of-care locations and service lines with secure messaging and case workflow
• Automation of alerts and escalations
• Integration with EHR and IT systems to minimize disruptions to workflow
• Act as a video and phone dialer with Epic Haiku/Canto.
• Active monitoring of point-of-care devices

bluejetty:00186179:ios.description:
Become the caretaker of a vibrant ocean reef! Collect and care for hundreds of lovable sea creatures in this relaxing game.
Dive into a peaceful underwater world where every new discovery brings your reef to life. Meet an incredible variety of real-world marine species, beautifully designed to reflect how they look and behave in nature, and enjoy learning delightful facts about each new friend you welcome.
A friendly turtle will be your guide as you hatch new species and nurture them to adulthood. Once they are fully grown, you'll release them to help restore balance to the wider ocean. Along the way, decorate your reef with vibrant coral and charming décor to create your own cozy sanctuary!
GAME HIGHLIGHTS:
* Relaxing Gameplay: Immerse yourself in a serene, visually stunning underwater world, teeming with life.
* Hundreds of Ocean Species: Collect and nurture spectacular marine life, from vibrant angelfish and ethereal seadragons to majestic sharks, alongside other stunning species.
* Decorate: Adorn your reef with a diverse array of beautiful coral and decorations that produce coins to help you grow your sanctuary.
* Learn as You Play: Document your discoveries and learn fascinating real-world facts about every species in the Aquapedia.
* Special Events: Join limited-time events to discover new species and exclusive decorations. There's always something new to collect!
* Connect with Friends: Exchange gifts and help each other build thriving sanctuaries.
If you love fish, collection, and calming, nature-inspired games, prepare to be captivated by the wonders of Splash.
Splash is developed and published by Runaway.
This game is free to play but does contain in-app purchases. If you run into any issues while playing or you have any suggestions, please reach out to us at support@runaway.zendesk.com

bluejetty:00177506:ios.description:
To make this text bulletproof for Apple's review, we need to remove phrases like "as called as Phone Number" (which sounds like you're trying to hide tracking keywords) and ensure the distinction between "Location" and "Information" is very sharp.
Here is the revised, compliant text:
App Description: Landline Region Identifier
Regional Information for Landline Numbers This app is a utility tool designed to identify the geographic region (City, State, or Country) associated with landline phone numbers using public area code data. It is an informational directory, not a tracking tool.
Important Notice: This app provides general region-level information only. It does NOT provide real-time location, GPS tracking, personal names, or precise street address data.
Key Features:
Landline Region Lookup Identify the registered geographic origin of a landline phone number based on standard area and country codes.
Database-Driven Results Results are based on public numbering plans (e.g., North American Numbering Plan and international ISD codes).
Landline Focus Optimized for identifying regional origins of landline numbers.
Optional Contact Lookup:
You may choose to grant access to your contacts to quickly identify the regional origin of your saved landline numbers.
If permission is denied, the app remains fully functional through manual number entry.
What This App Does NOT Do:
No Real-Time Tracking: We do not provide GPS coordinates or live movement data for any device.
No Personal Data Collection: We do not create user profiles or store your search history.
No Private Database Access: We do not look up private individual names or unlisted information.
No Mobile Tracking: This tool is for geographic area code identification only.
Privacy & Transparency:
Local Processing: Search queries are processed against our secure area-code database without storing your personal info.
User Control: Permissions for Contacts or General Location are used strictly to enhance the lookup experience and are entirely optional.
No Data Sharing: We do not sell or share any user data with third parties.

bluejetty:00073897:ios.name: Anchor Alarm with Late Set
bluejetty:00073897:ios.summary:
ANCHOR ALARM

The app comes with an option for late set: in case you forget
bluejetty:00073897:ios.description:
ANCHOR ALARM
The Anchor Alarm app lets you feel safe and secure when on anchor. 
You get instant alerts and notifications when your anchor drags or the GPS reception degrades. 
The app comes with an option for late set: in case you forget to set the alarm when you drop the anchor, you can still do it later. 
You can also adjust the anchor position manually on the map screen.
You can also manually enter the anchor coordinates, in case you saved them on another device.
If you decide to take your device ashore, you can pause the alarm and reactivate it later, when you return.
CUSTOM AREA
You can choose between circular area or you can draw a custom area on the map. 
The boat movement is recorded and a track is displayed on the map screen.
The app runs in the background and requires no internet connection.
The app supports dark mode and has simple and native user interface. 
REMOTE MONITORING
Peace of mind, wherever you are. 
With Remote Monitoring, leave one device on your boat and keep track from another in your pocket - so you’ll always know your boat is safe.
FIND MY BOAT
The app can remember the location of your boat when you leave and point you to its location later. 
In can also point to your last anchor position in case you forgot to set the boat position.
Useful in crowded anchorages or when on your dinghy.
ANCHORAGES MAP
The app includes a map of more than 8000 anchorages around the world for free, showing depths where available.
FULLY CUSTOMIZABLE
The application allows you to personalize your experience through customizable settings such as:
• measurement units
• alarm sounds
• GPS accuracy threshold
• The time before a bad GPS accuracy alarm is triggered
APPLE WATCH APP
The app supports Apple Watch. In addition to the distance to the anchor and GPS accuracy, you can monitor the boat speed and heading.
SIRI SUPPORT
You can create Siri shortcuts to start and stop monitoring.
Like us on Facebook or join our group to get updates on what's going on with the apps, get help or suggest features.
https://www.facebook.com/ancalarm
TERMS OF USE
Visit https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00137796:ios.description:
This self-teaching game helps to learn productively correct pronunciation and spelling through visual and audio support. For the correct organization of the learning process will help the function "Smart-Teacher". With this interesting and entertaining game you will be able to add new words from scratch to your vocabulary through playing. The vocabulary is the foundation for good oral and writing skills. Self-training every day can improve your knowledge in practice - reading, speaking, listening and literacy. It includes the translation of words more than 40 languages.

- Learning the alphabet, parts of speech, such as nouns, adjectives, verbs with phonetic transcription through flashcards and sound accompaniment by native speaker.

• Choosing the right word for the picture.
• Choosing the dynamic moving images for the words.
• Writing words and spell check.

bluejetty:00035214:ios.summary: Discover a new way to build and maintain healthy habits with Otto, your motivational virtual pet companion who makes healthy habits fun and achievable. Whether you’re managing ADHD or looking for a powerful habit tracker and planner, Otto h
bluejetty:00035214:ios.description:
Discover a new way to build and maintain healthy habits with Otto, your motivational virtual pet companion who makes healthy habits fun and achievable. Whether you’re managing ADHD or looking for a powerful habit tracker and planner, Otto helps you stay organized and motivated. Raise your adorable Otto by taking care of yourself and completing your daily to-do list!
Are healthy habits hard to stick to? Looking for a fun and supportive health app to establish a self-care routine? Otto is the ultimate virtual pet and habit tracker that combines the best features of a planner, to-do list, and journal. Otto makes building and sustaining healthy habits enjoyable and straightforward while helping you achieve your goals.
WHY OTTO IS THE BEST DAILY HABIT TRACKER?
Start your day with personalized goals using Otto’s habit tracker and planner. Energize your virtual pet Otto for daily adventures! Stay on track with your daily to-do list and watch your healthy habits flourish.
End your day with Otto by reviewing your progress and celebrating achievements. Every completed task on your to-do list helps your Otto grow, unlock rewards, and discover exciting new items along the way.
UNIQUE FEATURES OF OTTO
- Planner & To-Do List: Organize your day effectively with Otto’s comprehensive planner and customizable to-do list.
- Habit Tracker: Build and monitor daily habits using Otto’s intuitive habit tracker, designed for all users, including those managing ADHD.
- Supporting ADHD: Otto offers features like reminders, achievable goal-setting, and a fun virtual pet to keep you motivated and focused.
- Explorations & Gamification: Energize your Otto to explore, discover items, and develop new attributes.
- Customizable Virtual Pet: Personalize your Otto with new outfits and accessories as you complete goals on your to-do list.
- Growth & Rewards: Watch your Otto grow and evolve as you use the habit tracker and complete tasks with the planner.

bluejetty:00027445:ios.description:
Plan your tasks by day. This Week is similar to a calendar but every day is a list instead of an agenda. Put tasks into any day of this week or next week, or just add it to the "Later" list!
HOW IT WORKS
With This Week, tasks don’t use time of day. You can plan your day by rearranging tasks into an ordered list so you can do them one by one. 
This new approach to planning your to-dos is designed to fit real life. Other apps want to appeal to enterprises so they add lots of scheduling, calendars, and other enterprise features. This Week is designed for our personal lives where we may know what tasks we'd like to do on a given day, but not exactly when.
OTHER FEATURES
● Time-reminders
● Geo-reminders
● Sub-tasks
● Photo attachments 
● Drag & drop to rearrange 
Need a reminder for something? This Week offers both time reminders and geo reminders! Get a notification at a particular time or when leaving or arriving at a particular location. 
Use sub-tasks to make grocery lists or shopping lists for a particular store, without making your main list explode in length!
Attach photos to your tasks. Need a paint that compliments your couch? Attach a picture of your couch to your “Buy Paint” task!
PRO MEMBERSHIP (Available as an In-App Purchase)
The free version of This Week was built to work extremely well for users. All the fundamentals from This Week v1.0 are free! We chose to start with "Themes" as the only Pro feature so that everyone could still enjoy the core features of the app we've worked so hard to create.
As we roll out new abilities, like syncing and Siri integration, some of those features will require a Pro Membership. As two indie-developers with normal jobs and bills, we also appreciate the support!

bluejetty:00118989:ios.description:
Restoration job documentation all in one place
Stop juggling multiple apps. Encircle is the go-to field app built for restorers who want less stress and more profit. Capture every must-know detail in the field, keep your team connected in real time, and generate polished reports that get you paid faster—with no chasing or delays.
What you can do with Encircle:
JOB DOCUMENTATION
Snap unlimited photos, videos, 360° images and notes—organized by room with time/date, User and GPS metadata for rock-solid proof.
PROFESSIONAL REPORTS
Turn your field documentation into professional, easy-to-read reports that tell the full story of the loss—instantly. Each report includes interactive media and customizable content to handle any objections or potential pushback. 
FAST FLOOR PLANS
Scan a property in minutes with your phone and get a sketch with accurate measurements back in about under 6 hours. Send straight into Xactimate for an instant sketch and to kick off estimates on Day 1.
WATER MITIGATION
Log moisture, equipment and psychrometric readings to instantly create moisture maps. Use the IICRC S500 equipment calculator to determine the exact right amount to place and justify every line item.
CONTENTS
Save days on site by eliminating manual inventory and packout processes. Capture item photos and details in seconds, organize them by rooms and boxes, and auto-generate a report or schedule of loss report in minutes. 
CUSTOM FORMS
Take every form, contract, and document you've got and we’ll transform it into a digital format, accessible anytime, anywhere, and from any device. Get rid of paper documents and file folders for good. 
COMMUNICATION
Get documents signed remotely and share updates, reports and forms instantly with adjusters, subs and homeowners so everyone stays in the loop.
PAYMENT ON-SITE
Collect deposits, deductibles and even self-pay upgrades right on-site—no checks, no chasing, no delays. Powered by Stripe, you can Tap to Pay on iPhone in the field or send a secure link before work begins.
Simplify operations, get paid faster, and keep customers smiling—with Encircle.

TidySnap is not only your travel photo companion, but also a powerful smart photo cleaner that helps you free up storage space effortlessly while keeping your memories beautifully organized. 
• **Smart Cleanup**: Powered by intelligent algorithms, it automatically detects and categorizes redundant photos — including duplicates, similar shots, blurry images, screenshots, and large files. With just a few taps, you can clean up your album in minutes without the hassle of manual sorting. 
• **Storage Optimization**: Quickly free up valuable storage space, improve device performance, and get your phone ready for your next trip. 
• **Time Calendar**: Relive your daily highlights through a beautiful calendar view with curated photo moments. 
• **Trip Albums**: Automatically organizes your travel photos by location and date, making your journeys easy to revisit. 
• **Travel Stories**: Turn your photos into vivid stories with text and images, making every memory more engaging. 
• **Destination Memories**: Create dedicated albums and story cards for each city or place you visit. 
Whether you want to **clean up your photo library and optimize storage**, or **relive unforgettable journeys**, TidySnap makes it simple and delightful. 
---
**TidySnap offers auto-renewable subscription options:** 
* Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account upon confirmation of purchase. 
* Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. 
* Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, and the cost will be identified. 
* Any unused portion of a free trial, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription. 
* You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.

Terms of Service: 
https://resource.ahaphotolab.com/JournoAlbum/service.html

bluejetty:00166174:ios.description:
Tribune de Genève - Votre journal complet pour suivre toute l’actualité genevoise, suisse et mondiale
Avec l’application Tribune de Genève, soyez au cœur de l’actualité locale, nationale et internationale. Notre journal s’adresse à toutes les Genevoises et tous les Genevois à la recherche d’un média fiable, proche du terrain et profondément ancré dans sa région. Retrouvez chaque jour des news bien sourcées, des analyses pertinentes, des enquêtes exclusives et des reportages approfondis.
VOS AVANTAGES AVEC L’APPLICATION TRIBUNE DE GENÈVE
Une seule application pour tout suivre : news régionales, nationales et internationales en continu via votre journal de référence.
Notifications personnalisées : choisissez les thématiques de l’actualité qui vous passionnent.
Sauvegarde de vos articles : ajoutez vos lectures préférées à votre liste de favoris.
Lecture hors ligne : accédez à vos contenus du journal, même sans connexion.
Partage d’articles : les abonnés peuvent offrir jusqu’à 10 articles par mois à leurs proches.
E-Paper : consultez en un clic la version numérique complète du journal Tribune de Genève.
Agenda : retrouvez les événements culturels, concerts, films, spectacles dans notre calendrier interactif.
Carte blanche : accédez à des offres exclusives réservées aux abonnés du journal.
NOUVEAU: Écoutez vos articles en déplacement grâce à la lecture audio (Text to Speech) : découvrez une nouvelle manière de suivre l’actualité en toute liberté.
PLUS QUE DES NEWS
La Tribune de Genève ne se limite pas à l’essentiel de l’actualité : nous vous apportons aussi les meilleures recommandations sur les sorties, films, restaurants et événements autour de vous. Notre équipe locale veille à vous livrer des news proches de votre quotidien. Et bien sûr, suivez la météo suisse en temps réel pour planifier vos journées.
Avec des dossiers thématiques, des formats longs, des débats et des décryptages, notre journal met la qualité journalistique au service de vos connaissances.
S’INSCRIRE POUR EN PROFITER PLEINEMENT
Créez votre compte utilisateur pour sauvegarder vos articles favoris, vous abonner à nos newsletters, partager vos news préférées, accéder à toute l’actualité, consulter la météo suisse, et maintenant écouter vos articles à tout moment grâce à la lecture audio intégrée.
ABONNEZ-VOUS POUR UN ACCÈS COMPLET AU JOURNAL
L’abonnement vous donne accès à l’intégralité des contenus exclusifs du journal Tribune de Genève : des news internationales aux histoires locales, en passant par les grandes enquêtes et les analyses politiques.
Le téléchargement de l’application est gratuit. Les abonnés au journal papier bénéficient aussi d’un accès illimité en ligne, simplement en créant un identifiant avec leur numéro de client.
Remarque sur les abonnements : la facturation s’effectue via votre compte iTunes et se renouvelle automatiquement. Vous pouvez désactiver le renouvellement dans « Afficher mon compte » au moins 24 heures avant la fin de la période. La résiliation prend effet à la fin de la période en cours.
Le téléchargement d’articles, contenus multimédias ou l’utilisation du streaming peut engendrer des frais de connexion. Renseignez-vous auprès de votre opérateur mobile.
Conditions générales : https://cgv.tdg.ch
Déclaration de confidentialité : https://privacypolicy.tdg.ch

bluejetty:00078818:ios.description:
This app is an unofficial informational tool for finding Peacock TV Originals release dates, quickly and easily. You can not watch or stream shows or movies in this app, this app is an informational tool. 
Quickly find all scheduled Peacock TV Original release dates, then get notified about changes and updates to the show or movie, including notifications about your favourite actors.
With Originals you can be the first person to know about a new season announcement and release date!
Set reminders for your favorite series release dates.
- Notifications about new seasons and episodes, and production changes,
- Follow actors and get notified about new shows and movies they are in,
- Smart Subscriptions to help you save on streaming services,
- Track your shows/movies watched,
- Track watched progress,
- Follow actors and get updated on changes,
- Filter by Series, Movies or Documentaries,
- Notifications for new seasons, or part seasons,
- Notification when show is released,
- List of favourite shows, movies,
- Browse and Search for Original Shows/Movies,
- Browse by popular, rating, date, show or movie,
- Watch Trailers,
- Filter upcoming by date, title, media type,
- Filter by Release date,
Originals is funded by ads, if you choose to purchase Originals Pro to hide these ads, unlock Smart Subscriptions, Premium notifications, and unlimited favorites and follows, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase.
Purchasing Originals Pro will not allow you to stream or watch any content, shows, or movies.

bluejetty:00098235:ios.description:
YOUR SKIN IS UNIQUE. YOUR TREATMENT SHOULD BE TOO.
Effective treatment for acne, redness, wrinkles, and other skin conditions isn't one-size-fits-all. The challenge is finding the right approach tailored exactly to you and your skin. To achieve this, you need someone guiding you every step of the way. That's why Nolla exists.
PERSONAL CLINICIAN
Our goal is to provide treatment as if you had a personal clinician by your side at all times. We offer recommendations tailored specifically to your skin and closely track your progress through scans from the app, so we know exactly when you need to check back in with your clinician.
EXPERIENCED CLINICIANS AND PROVEN MEDICATIONS
We collaborate with skilled clinicians who have extensive experience treating skin conditions. Our clinicians prescribe only evidence-based treatments that have been proven effective through clinical research. We ship your prescribed medication straight to your door.

bluejetty:00174949:ios.name: Flag Football Playmaker X
bluejetty:00174949:ios.summary: Flag Football Playmaker X is a playbook design, collaboration and printing app. We've built on the foundation of our coach-favorite Playmaker app and added cloud backup, multi-device syncing, advanced diagramming, animation, deeper printing
bluejetty:00174949:ios.description:
Flag Football Playmaker X is a playbook design, collaboration and printing app. We've built on the foundation of our coach-favorite Playmaker app and added cloud backup, multi-device syncing, advanced diagramming, animation, deeper printing options and more.
DESIGN & ORGANIZE PLAYS
• Intuitive touch controls make it easy to set formations & draw plays. 
• Name plays & assign them to categories for instant access to the right play for any situation. 
• Collapsable roster panel lists all team members with drag and drop position assignment.
ANIMATE YOUR PLAYBOOK
• One tap to animate any play.
• Fine tune animation speed for precise route timing.
• Show football movement with the animated football annotation.
MAKE INSTANT ADJUSTMENTS
• Make changes to existing plays on the fly.
• Flip any play instantly.
• Draw up a new play in seconds to take advantage of schematic opportunities as they emerge.
• Switch between offensive & defensive playbooks with one touch.
MAXIMIZE PLAYER COMPREHENSION
• Assign names to positions to save time in the huddle & keep players focused on their responsibilities.
• Customizable colors & labels clearly distinguish positions.
• Optional field lines for precise alignments and route depths.
• High definition graphics make play diagrams easy to see under any lighting conditions.
MORE
• Playbook settings for 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 & 9 player per side leagues. 
• Customize your dashboard with your own team logo and color.
• Identify an intended receiver, choose smooth or straight lines, show zigzag lines for pre-snap motion, show dotted lines for pitch & pass and draw zone defense responsibilities. 
• Add text annotations to provide on-play notes.
• Add option routes for more advanced offensive diagrams.
• Add a ball icon to show handoffs and ball movement.
• Choose between three end caps for your routes: arrow, T (for blocks) and dot. 
• Choose between dark & light backgrounds for optimal visibility under any lighting conditions.
• Set up custom Personnel Groups. Great for play-specific position assignments, depth charts and mass substitutions.
• Design unlimited offensive & defensive plays. Have your full playbook at your fingertips & add new plays whenever inspiration strikes. 
OPTIONS FOR EVERY COACH
After your free trial, you can choose between a range of app options to suit your team’s needs.
PAPERLESS
• App access for you 
• + Cloud backup & sync on multiple devices
PRINT
• App access for you
• Cloud backup & sync on multiple devices
• + Print wristbands, playbooks, call sheets & more
TEAM
• App access for you
• Cloud backup & sync on multiple devices
• Print wristbands, playbooks, call sheets & more
• + App access for your whole team

bluejetty:00026512:ios.summary: Become a superhero and save the city from crime in the brand new open world game! Fight your way through the mafia and gangsters using your incredible combat skills. Traverse the city using the web to swing from building to building and exp
bluejetty:00026512:ios.description:
Become a superhero and save the city from crime in the brand new open world game! Fight your way through the mafia and gangsters using your incredible combat skills. Traverse the city using the web to swing from building to building and explore locations.
Experience an open-world adventure that will take you through the city's bustling streets and sprawling skylines. With the ability to climb walls and leap great distances, you'll feel like a true superhero as you take on any challenge that comes your way.
Join forces with the iconic superheroes as you battle against some of the most dangerous villains in the universe. With an array of customizable abilities and a wide variety of weapons at your disposal, you'll be able to take down anyone who stands in your way.
But be warned, the city is filled with dangers at every turn. From corrupt politicians to ruthless gangsters, you'll need to use all of your wits and skills to survive. With a gripping storyline that will keep you on the edge of your seat, a brand new Super Fighter 3 game is the ultimate open-world adventure for fans of the genre.
- Play as your favorite superheroes and fight the city's biggest villains
- Travel the city using the web to explore locations
- Battle against the mafia, gangsters, and other dangerous criminals
- Join forces with iconic superheroes
- Customizable abilities and a wide variety of weapons at your disposal
- Gripping missions that will keep you on the edge of your seat
With vivid graphics, intuitive controls, and non-stop action, it is the ultimate open-world adventure for fans of the genre. Whether you're a fan of the comics or just love action-packed games, this is one title you won't want to miss. Get ready to fight for justice and save the city from the brink of destruction!
Privacy Policy: http://starplay.games/policy.html#PRIVACY_POLICY
Terms of Use: http://starplay.games/policy.html#TERMS_OF_USE

bluejetty:00069161:ios.description:
Bring. Back. My. Girls!
Enter the iconic Werk Room and experience the fantastic fashion-conscious world of RuPaul’s Drag Race. Werk your way to be the top fashion designer and become a superstar stylist. Go shopping and select from hundreds of fashion dress-up pieces, put on that makeup and create the fiercest look to slay the runway.
Slay your competition with your best makeover style, challenging other players from around the world to become the Top Queen. Win amazing new outfits, dresses, shoes and add more to your closet, and earn the respect of real Queens from the TV show! You’ve got what it takes to slay, make sure you don’t sashay away. And may the best Drag Queen - Win!
FIERCE FASHION GAMEPLAY
Choose from hundreds of fabulous fierce fashion pieces across a multitude of different drag genres to combine and create your own unique dress-up style. Upgrade your pieces to create stunning looks, that will make everyone gag.
CHALLENGE THE WORLD
Werk the runway! Take your looks into nail-biting competitions with other Drag Queens around the world, and fight to be the next Drag Superstar. Win more incredible looks that will help you serve your eleganza extravaganza.
WERK THE ROOM
Experience all the tea and sisterhood of the Werk Room, right out of the TV show. Prepare yourself for the Maxi Challenge where you can slay your rivals with style.
RU’S GIRLS
Unlock Queens from RuPaul’s Drag Race, party in the Untucked lounge, and win some of their most iconic outfits.
BECOME AN IDLE IDOL
RuPaul’s Drag Race Superstar is an idle game so you never have to miss earning those Werk Coins and Ru Badges, even when you’re not on your mobile phone!
By downloading this app, you agree to our privacy policy and terms of use, available at:
Terms of Service - https://service-terms.eastsidegames.com
Privacy Policy - https://privacy-policy.eastsidegames.com/
Please note that this game is free to download and play, but some game items are available for purchase using real money. A network connection is required to play the game.

bluejetty:00168318:ios.name: The Boiled One: Horror Game
bluejetty:00168318:ios.summary: In the depths of the gaming world, where horror meets the pinnacle of terror, emerges "The Boiled One," a horror game designed to test the limits of fear and endurance. This game intertwines the eerie essence of creepypasta legends with the
bluejetty:00168318:ios.description:
In the depths of the gaming world, where horror meets the pinnacle of terror, emerges "The Boiled One," a horror game designed to test the limits of fear and endurance. This game intertwines the eerie essence of creepypasta legends with the unsettling ambiance of analog horror, creating an experience that is not for the faint of heart. Players find themselves trapped in a sinister location for five harrowing nights, each filled with the chilling task of surviving the malevolent entity known as The Boiled One.
The phenomenon of The Boiled One is no ordinary tale; it's a blend of urban legends and digital horror that has seeped its way into the realm of creepypasta, captivating and terrifying an audience yearning for a taste of true terror. The game's narrative is rich with lore, drawing players deeper into a world where the boundaries between reality and the digital horror sphere blur. With every night spent in the game, the story unfolds, revealing the dark origins and malevolent intentions of The Boiled One, an entity whose presence is as mysterious as it is deadly.
Gameplay in "The Boiled One" is a masterful combination of survival horror mechanics and psychological terror, pushing players to their limits as they navigate through dimly lit corridors, decipher cryptic messages, and solve puzzles that are as mind-bending as they are essential for survival. The atmosphere is thick with tension, crafted through a meticulously designed soundscape that amplifies every creak and whisper, turning the game into a symphony of scares.
The horror game genre is no stranger to fear, but "The Boiled One" elevates this to new heights with its unique approach to the boiled one phenomenon. The entity is not just a monster; it's a manifestation of primal terror, leveraging the analog horror aesthetic to create a sense of dread that lingers long after the game is turned off. Players must use every resource at their disposal, from hidden clues to the very environment around them, to outwit and escape the clutches of The Boiled One Survival Horror.
As the nights progress, the challenges grow more daunting, and the veil between the game world and the psychological terror it induces grows thinner. Players are not just fighting for survival within the game; they're battling their own fears, amplified by the creepypasta-inspired narrative and the relentless pursuit of The Boiled One. The game cleverly incorporates elements of terror, horror, and suspense, ensuring that the experience is as mentally engaging as it is terrifying.
"The Boiled One" is not just a horror game; it's a journey into the heart of darkness, a test of courage, and a showcase of the horror genre's potential to evoke deep, unsettling emotions. It's a tribute to the analog horror and creepypasta communities, offering a new legend to be feared and respected. This game is a must-play for horror aficionados and those brave enough to face the terror of The Boiled One. Will you survive the five nights, or will the darkness consume you? The only way to find out is to enter the world of "The Boiled One" and face the horror head-on

bluejetty:00071162:ios.name: My Disney Experience
bluejetty:00071162:ios.summary:
The official Walt Disney World® app! Now it’s easier than ever to plan & share your vacation details—at home & on the go.
-Maximize your park time by taking advantage of our new Disney Genie service, which generates a personalized itinerary
bluejetty:00071162:ios.description:
The official Walt Disney World® app! Now it’s easier than ever to plan & share your vacation details—at home & on the go.
-Maximize your park time by taking advantage of our new Disney Genie service, which generates a personalized itinerary that guides you through our theme parks with tips that can help you reduce time in lines & take the guesswork out of “what’s next.”
-Quickly access real-time wait times, park hours, Character Greetings, showtimes & more.
-Use the interactive, GPS-enabled map to explore the Resort & easily see the dining options, attractions & more nearest to you.
-Find your way around with step-by-step directions.
-Browse restaurant menus, make dining reservations, modify existing ones & even mobile order meals from select locations.
-Download, edit & share your Disney PhotoPass® photos & videos throughout your vacation once you’ve purchased Memory Maker.
-Search & filter activities to find exactly what you’re looking for.
-Keep select Disney Resort hotel reservations, dining plans & activities organized—all in one spot with My Day & Plans.
-Save time by starting your Disney Resort hotel check-in process right from the app.
-Link a MagicBand+ to your Disney account on the app & unlock enchanting touches of magic.
-Save your parking information at select parking locations with car locator.
-Manage your Disney Resort reservations, tickets, MagicBands & cards & share plans with others.
-Discover official content for Walt Disney World Resort, including our 4 theme parks (Magic Kingdom® park, Epcot®, Disney’s Hollywood Studios® & Disney’s Animal Kingdom® park), 2 water parks (Disney’s Typhoon Lagoon & Disney’s Blizzard Beach water parks), Disney Springs®, select Walt Disney World Resort hotels & ESPN Wide World of Sports Complex.
Have questions, problems, comments or suggestions? Reach out to us at app.support@disneyworld.com.
Connecting to the Internet in the parks: Without a strong Internet signal, wait times, park hours & schedules may not update accurately. You can see if your device is connected properly by checking under Settings.
Note: Some features in this app will require your full name, country, birthdate & email address, as well as access to your location data. If Bluetooth is enabled on your device, this app will also collect your precise location information through beacon technology in order to improve your in-park experience, such as wait times. To facilitate the sign-in process, the app will also require access to your email address, stored within Account Manager.
This app may request access to your camera to capture media & scan barcodes. Some Disney PhotoPass Lenses may use information on your device to detect face & hand coordinates. The app may request access to your external storage to cache certain data for offline browsing.
Optional planning tools may also ask you to provide details about your travel party. Some features in this app include the ability to make purchases & will require a Wi-Fi or mobile carrier data connection. Message, data and roaming rates may apply. Availability subject to handset limitations and features may vary by handset or service provider. Coverage and app stores not available everywhere. Guests must be 18 years or older to make purchases.
Before downloading, please consider that this app contains in-app purchases that cost real money. The app provides you with the option to receive push notifications for information relating to your visit to a Park or a Disney Resort hotel.
Terms of Use: http://disneytermsofuse.com
Privacy Policy: https://disneyprivacycenter.com
Your US State Privacy Rights: https://privacy.thewaltdisneycompany.com/en/current-privacy-policy/your-us-state-privacy-rights/
Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information: https://privacy.twdc.com/dnssmpi
Important Info About Disney PhotoPass Lenses: https://disneyworld.disney.go.com/photopass-terms-conditions/#important-notice-about-attribute-lenses

bluejetty:00187402:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone into a key – with Nuki
Nuki: The retrofittable, smart door lock. Innovated in Austria – manufactured in Europe. 
APP REPLACES KEYS
Turn your smart devices into keys. With the free Nuki app, you can open your door with your iPhone or your Apple Watch. Open the door with just one click, even remotely. 
SHARING KEYS
Share access permissions with the Nuki app. Simple and secure. You decide who has access. With the activity log you always know who unlocked your door and when. 
SMART FEATURES
Auto Unlock: Your door opens automatically when you come home.
Auto Lock: Automatic locking, form maximum security.
Night Mode: Activate various safety features during the night. Customize the night mode to your needs.
SMART HOME INTEGRATIONS
Easy and fast integration into your existing Smart Home. Thanks to Matter Nuki Smart Locks are compatible with most Smart Home systems. Matter ensures an easy and fast integration. 
EASY DIY INSTALLATION
You can install the Nuki Smart Lock yourself within a few minutes. The Nuki app supports you with a step-by-step guide. 
See if Nuki is compatible with your door here: www.nuki.io/check 
SMART ACCESSOIRES
The Nuki ecosystem offers you a variety of accessoires. Open fast via fingerprint or entry code with the Nuki Keypad 2 or simple and easy via button with the Nuki Fob. No smartphone needed. 
Get your Smart Lock now directly in our online shop: https://shop.nuki.io/
We’d love to hear from you. If you have questions about Nuki products please contact us at contact@nuki.io, or visit us on social media.

bluejetty:00159409:ios.name: Bezzy Type 2 Diabetes
bluejetty:00159409:ios.summary:
As humans, we’re hardwired for connection. Belonging to a community makes us feel safe and helps us thrive. 
But so often, living with type 2 diabetes (T2D) can make you feel physically and emotionally isolated. Not only can it be hard to
bluejetty:00159409:ios.description:
As humans, we’re hardwired for connection. Belonging to a community makes us feel safe and helps us thrive. 
But so often, living with type 2 diabetes (T2D) can make you feel physically and emotionally isolated. Not only can it be hard to do things you loved before your diagnosis, but it can also feel like no one understands what it’s like.
Until now.
Our mission is to cultivate a space powered by the T2D community and empowered by each other. From one-to-one chats to conversation forums, we make connecting easy. This is a safe place to find and receive advice, to seek and offer support, and to discover the authentic stories of members, just like you.
Bezzy T2D is a free online platform bringing new meaning to the word “community.” 
Our aim is to create an experience where:
- everyone feels seen, valued, and understood
- everyone’s story matters
- shared vulnerability is the name of the game
Bezzy T2D is a place where you are more than your T2D. It’s a place where, finally, you belong.
HOW IT WORKS
Social-first Content
Like all of your favorite social networks, we’ve designed an activity feed to connect you with other members living with type 2 diabetes. We pride ourselves on making Bezzy T2D a safe and secure space where you can join live discussions, connect one-to-one, and read the latest articles and personal stories.
Live Chats 
Need to vent? Get advice? Share what’s on your mind? Hop into a daily live chat to join the conversation. They’re often led by our amazing Community Guide, but you can also expect to chat with other advocates and experts, too.
Forums
From treatments to symptoms to daily living, T2D changes everything. Whatever you're feeling on any given day, there's a forum where you can connect and share directly with others.
1:1 Messaging
Let us connect you with a new member from our community every day. We’ll recommend members to you based on your treatment plan, lifestyle interests, and needs. Browse member profiles and request to connect with anyone from our community with members listed as “Online Now.”
Discover Articles and Stories
We believe that shared experiences empower the kind of belonging that can help people not only survive—but thrive—with T2D. Our stories offer perspectives and tips from people who know what it’s like.
Get handpicked wellness and member stories delivered to you each week.
Connect Safely Anytime, Anywhere 
We take thoughtful steps to build safety, security, and privacy into our platform and foster an environment where members feel safe sharing their personal experiences. Check and send messages, see who’s online, and get notified when a new message comes in—so you’ll never miss a thing. 
Bezzy is not a substitute for the advice of a medical professional familiar with your specific needs. It's important to always speak with your doctor before making any medical decisions. 
ABOUT HEALTHLINE
Healthline Media is the top ranked health publisher and number 44 on Comscore’s Top 100 Property rankings. Across all of its properties, Healthline Media each month publishes up to 1,000 scientifically accurate yet reader-friendly articles authored by more than 120 writers and reviewed by more than 100 doctors, clinicians, nutritionists, and other experts. The company’s repository contains more than 70,000 articles, each updated with current protocol.
More than 200 million people worldwide and 86 million people in the U.S. visit Healthline’s sites each month, according to Google Analytics and Comscore, respectively.
Healthline Media is an RVO Health Company

bluejetty:00040726:ios.description:
Spy Phone ® Pro Mobile Tracker is a powerful monitoring tool to help you keep track of your loved ones online or to keep track of employees. Spy Phone Labs is a World Leader in providing phone tracking software that enables parents to monitor their child’s activities and usage on their smartphones. Highlights of the app include:
-You can view GPS and contact info on up to 99 different phones on your control panel. The GPS Location results are also inserted on a map for ease of use.
-With the Geo-Fencing feature you can set boundaries for up to 50 phones on where your family can go. If they leave that area you are sent an alert.
-Monitor Family Screen Time and set App time limits. 
-Set Custom Speed Driver alert thresholds per device and an Alert Center for viewing historical speed alerts
-Route History & Export: Shows a daily map trace of movement plus CSV/GPX export for a selected day/device.
-You can see Contacts from the phone. The app will copy First Names, Last Names, Email Addresses and Telephone Numbers from the Child's Phone Contact List. You will now have the opportunity to see who your kids have been interacting with.
-We have included a Panic Button which can be used by your family members to alert you of potential problems or situations in which you are needed. You can set up to 99 phones to send you panic button alerts.
-Quiet Hours: Parents can set time-based quiet windows to pause alerts (speed, panic, geofence, battery). Quiet windows are per parent, day-of-week aware, and timezone aware.
-Device Info Status Page: Per-device status view (App Version, OS Version, battery/charging, connection, GPS accuracy, last seen, and latest coordinates) with a manual refresh.
-Daily Digest: an automatic daily summary for each connected device, including update count, movement summary, max speed, and after-hours movement indicators—so you can spot what matters fast from your control panel.
-You can access all this info 24/7 from your control panel.
If you are concerned about your kid's or employees smartphone activities, you should definitely try Pro Mobile Tracker. We are the ultimate child protection software ideal for monitoring all the important activities of your child’s Smartphone. Please note that the Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life. If you do not need 99 device capabilities please take a look at our Spy Phone ® Phone Tracker app which provides less robust features and 10 device capability.

bluejetty:00098511:ios.description:
Ready to turn ordinary hangouts into unforgettable moments? Charades - Family & Guess Game is the ultimate party game reimagined for your phone! Whether you are mimicking a celebrity, acting out a blockbuster movie, or dancing like a robot, it is guaranteed to bring non-stop laughter to your living room.
Hold the phone to your forehead, face your friends, and guess the words from their hilarious clues. Act it out, describe it, sing, or dance—it’s your party, so let your creativity run wild! Perfect for house gatherings, wild parties, cozy sleepovers, family game nights, and road trips.
Stop the boring small talk. Download Charades now and let the fun begin!
Why Players Love Charades:
• Massive Content Library: Choose from 80+ unique decks and over 5,000+ secret words. From Movies and TV Shows to Animals and 90s Nostalgia, the fun never runs out!
• Easy For Everyone: Simply tilt your phone down to mark a correct guess or tilt up to pass. It’s so intuitive that kids, teens, and adults can all play together.

• Custom Decks: Want to play with inside jokes? Create your own custom categories and keep your friends on their toes!
• Offline Mode: No Wi-Fi? No problem. Play anywhere with zero ad interruptions to keep the energy high.

1. Gather your group and pick a deck that matches your party's vibe.
2. One player holds the phone facing the group—everyone else can see the word, but the guesser can't.
3. Friends act, describe, sing, or give clues while the player guesses.
4. Tilt the phone down for a correct guess, or tilt it up to pass. Beat the clock before the timer runs out!

bluejetty:00179661:ios.summary:
Discographic is the best and most complete vinyl collector app currently available with Apple Music, Spotify integration & Last.fm scrobbling.
Wether it’s adding a disc to an existing collection, starting a new discography or checking out
bluejetty:00179661:ios.description:
Discographic is the best and most complete vinyl collector app currently available with Apple Music, Spotify integration & Last.fm scrobbling.
Wether it’s adding a disc to an existing collection, starting a new discography or checking out album details in-store, Discographic does it all.
Featured in WaxTimes (http://bit.ly/1bf3Min), Fact Magazine (http://bit.ly/1GOngnz), AppSpezis (http://bit.ly/1HKO9xS), etc.
DISCLAIMER: This application uses Discogs’ API but is not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by Discogs. ‘Discogs’ is a trademark of Zink Media, LLC.
With Discographic you can:
• Catalog Your Collection 
-Add and remove items from your Collection, move them between folders.
-Use its barcode scanner to add record easily or search for them by catalog number, artist or title.
-Create folders, rename or delete them.
-Order your listings by artist, title, date, etc. and filter them by keywords.
-Add custom notes and edit condition grades. All of your Collection custom user fields are displayed and editable, including ratings.
-Calculate your Collection Value.
• Add to Your Wantlist 
-Carry your Wantlist everywhere you go. 
-Add and remove items from your Wantlist on the go.
-All your Collection and Wantlist will be always synced between your device and server.
• Search the whole Discogs database 
-Search the world's largest database of physical music. Browse records, artists or labels with all the detailed information available on Discogs.
-Filter your searches by category to make them more powerful.
-Display full band/artist discographies. 
-Browse image galleries of releases, masters, artists and labels where available.
-Save your search results for offline display.
• Get your custom user lists always available .
• List items in Discogs Marketplace with only two finger taps :
-Take with you all your Inventory with all the info available.
• View Marketplace Pricing
-Check the marketplace for releases you want to acquire and compare prices.
- All Discogs prices are saved and always available on the app, including History Sales stats.
-Check to see if you already own a record before you buy.
• Full offline support available
-Your Collection, Wantlist, Seller Inventory and every bit of data displayed by the app is conveniently cached in order to make every record on your collection available at any time. 
-This includes masters, releases, artists, labels, Marketplace info, Sales History, your Collection Value Range, your custom searches, etc.
-You can remove all cached files at any time if you need you free space on your device.
• Data Export
-You can export your Collection, Wantlist and Inventory to Excel-compatible format directly from the app, including custom notes and comments.
• Last.FM Scrobbling
-You can scrobble tracks or albums directly from the app (a Last.FM account is needed to use this feature).
• A built-in full Apple Music/Spotify Player to listen to your records.
• Customizable display
-Dark mode, color schemes and display options.

bluejetty:00017986:ios.summary: Use the Greater Vancouver Community Credit Union Mobile App to manage your finances virtually - whenever and wherever you are! This free App provides easy and secure access to your Greater Vancouver Community Credit Union accounts; manage y
bluejetty:00017986:ios.description:
Use the Greater Vancouver Community Credit Union Mobile App to manage your finances virtually - whenever and wherever you are! This free App provides easy and secure access to your Greater Vancouver Community Credit Union accounts; manage your accounts, pay bills, deposit cheques, transfer money and more!
FEATURES INCLUDE:
•Check account balances
•View transaction history
•Transfer money between your accounts
•Send and receive funds securely with Interac® e-Transfer
•Pay bills or schedule upcoming payments
•Deposit cheques from your smartphone or tablet using Deposit Anywhere™
•Branch/ATM locator utilizing your phone’s GPS
•Rate information
•Financial Calculators
•Optional Quickview allows fast access to account balances without logging in
BENEFITS
•Free download
•Easy navigation
•Same login credentials as our full online banking site
ACCESS
To take advantage of the full functionality of this app, you must already be registered and have logged in to Online Banking. Simply login with the same login information as you would the full Online Banking site. If you have not tried Online Banking, visit the nearest Greater Vancouver Community Credit Union branch to sign up for free! If you do not wish to be an Online Banking member, you can still use the Branch/ATM locator, Rates, Calculators and our Contact Us information.
There is no charge for the app however mobile data downloading and internet charges may apply. Check with your mobile phone provider for details.
SECURITY
Your security is important to us, which is why our mobile banking app uses the same level of secure protection as our full Online Banking website. Once you have logged out of the app your secure session ends.
For our privacy and security policy, please visit our website.
PERMISSIONS
By downloading the Greater Vancouver Community Credit Union Mobile app, you consent to the installation of the app and any future updates or upgrades. You may withdraw your consent at any time by deleting or uninstalling the app from your device.
When you install the app it will ask for permission to access the following functions of your device:
• Location services – allows the app to use your device's GPS to find the nearest branch or ATM
• Camera – allows the app to use device camera to take picture of cheque
• Contacts – allows you to create new INTERAC® e-Transfer recipients by selecting from your device contacts.

bluejetty:00061489:ios.description:
OneLogin Protect authenticator, a free, enterprise-ready MFA app, provides two-factor authentication for all your OneLogin SSO accounts and thousands of third-party apps and services. When you use multi-factor authentication, you automatically increase the security of your online accounts. 
Features
• Alerts user with a push notification, user responds with just a tap (OneLogin accounts only).
• Requires your Touch ID, Face ID, or PIN to accept push notification (OneLogin accounts only).
• Works with third-party providers and accounts which you can add at any time.
• Compatible with services using OATH security tokens (i.e. Google Authenticator).
• Generates a unique 6-digit code every 30 seconds for each account (TOTP).
• Generates verification codes without a data connection.
• Adds a new account by scanning a QR code or by entering it manually.
• Securely backup and restore your accounts to your own Google Drive
Permissions
• Camera access for scanning QR code when adding new accounts.
• Push notifications for delivery of OTP requests
Learn more
• Learn more about 2-step verification at onelogin.com/onelogin-protect-authenticator
• Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/onelogin
• Like us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/onelogin

bluejetty:00177796:ios.description:
Our happy kindergarten is going to have a magic trip today. We are going to visit a real amusement park. Hurry up, get in the bus and take your seat, it goes to a play park! We are very excited to present you our next game from the series of educational games for children: Amusement Park.
The way to it isn't easy. It is a real off-road race. You will meet a lot of various obstacles and challenges. You can even have an accident. So be ready to play a role of a real repairman. Perhaps you will have to repair some parts of the bus.
Despite all the difficulties you come at last to the best amusement park for children. Take a look attentively and choose the best attractions that you are willing to attend. Our park is huge. Here is a shooting rage where you can check on your accuracy, cook and eat some popcorn and cotton candy. Definitely attend a fakir's show! Walking along the park you will get lots of unforgettable impressions. Hurry up and get a toy out of the vending machine. Banish all the rodents. And finally here is a fun and fascinating fishing! Get as much fish as you can to get awarded! 
Have a fun playing our amusement park game for family! Our wonder park is waiting for you! 
P.S. We will be very thankful if after playing the game you leave reviews with your ideas and recommendations regarding the game. It will help us to make our games better and to create interesting content for you.

• Type in English letters and get Marathi words with our transliteration technology
• Type faster using word predictions
• Easily switch to English with the
bluejetty:00133593:ios.description:
Desh Marathi Keyboard is a keyboard extension that makes Marathi typing super easy:
• Type in English letters and get Marathi words with our transliteration technology
• Type faster using word predictions
• Easily switch to English with the language key
• Word predictions and spell-correct is available in English also
• Emoji button is available after pressing 123
Open the app and follow instructions to get your new Marathi keyboard:
• Enable keyboard from settings
• Activate the keyboard by holding the Globe icon and selecting "Desh Marathi Keyboard"
• Type Marathi everywhere!
Allowing full access:
• When enabling the keyboard, you may enable "Allow Full Access"
• This allows us to access crash reports and will help us improve the stability of the app
• We respect your privacy. No personal information is collected
• A standard warning is shown when you enable any downloaded keyboard app
How to access settings:
• Tap on the ⋯ button after opening the app and tap Settings. This option will be available after keyboard is activated
• Available settings: sound on key press, vibrate on key press, emoji row, number row
Using the clipboard:
• The clipboard lets you save text that you frequently use and paste them easily
• After you copy any text, it can be viewed from the clipboard by tapping on "Paste copied text". You can use the Pin button to save it permanently
• To show copied text automatically when clipboard is opened, you can change the "Paste from Other Apps" setting to "Allow"
Using stickers to make your chats more fun:
• Open the stickers page by clicking on the sticker icon on the keyboard. Click on any sticker you like to copy it
• Navigate back to your chat app and use your phone's Paste option in the message box
• The sticker will be pasted in the chat. Note that animations are currently sent as GIFs due to technical limitations
Do share your feedback and help us improve Desh Marathi Keyboard. And don't forget to leave a review if you like it.

bluejetty:00185971:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00185971:ios.description:
Is the movie really over?
We've all been there. The movie ends, the credits start rolling, and you're wondering whether you should stick around or head for the exit.
Is there a scene during the credits? What about after? And even if there is one, is it actually worth waiting for?
That's where After Credits comes in.
Look up a movie in seconds and find out if there's anything during or after the credits. No guessing, no awkwardly standing in the aisle, and no sitting through ten minutes of credits just to find out there was nothing.
What you can do:
+ Know when to stay. See whether a movie has scenes during or after the credits.
+ See if it's worth the wait. Check what other moviegoers thought, and cast your own vote.
+ Find movies fast. Browse what's in theaters, check new releases, or search thousands of movies.
+ Avoid spoilers (or don't). Scene descriptions stay hidden until you choose to reveal them.
Help keep things up to date. Submit missing movies and suggest corrections to help others find what they're looking for.
After Credits is powered by moviegoers like you. Every submission, correction, and vote helps the next person decide whether to stay in their seat.
Because sometimes the best part of the movie happens after everyone else leaves.

bluejetty:00034022:ios.description:
Discover the power of Rock Identifier, your all-in-one Rock & Crystal Scanner for identifying stones, gems, minerals, and crystals. Whether you're a seasoned geologist or a curious beginner, Rock Identifier transforms your device into an intelligent rock scanner that unlocks the secrets of Earth's treasures.
Instant Rock & Crystal Identification
Simply take a photo or upload an image of any rock, crystal, or mineral, and our advanced AI will provide you with accurate results in seconds. Rock Id can recognize over 6,000 types of rocks and minerals!
Comprehensive Stone Information
Each Rock identification includes:
• Rock type and specific name
• Mineral composition
• Texture and hardness
• Color variations
• Formation process
• Geological age
• Common uses
• Locations where it can be found
AI Accuracy
Our Rock Identifier provides a confidence level for each identification, ensuring reliable results for your rock hunting adventures.
Gemstone Authentication Guide
Learn to distinguish real from fake gemstones with our practical identification methods, considering factors like color, cleavage, fracture, touch, shape, and transparency.
Rock & Crystal Encyclopedia
Explore our extensive database of stones, crystals, and minerals. Discover healing properties, zodiac connections, and fascinating facts about each specimen.
Personal Rock Collection Manager
Build and organize your digital rock collection within Rock Identifier. Add notes, create wishlists, and track your geological discoveries.
Join over 1 million rock enthusiasts who have already discovered the wonders of the mineral world with Rock Identifier! Whether you're a rock hound, crystal collector, or geology student, our Rock & Crystal Scanner is your ultimate companion for mineral exploration and learning.
Download Rock Identifier now and embark on your journey to become a rock expert! Uncover the stories hidden within every stone, crystal, and mineral you encounter.

bluejetty:00007093:ios.description:
