bluejetty:00043200:ios.description:
Avec SG Connect, l’appli mobile des filiales africaines de Société Générale, gérée par Société Générale African Business Services, Gérer votre compte simplement, rapidement et en toute sécurité !
AVANTAGES 
L'appli mobile SG Connect simplifie votre relation avec la banque :
1. Facilitation du quotidien : Plus besoin de me déplacer en agence pour mes opérations courantes. Le service est disponible 24/7.
2. Temps réel : mes opérations sont traitées de manière instantanée (en temps réel) 
3. Sécurité : L’accès à l’application mobile ainsi que la validation de toutes opérations transactionnelles exigent systématiquement la saisie d’un mot de passe. 
4. Simplicité d’utilisation : L’application est facile d’usage avec une interface ergonomique et intuitive qui rend la navigation fluide.
ESPACES
L’appli mobile m’offre deux espaces de navigation : 
- Un espace Public : je peux y accéder sans authentification et bénéficier d’un ensemble de services pratiques (géo localisation d’une agence ou d’un Distributeur Automatique de Billets (DAB), consultation des contacts utiles, consultation du cours des devises, …)
- mon espace sécurisé : il suffit que j’active mon compte pour y accéder de manière sécurisée et bénéficier de toutes les fonctionnalités liées à la gestion de mes comptes bancaires. Je peux consulter mes comptes, …
FONCTIONNALITES
L’appli mobile m’offre plusieurs fonctionnalités : 
- Consulter le solde et l’historique de mes comptes (courant et épargne), 
- Télécharger votre RIB ;
- Recap des Opérations, 
- Géolocaliser une agence ou un distributeur automatique de billets ;
- Mise à disposition d’un catalogue de produits pour découvrir les offres et services de la banque.
- Fonctionnalité Bourse en ligne pour consulter les marchés, passer vos ordres et suivre vos portefeuilles.
... Et bien d'autres services à découvrir

bluejetty:00061931:ios.description:
AdaptiBar MCQ Simulator leads the industry as the only bar prep provider to offer the combination of licensed MBE questions from the National Conference of Bar Examiners (NCBE) and patented adaptive technology that adjusts to each individual user’s studying needs. AdaptiBar continuously assesses your performance and automatically adjusts the presentation of questions to focus in on your areas of weaknesses (e.g. Negligence) without neglecting an area of strength. You will know at any given time exactly which areas you need to make improvements. 
To date, thousands of law students worldwide have successfully prepared for the bar exam with AdaptiBar. To employ the most effective bar preparation method ever, supplement your comprehensive bar review course with AdaptiBar. 
Study on the go with the AdaptiBar app designed for iOS devices. The progress you make on the app is tracked and automatically synchronized with the main program. As long as you have an active program session, you’ll be able to: 
• Answer Practice Questions
• Create Customized Practice Exams
• Take the NCBE Online Practice Exams
• Analyze MCQ Performance Statistics
  o Subject Performance graph
  o Timing Performance graph
  o View Exam Reports
  o Review Past Questions 
  o Check your Question Progress
• Review substantive Flashcards
• Watch substantive Video Lectures (optional upgrade)**
Wi-Fi internet access is recommended for login and downloading. 
Existing program user? 
Simply download AdaptiBar’s app and log in using the same email address and password. 
Not yet enrolled? 
Visit www.adaptibar.com to enroll today. 
** Enhanced Options include: MBE Video Lectures. User must upgrade to access the optional features on the app. 
Please Note:
• Writing Guide and Critical Pass digital experience are not included in the AdaptiBar mobile app.
• AdaptiBar Test Drive (free trial) users are only able to log in on the main website, www.adaptibar.com. Access to the AdaptiBar App is available for the full program only.

bluejetty:00073224:ios.description:
Hello.
My name is Eden and ever since "that day", I have been living a wandering life, looking for a shelter, town, or mansion for survival.
Due to many people's selfishness, our environment and town have been destroyed and became a wasteland with no love or any pies to eat. 
All houses, all cities, every single mansion are completely destroyed.
Living alone in this world full of chaos is very exhausting and lonely.
Can I possibly survive in a place like this...?
Hey, you there! I think you can help me find a shelter for survival! A mansion could be even better. 
Could you please help me out so I can travel through desolated town, and stay safe and survive in this world of misery?
In "Merge Survival", you can experience the life of surviving in the post-apocalypse world created by environmental pollution and disasters.
Merge to create survival materials among desolated towns, and find any new resources or hidden locations by traveling town to town.
Create an "Eco-Friendly Camp" to live in harmony with nature and other survivors.
Do you love survival games, and merge games? Then begin right away!
■ "Merge"to create various survival items and your shelter.
- Merge, merge, merge.. Enjoy creating various survival tools by merging abandoned resources.
- Complete quests with the created survival tools, merge food such as pies to help Eden build a cozy shelter.
- Learn the meaning of resource recycling, and complete your item collection.
■ A "survival" story of the ones who live in the "Post-Apocalypse".
- An interesting story of encounters, conflicts, and living together with other survivors will unfold.
- Aren't you curious about the stories of people and animals you meet in despair? 
■ Build your safe "shelter", travel and explore to find the hidden locations.
- Build a production facility to "recycle" resources or acquire special resources.
- Find hidden locations, travel devastated towns to find special resources by exploring with your friends.
Maybe you can even encounter a mansion. 
■ Enjoy the "strategy" of finding the materials you need for survival.
- Have fun by strategically collecting survival essentials such as water and oxygen.
- Merge pies and chocolates to keep your energy up.
Are you into survival games and merge games?
Then start "Merge Survival : Wasteland" now!
Merge right away to build your safe zone! A cozy camp with friends is much better than a luxurious mansion. 
We request permission to access memory for a stable game progress.
- Customer Support : Settings>Customer Support
 mergesurvival@stickyhands.oqupie.com
- Join our community (Official Facebook page):
https://www.facebook.com/mergesurvival.official

bluejetty:00153285:ios.description:
Tired of confusing labels and misleading claims? Instantly reveal what's really in your food and cosmetic products with a single scan. Lumin is your unbiased, science-backed guide to shopping with total confidence.
From the grocery aisle to the beauty counter, Lumin illuminates ingredient lists so you can make healthier, safer choices for you and your family. Our comprehensive database and easy-to-understand health scores empower you to cut through the marketing noise and understand the true impact of any product.
WHY YOU'LL LOVE LUMIN:
UNIFIED SCANNING: Why use two apps when you only need one? Seamlessly scan barcodes on both food products and cosmetics. Lumin is the only ingredient checker you'll ever need.
INSTANT HEALTH SCORES: Get a simple, color-coded health score for every item. Our analysis goes beyond calories to assess ingredient quality, the presence of controversial additives, and nutritional balance.
DECODE ANY INGREDIENT: Tap on any ingredient to learn what it is, its purpose, and its potential health concerns, all explained in plain English and backed by scientific sources. Decode food labels and cosmetic lists with ease.
FIND HEALTHIER ALTERNATIVES: Scanned a product with a poor rating? Don't worry. Lumin instantly suggests better, cleaner alternatives for you to purchase instead, helping you build a truly healthy shopping list.
A 100% INDEPENDENT PROJECT: Our analysis and recommendations are completely objective and based on scientific evidence. We do not partner with brands or accept advertising. Our only commitment is to your health and transparency.
PERFECT FOR YOUR LIFESTYLE:
Whether you're a parent looking to avoid harmful food additives, a clean beauty advocate searching for non-toxic skincare, or managing a specific dietary need like a gluten or dairy allergy, Lumin is built for you. Our goal is to make healthy shopping simple for everyone.
LUMIN PRO:
• You can subscribe to get unlimited access to certain app features.
• Subscriptions are billed automatically at the rate depending on the selected subscription plan.
Download Lumin today and stop guessing. It's time to shop with total confidence.
By using the app, you are agreeing to the Terms of Use

bluejetty:00163016:ios.description:
INTAXI – IL TUO TAXI
Oltre 7.600 taxi a tua disposizione per chiamare subito o prenotare in anticipo nelle principali città italiane. Con InTaxi ti basta un tap.
PERCHÉ SCEGLIERE INTAXI
- Chiami il taxi con un solo click.
- Prenoti il tuo viaggio in anticipo.
- Scegli il tipo di auto: fino a 7 passeggeri, e opzioni per il trasporto di piccoli animali in gabbietta.
- Personalizzi la corsa in base alle tue esigenze: preferisci un’auto bassa o alta? Ti serve più spazio per i bagagli? Vuoi un autista che parli inglese? Con InTaxi selezioni il taxi ideale tra le opzioni disponibili.
- Notifica immediata quando troviamo il taxi più vicino a te.
- Segui il taxi in tempo reale sulla mappa mentre sta arrivando.
- Paghi in app con carta di credito personale o aziendale, oppure con l’abbonamento business Globix, con un’unica fattura a fine mese.

bluejetty:00064100:ios.description:
Sing, duet, and create music on Smule, a creative singing platform built to help you grow your voice with confidence. Join others in duets for free, or unlock solo recording when you are ready to practice, learn, and craft your sound.
Explore 15 million+ songs across pop, rock, R&B, country, K-pop, musicals, and more. Smule gives you the space to practice, improve, and explore your voice at your own pace, whether you are singing for fun or working toward becoming a better singer.
On Smule, you can begin by joining existing duets with singers from around the world at no cost. Singing together is a low pressure way to start, helping you learn by doing while building confidence through shared performances. With a VIP subscription, you can unlock solo recording and start your own duets or group songs, giving you more control to practice independently, refine performances, and shape your sound.
Smule offers one of the largest karaoke song libraries available, with new songs added regularly. You can also sing recorded duets alongside official tracks from global superstars. Smule lets you join pre recorded duet performances featuring artists like Ed Sheeran, Dua Lipa, Olivia Rodrigo, and Disney favorites, so you can learn songs you love and feel part of the music.
As you sing, Smule helps you improve naturally over time. You can practice with pitch guidance, adjust song keys to better fit your vocal range, and experiment with harmonies, layers, and arrangements. Whether you are practicing solo, joining duets, or creating group songs, Smule supports progress at every stage of your singing journey.
Smule uses studio quality audio and voice effects to support creativity without replacing your unique sound. You can enhance recordings with reverb, filters, and vocal effects, explore optional AI powered tools to refine tone and range, and experiment freely while keeping your voice authentic. These tools are designed to help you learn, improve, and gain confidence as you sing.
Smule is a global community of singers in more than 190 countries. You can join duets, create group songs, discover new artists and styles, participate in live singing sessions, or share performances when you feel ready. Many singers start by practicing and joining duets, then gradually unlock more creative options as their confidence grows.
Smule is built for every kind of singer, from curious first timers and casual karaoke fans to aspiring artists developing their voice. There is no single right way to use Smule. You choose how you practice, how you perform, and how far you want to go.
Smule is more than a karaoke app. It is a creative platform for learning to sing, practicing with purpose, building confidence, and growing through solo recordings, duets, and musical collaboration, powered by smart tools and a supportive global community. Download Smule and start singing today.

Get unlimited access to Smule’s full karaoke song catalog and sing karaoke solos, duets, groups, or acapella. Subscriptions are available weekly, monthly, or yearly. listings.description:
Sing, duet, and create music on Smule, a creative singing platform built to help you grow your voice with confidence. Join others in duets for free, or unlock solo recording when you are ready to practice, learn, and craft your sound.

Explore 15 million+ songs across pop, rock, R&B, country, K-pop, musicals, and more. Smule gives you the space to practice, improve, and explore your voice at your own pace, whether you are singing for fun or working toward becoming a better singer.

On Smule, you can begin by joining existing duets with singers from around the world at no cost. Singing together is a low pressure way to start, helping you learn by doing while building confidence through shared performances. With a VIP subscription, you can unlock solo recording and start your own duets or group songs, giving you more control to practice independently, refine performances, and shape your sound.

Smule offers one of the largest karaoke song libraries available, with new songs added regularly. You can also sing recorded duets alongside official tracks from global superstars. Smule lets you join pre recorded duet performances featuring artists like Ed Sheeran, Dua Lipa, Olivia Rodrigo, and Disney favorites, so you can learn songs you love and feel part of the music.

As you sing, Smule helps you improve naturally over time. Whether you are practicing solo, joining duets, or creating group songs, Smule supports progress at every stage of your singing journey.

Smule uses studio quality audio and voice effects to support creativity without replacing your unique sound. You can enhance recordings with reverb, filters, and vocal effects, explore optional AI powered tools to refine tone and range, and experiment freely while keeping your voice authentic. Mobiles Tycoon is a brand new game about creating your mobile devices: smartphones and tablets. In the game you have to manage your company and develop your devices (smartphones and tablets), operating systems and processors. Research new technologies, upgrade your office and your factory, hire the best employees, invest in marketing, or save money and buy one of the computer giants!
Mobiles Tycoon gives you almost complete freedom of action. Create smartpones and tablets from scratch by selecting the desired characteristics and design. The game has a lot of features that are not found in other games of this genre, such as Smartphones Tycoon or Devices Tycoon: detailed statistics of your company and products, intelligent algorithms for evaluating products and behavior of companies, interactive operating systems created by the player that you can test. 
Also in the game there are:
* 3000+ technologies for research
* Challenging mode for fans of economic strategies
* Smart behavior of competitors, automatic development and release of products
* The ability to run the OS on your gaming smartphone
* 10 levels of office improvement with beautiful 3D models
* Many ways to invest your money, including buying companies, marketing, paid employee search
* Many smartphone designs 
* Cloud synchronization
Mobiles Tycoon is a business simulator game that is worth your attention and is a serious player among economic strategies.

HiLo House is where you come to sweat, sculpt and strengthen your entire body on two of the most effective and efficient human-powered machines on the market. Our machines are high-intensity, yet low impact.

We also offer combination classes that consist of 25 minutes on the Versaclimber and 25 minutes of upper body, lower body or core work on the Megaformer.
Our Classes are sweat dripping, heart-pounding, soul searching, comfort zone crushing, total body workouts that remind you to show up, stay humble and work hard.
Our classes are:
Less than an hour
Created for ALL levels of fitness
HiLo House is a radically inclusive community that is built on passion, movement and comradery!
Download our app so we can become better together, one drop of sweat at a time! Welcome to the HiLo House Squad!

bluejetty:00039922:ios.description:
Salto JustIN Mobile access technology simplifies the users and dynamic key management process of users in a building. Receiving a key generated electronically on their smartphone, previously identified and authorized by the system, they can unlock the assigned doors from the JustIN Mobile app by selecting the appropriate key.
Technologically cutting-edge, JustIN Mobile means the end of lost key hassles, expenses and waste. Plus, the technology isn't limited to one building or hotel room - it can also be used by staff and users on multiple sites for any kind of access types like main entrance doors, elevators, car park barriers, meeting rooms, etc.
Combined with user-convenient features such as user friendly design or multi key possibilities to use the same app in different buildings, locations and for different applications, JustIN Mobile access control technology simplifies card issuing, fob and traditional PIN code management that can be lost, forgotten or broken by offering flexibility for diverse applications. People do not forget their phones as they forget their keys and, if lost, they are replaced rapidly. This is a major benefit for administrators, clients, and users.

Salto is a leading global access solutions provider, part of the SALTO WECOSYSTEM.
We develop pioneering facility access, identity management and electronic locking technology that ensures seamless, reliable and secure experiences.
Through close customer relationships and innovative solutions, our global team of experts create timeless and meaningful products that positively impact people and planet.
Stay connected with @saltosystems

bluejetty:00114313:ios.description:
Squiggles is a paint and image app for the iPhone. 
***** Temp price reduction. More info below. Can run on IOS 5****
Currently running on iPhone 4s and iPad 2 with OS 5 despite some incorrect user reviews. If you do have a problem please report it using support button in app. 
Take a photo or select an image with your iPhone and doodle on it. Or decorate with the many overlay images and special stamp brushes. Or start with a plain background and create art.
Update in progress. Current version supports original iPhone resolution (480 x 320). Works on all iPhones and iPads but doesn't use high resolution. Works on OS's include OS 5.
Squiggles received a Grade A recommendation from Best Kids Apps and "Best" award by iPhoneAppsPlus.com
FEATURED TWICE ON APPLE STAFF PICKS AND ON WHAT'S NEW.
Actual reviews from real users:
This is a fantastic art package that enables you to create some sophisticated looking artwork with ease. The tools are useful and well thought out. I love doodling and with this package I can produce doodles that look like they should be hung in art galleries. Amazing.
I like this app, useful for quickly drawing a Kanji for my host mother, as well as editing screenshots... Very nice. Good job Superb tool for the iphone. Hey this thing is so cool that I get on it or try to get on it every day. :)
 Fantastic App! You can do so much with this, a lot of thought has gone into making Squiggles. The clone feature works great, smoothing feature is a God send, set finger offset is also a God send. The list goes on and on! If I could give this app more than 5 stars I would, peeps you really need this app in your lives! Awesome!!!
This is reallllyyy fun! You can make pictures and email them to friends! It's great! It's worth more than it costs!
------
Please send any bug reports to squigglessupport@gmail.com so we can make sure to address your problems. 
Squiggles is a paint and image program specifically designed for the iPhone. Whether you need to make a sketch to get your ideas down, have fun with your photos, flex your artistic side or just plain doodle while waiting in line, Squiggles is ready. Paint on provided backgrounds, any photos on your iPhone or take photos in Squiggles and add notations or enhancements. 
Check the demo video on the website.
Squiggles comes with hard, soft and specialty brushes.
Undo. Erase on Shake.

bluejetty:00069448:ios.description:
Pick a design you love, then make it yours. Widgy brings custom widgets to your Home Screen, Lock Screen and Apple Watch, built around your style and the information you care about.
START WITH A COMMUNITY DESIGN
Explore widgets shared by the Widgy community. Import a design, personalize it, or create your own from scratch.
MAKE THE DETAILS YOURS
Arrange text, photos, symbols, shapes and charts in layers. Adjust colors, fonts, gradients and layout while you see the result in the editor.
PUT YOUR DAY AT A GLANCE
Create clocks, weather displays, calendars and countdowns. Bring together reminders, activity data and other information in a layout that works for you. Available data depends on the sources and permissions you choose.
GO BEYOND THE HOME SCREEN
Create Lock Screen widgets and personalize your Apple Watch with Watchy. Explore Live Activities and Dynamic Island layouts on supported devices. Features vary by device and operating system.
BUILD SOMETHING MORE
Use charts, gauges and custom data sources to create detailed dashboards. Share your widgets with a QR code, a link or a file, and discover more designs from other creators.
Try Widgy for free. Optional in-app purchases unlock additional widget slots and features.
HEALTH AND PERMISSIONS
With your permission, Widgy can display data from Apple Health. Health access and other permissions are optional and depend on the widgets you choose.
Widget designs featured in screenshots and app previews: @homescreen_design_marco, @Ahmadansari2233 and pauljima.

Petfolk is a new model of veterinary care, built by vets who love pets. 
Petfolk integrates everything pets and their parents need in their journey — from scheduled on-site to access-anywhere virtual care. We believe the easier the experience is for the parent, the healthier and happier the pet.

bluejetty:00026746:ios.name: (Not Boring) Weather
bluejetty:00026746:ios.summary:
~ WEATHER DOESN’T HAVE TO BE BORING ~
The simple weather app that’s winning awards (Apple Design Award, Best Weather Apps) and impressing tastemakers (MKBHD, Fast Company).
~ PLAYFUL YET FUNCTIONAL DESIGN ~
Turn your daily weather forecast
bluejetty:00026746:ios.description:
~ WEATHER DOESN’T HAVE TO BE BORING ~
The simple weather app that’s winning awards (Apple Design Award, Best Weather Apps) and impressing tastemakers (MKBHD, Fast Company).
~ PLAYFUL YET FUNCTIONAL DESIGN ~
Turn your daily weather forecast into a memorable experience with a next-generation user interface design inspired by 3D video games. Feel the rain, hear the thunder, and watch the wind blow across your screen in vivid detail.
~ TOP WEATHER SOURCES ~
Powered by local data from the best weather sources like Accuweather, Foreca, Apple Weather, and the National Weather Service for the most local, most accurate forecasts.
~ MORE DETAILED ~
Explore every aspect of the weather for rich details on temperature changes, air quality (AQI), pollen reports, cloud cover, visibility, wind direction, rainfall, humidity, UV index, and much more. 
~ MINUTE FORECASTS™ ~
Designed for precise forecasts down to the minute. Know exactly when the downpour will start or when the dark sky will clear.
~ WIDGETS ~
Bring real-time weather data to your home screen and lock screen with simple widgets. Get frequent updates on the day’s temperature, conditions, rain, air quality, UV index, and wind conditions as they happen.
~ SEVERE WEATHER ALERTS ~
Keep an eye on severe weather alerts and be prepared for the next heat wave, storm tracking, flood risk, hurricane, blizzard, and more.
~ MOON PHASES ~
Astronomical moon phases and illumination. It’s simple to see when the next full moon and new moon are expected.
~ AIR QUALITY & POLLEN ~
Prepare for the outdoors with air quality index (AQI) and pollen forecasts. See AQI scores and pollen levels over the coming hours or days.
~ CUSTOM APP ICONS & SKINS ~
Collect app icons and custom skins that change the design of the entire app to match your mood. New icons, skins, and artist collaborations dropping regularly to keep your routine fresh.
~ MINIGAME & SURPRISES ~
Say hello to Cloudburst to pass the time or see how many hidden surprises you can find.
~ FREE OR UPGRADE ~
!Weather™ is free to use for as long as you need. Upgrade for realtime widgets, faster forecasts, more in-depth weather data like AQI and pollen, free skins, app icons, and wallpapers.
~ SUPER !BORING ~
Become a member and unlock access to all 5 Not Boring apps, skins, app icons, wallpapers, and more. We’re 100% member-supported. No ads, no data tracking.
Plans: https://notboring.software/plans
Support: https://notboring.software/support

bluejetty:00063300:ios.description:
**You must own a Synology NAS to run this app, and be running the Audio Station 6.5.0 package to get the complete set of features**
DS audio allows you to stream music stored on your DiskStation with an iPhone/iPad wherever an Internet connection is available. Better yet, with the offline mode you can listen to songs stored in the device’s local memory for when no network connection is available. You can browse music by albums, artists, folders or genres, create your own playlists or share them with your friends, and even rate your music! And if you have dedicated stereo speakers at home, DS audio can also become a remote control to stream music to them. 
Find all detailed features about the app on our website:
www.synology.com > NAS > DSM 7.1 > Apps > Mobile Apps > Software Specs
https://www.synology.com/en-global/dsm/7.1/software_spec/video_station#affiliated_utility__ds_video_mobile__feature

bluejetty:00187209:ios.description:
Join over 20,000 businesses across 170 countries that trust Sonetel for a professional phone presence—whether you need a local number in the US/Canada or beyond. Make calls showing your Sonetel number, forward incoming calls to your mobile, and power up your communication with AI-driven summaries, transcripts, and voicemail insights.
Key Features
• Local Business Number – Present a professional identity with a number in your city or any of 80 countries.
• Make Calls with Your Sonetel Number – Show a consistent caller ID to customers for a polished, unified brand image.
• Call Forwarding – Never miss a call by forwarding it to your mobile or landline wherever you are.
• AI Call Summaries & Transcripts – Stay organized by automatically capturing key points of every call.
• Call Analysis – Get instant feedback on call effectiveness and tips for better engagement.
• Follow-Up Email Drafts – Save time and reduce misunderstandings with AI-generated summaries of agreements and next steps.
• AI Voicemail Summaries – Receive concise, actionable overviews of voicemail messages, including the caller’s mood.
• Voice Response (IVR) – Greet callers with a professional menu—e.g., “Press 1 for Sales…”—and direct them effectively.
Download Sonetel and take your business communications to the next level. Learn more at sonetel.com.

bluejetty:00188209:ios.description:
Liturgie vous propose chaque jour les textes officiels de la liturgie catholique publiés par l'AELF.
Tous les textes — bréviaire, messe et Bible — sont issus de la traduction officielle de l'AELF (Association Épiscopale Liturgique pour les pays Francophones), la référence pour la liturgie en langue française.
Bréviaire — Priez la liturgie des Heures à votre rythme. L'application vous propose automatiquement l'office correspondant à l'heure de la journée : Laudes, Tierce, Sexte, None, Vêpres, Complies et Office des lectures.
Messe — Suivez les lectures et prières de la messe du jour dans la traduction de l'AELF. Un mode missel intègre les dialogues et les textes de l'ordinaire, idéal pour ceux qui découvrent la messe ou souhaitent mieux y participer.
Bible AELF — Explorez l'intégralité de la Bible dans la traduction liturgique. Parcourez l'Ancien Testament, le Nouveau Testament et les Psaumes livre par livre, chapitre par chapitre. Une recherche avancée vous permet de retrouver instantanément n'importe quel passage. Depuis le bréviaire ou la messe, un simple appui sur une référence biblique vous emmène directement au texte complet.
Hors connexion — Pas besoin de réseau. L'application télécharge pour vous en arrière-plan les textes des jours à venir. La Bible complète est disponible en permanence, même sans connexion.
Personnalisable — Adaptez l'application à votre usage : taille et police du texte, thème clair, sombre, choix de votre zone liturgique.
Cette application utilise les textes de la liturgie catholique publiés par l'AELF.

bluejetty:00174746:ios.summary: Are you going through the motions, pursuing goals that don't bring you real joy? Do you feel disconnected from who you truly are, caught up in what society says you should be doing? Does it feel like you're drifting, unsure of what truly ma
bluejetty:00174746:ios.description:
Are you going through the motions, pursuing goals that don't bring you real joy? Do you feel disconnected from who you truly are, caught up in what society says you should be doing? Does it feel like you're drifting, unsure of what truly matters to you, and longing for a deeper sense of purpose in your daily life?
It doesn’t have to be that way. Imagine creating the time and space for what truly matters. Picture ending each day with the satisfaction of knowing, “I’m living my life on purpose.” Inspired by approaches from Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), Elixir becomes your life coach, guiding you from daily priorities to life-changing decisions.
With Elixir, you will:
- Discover your core values and true motivations.
- Define your life's direction with meaningful goals.
- Build purpose-driven habits and skills.
- Create genuine, sustainable life balance.
- Unleash your most authentic and powerful self.
Your time is precious. Spend it living a life of meaning.
GO BEYOND EMPTY GOALS & BURNOUT
Tired of chasing goals that feel hollow or abandoning checklists that don't truly motivate you? Elixir flips the script. Instead of focusing on what to achieve, you’ll first connect with why it matters. We help you illuminate your innermost values, turning them into a powerful compass that’s uniquely yours. When your actions are aligned with your authentic self, motivation flows naturally, free from the pressure of what other people think you should be doing.
CONNECT TO YOUR CORE VALUES
Core values are always a part of who you are, but they can become lost in the distraction of the daily grind. Step back and reconnect with them. When you’re guided by your core values, there’s no need to rely on intense self-discipline. Making the right choices for you becomes simple. You’ll stop procrastinating and reclaim your power to act. Reveal the confidence and clarity that have been waiting inside you all along — even when you face difficulties and challenges. Overcome obstacles and live with intention.
COMMIT TO ACTION
Once you know what’s important, Elixir keeps you focused. Follow through with one-time actions that help you achieve long-term goals. Develop habits, routines, and rituals to live meaningfully. When you take a deep dive into your core values, you naturally begin to shape your time to build a fulfilling life.
CRAFT A LIFE OF MEANING
It’s not about simply creating a better you; it’s about revealing your thriving, true self that’s always been there. Your core values guide your daily priorities, taking you on a path to living with purpose. Elixir is your compass, helping you navigate the trails.
Maximize your time with bite-sized content:
1. Pathways: Follow step-by-step guides to bring your core values to life. Learn how to use your values to handle difficult times with more ease. Navigate challenges and set authentic goals that and inspire you.
2. Your Daily Elixir: Each day you’ll receive your Daily Elixir of personalized insights or reflections to anchor you in your core values and purpose. It’s a simple ritual to help you live with intention, find deeper satisfaction, and quiet self-doubt.
3. Coaching with AI capabilities: Get inspired on-demand. Access a library of bite-sized audio sessions on topics like overcoming procrastination, reigniting your passions, and designing your future. Each session, a drop of wisdom to spark motivation.
WHO WE ARE
Assessed by psychologists and behavioral science experts, Elixir is from the creators of Fabulous, an award-winning app. Through the power of behavior science, we’ve already helped millions of people worldwide develop life-changing habits. Now we’re helping people find greater life balance, reach life goals, and maximize their personal growth.
Discover what happens when you live a purpose-driven life.
-------
Read our full terms and conditions and our privacy policy at: https://www.thefabulous.co/terms.html

bluejetty:00076439:ios.description:
The ReSound Smart 3D app lets you control your hearing aids directly from your mobile device. You can change programs, and make simple or more advanced sound adjustments and save them as favorites. The app helps you learn what you can do and how to do it. It can even help you find your hearing aids if you lose them. Last, but not least, you can have your hearing care professional update your hearing aid programs and send you new hearing aid software without taking a trip to the clinic.
Notes: Please contact your local ReSound representative for product and feature availability in your market. We recommend that the hearing aids run the latest software version. If in doubt, please contact your hearing care professional.
ReSound Smart 3D mobile device compatibility:
Please consult the ReSound app website for up-to-date compatibility information: www.resound.com/compatibility. 
Use the ReSound Smart 3D app to: 
• Enjoy optimization anywhere with ReSound Assist: Request help with your hearing aid settings from your hearing care professional and receive new settings and software updates. 
And use these direct control and personalization options:
• Adjust volume settings on your hearing aids
• Mute your hearing aids
• Adjust volume of your optionally acquired ReSound streaming accessories
• Adjust speech focus as well as noise and wind-noise levels with Sound Enhancer (feature availability depends on your hearing aid model and the fitting by your hearing care professional) 
• Change manual and streamer programs
• Edit and personalize program names 
• Adjust treble, middle and bass tones to your preferences
• Save your preferred settings as a Favorite – you can even tag to a location
• Monitor the battery status of your rechargeable hearing aids
• Help locate lost or misplaced hearing aids
• Tinnitus manager: Adjust sound variation and frequency of the Tinnitus Sound Generator. Select Nature Sounds (feature availability depends on your hearing aid model and the fitting by your hearing care professional) 
For more information please visit www.resound.com/smart3Dapp or the support site via the link in the app store.

Why should you choose Notes: notepad and lists?
- 3 in 1
Replace your to-do list, notepad and memos with this simple, all-in-one app.
- Easy to use
Notes: notepad and lists is an extremely simple and intuitive app. No instructions or tutorial necessary.
- Fast
Create a note or a list in literally seconds - the perfect way to jot down important information. A notepad, diary and to-do list that suits your face-paced lifestyle.
- Multiple formats
Create notes from photos, images, and voice messages, and make your to-do list or shopping list. Use it on the go, or even behind the wheel - all you have to do is record your message or take a photo.
- Editing

- Planning

- Sorting
You can sort your notes by urgency, category, due date, and color, so searching through your content is quick and easy.
- Security
Notes: notepad and lists lets you protect your personal data with a short security-code, meaning only you can access your notes and lists.
- Transfer your info
If you get a new device, you won't lose your information - registered users can restore their data.

bluejetty:00138048:ios.name: ScanGo - PDF Document Scanner
bluejetty:00138048:ios.summary:
WHAT IS ScanGo?
ScanGo is a little, simple, flexible, easy-to-use app with kinds of features satisfying different situations in your iPhone. It allows you to scan documents, certificates, credit cards, invoices, receipts, tickets and any pa
bluejetty:00138048:ios.description:
WHAT IS ScanGo?
ScanGo is a little, simple, flexible, easy-to-use app with kinds of features satisfying different situations in your iPhone. It allows you to scan documents, certificates, credit cards, invoices, receipts, tickets and any paper with high quality image & PDF output. Also, you can extract text by OCR function from any scans just by one tap.
It is also a camera scanner with concise, efficient user interface whose main tone is black & white with teal & chrome yellow embellished throughout the app. 
HOW TO SCAN DOCS?
- Scan everything by one click, of course you can choose to scan from Photos or Camera.
- Edit docs after scanning immediately, including add, rotate, adjust, reorder and delete pages.
- Rotate, Crop and Adjust filter to get high quality scans.
- Provided five filter modes to enhance your scans - Original, B&W 1, B&W 2, Color, Grayscale. What’s more, each filter can be adjusted for its own Brightness, Contrast, Saturation and Sharpness.
HOW TO MANAGE DOCS?
- The Recents module on home page shows your recently added docs, which helps to find them faster.
- Add folders and sub-folders to manage scanned docs.
- Rename folders and documents to make them more distinguishable.
- Important and urgent documents can be Starred for faster access.
- Search function helps to find the doc you need from a dizzying array.
- Every folder, doc and page can be shared with email, Dropbox, Google Drive, Evernote etc. or Wifi directly.
- Save scans as JPEG to Photos.
- Move/Copy/Delete docs and pages.
- Print scans directly within app once you connect to a Printer.
- Fax scans directly if you have Fax Pro app installed.
AFRAID OF DATA LOSS?
ScanGo supports syncing data with iCloud. 
MAKE THE APP MORE EFFICIENT
CONVENIENT - Turn on the camera immediately whenever you open the app.
HANDY - Save scans to Photos automatically.
EASY - Auto edge detection and enhancement.
SIMPLE - Share docs and folders in default PDF size.
SECURE - Protect your documents with passcode.
MORE QUESTIONS?
If you have any problems with ScanGo, please email us at scango@beesoft.io, we’ll help to figure it out asap.

bluejetty:00146627:ios.description:
Welcome to "Zombie Survival Apocalypse" - where your daily commute involves dodging the undead and banking on survival! In this exhilarating mobile game, you step into the shoes of a survivor navigating a world swamped with aggressively social, yet unfriendly, zombies. Armed to the teeth with firearms, your mission is to turn these walking dead into walking dead-er, earning cash with every brain-busting victory.
But that's not all! Your hard-earned zombie cash isn't just for keeping score. Deposit it in the bank and watch your wealth grow, then splurge on upgrading your skills and arsenal. From shotguns that would make a grown zombie cry to gadgets that would make a tech geek weep, you'll need all the firepower you can get to face the fearsome bosses. Each level challenges you with a new breed of 'management-level' zombies – tougher, smarter, and with more annoying post-life crisis behaviors.
Customization is key to your survival strategy. Change your character's appearance to suit your mood, from battle-hardened warrior to beach-ready zombie slayer. Each character comes with their unique style and flair, perfectly suited for the apocalypse fashionista in you.
"Zombie Survival Apocalypse" is not just a game; it's a lifestyle choice for those who prefer their apocalypse with a side of humor and a dash of financial planning. Are you ready to shoot, loot, and deposit your way through the apocalypse? Download now and let the undead know who's boss!

bluejetty:00089735:ios.name: Resume AI Cover Letter Builder
bluejetty:00089735:ios.summary: Creating resumes and professional correspondence no longer requires filling out complicated forms. Resume AI helps you quickly prepare documents tailored to a specific job opening. Create resumes and letters, edit the results in the app, an
bluejetty:00089735:ios.description:
Creating resumes and professional correspondence no longer requires filling out complicated forms. Resume AI helps you quickly prepare documents tailored to a specific job opening. Create resumes and letters, edit the results in the app, and save your finished documents as PDFs.
App features and sections:
1. Resume Templates
Browse professionally designed resume templates available to download and edit in Keynote and PowerPoint formats. Choose a layout that suits you and customize it with your own information.
2. Resume Generator
Enter your name and describe your experience, skills, and education in your own words. You can also use a saved resume or import text from a file instead of entering everything again.
The Job Requirements field is optional, but recommended. Paste a job description from a listing so AI can tailor your resume to the employer’s requirements and include relevant keywords used by applicant tracking systems (ATS).
AI organizes your information into a complete, editable draft. Preview your formatted resume in the app, edit any field, and export the result as a multipage PDF.
3. Letter Generator
Create documents for different stages of your job search. Use information from a saved resume or enter your details manually. Choose from five document types:
- Cover Letter
- Thank-You Letter after an interview
- About Me Presentation
- Follow-Up Letter
- Cold Outreach Letter to a recruiter or prospective employer
Edit the generated text, copy it, save it as a PDF, or send it using the system Share menu.
4. Keyword Analyzer
Compare your resume with a job description. The analyzer provides a keyword match percentage, explains the matches in detail, identifies requirements that are not supported by your resume, and suggests specific improvements.
Use the recommendations to highlight relevant experience and skills, add missing keywords, and improve your resume’s chances of passing automated screening by applicant tracking systems (ATS).
5. My Documents
Generated resumes and letters are automatically saved in the app’s local document library. Return to your documents, edit them, and reuse saved information when creating new content. Viewing and manually editing saved documents is free.
Languages:
The interface is available in seven languages. Change the app language in Settings and choose the language of your finished document separately before generating it. Enter your information in the language you are comfortable with and create documents in your chosen language.
Free Access and Subscription:
The app includes limited free generations, analyses, and downloads. Free allowances are provided once and do not renew daily. An active subscription removes these free usage limits for resume and letter generation, resume analysis, document exports, and template downloads.
Important Information:
AI-generated drafts may contain inaccuracies and fictional details. Check all facts, contact details, work experience, and education before sending a document to an employer.
Privacy Policy: https://resumeprofast.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://resumeprofast.com/terms_of_use

bluejetty:00185823:ios.description:
Etkinlik biletlerinizi, Bubilet mobil uygulamasıyla kolayca alın, unutulmaz anılar biriktirin!
Bubilet, konserlerden tiyatrolara, festivallerden çocuk ve spor etkinliklerine kadar geniş bir yelpaze sunan, pratik ve güvenilir bir mobil uygulamadır. Birkaç adımda biletinizi alın ve keyifli etkinliklere katılmanın tadını çıkarın! 
Bubilet Size Neler Sunar?
- Kolaylık ve Hız: En popüler konser, tiyatro, festival ve diğer etkinliklere bir tıkla ulaşın.
- Gelişmiş Arama: Türe, tarihe, lokasyona veya fiyata göre arama yaparak, istediğiniz etkinliği bulun.
- Güvenli Ödeme: 256 bit SSL ve 3D güvenli ödeme sistemi ile kredi veya banka kartınızla rahatça alışveriş yapın.
- Mobil Bilet: Fiziksel bilet taşımanıza gerek kalmadan, biletinizi uygulama üzerinden göstererek etkinliğinize katılın.
Bubilet, kültürel etkinliklere ulaşımınızı kolaylaştırır. Güvenli ödeme altyapısı, kullanıcı dostu arayüzü ve geniş etkinlik yelpazesi ile her zaman yanınızda. Artık konser, tiyatro ve festival biletlerini almak için uzun kuyruklarda beklemenize gerek yok!

bluejetty:00170541:ios.description:
You can find the following functions in the Shokz app:
1) Rich and powerful sound
Enjoy built-in tuning for easy switching between sound modes, while the customizable equalizer allows you to tailor your music to your preferences.
2) Programmable buttons
Assign touch buttons to the functions you use the most.
3) Effortless multipoint pairing
The app allows you to simultaneously connect one pair of headphones to two Bluetooth devices. Additionally, you can easily switch and manage other Shokz headphones directly from the app.
4) Firmware upgrades
Up-to-date firmware keeps your headphones in optimal condition, ensuring you get the best user experience.
5) Playback controls
Adjust the volume, pause/play music, skip songs, and choose playback modes directly through the app.
6) Access information
- Your headphones: Including headphone battery status, user manual, serial number, and additional details.
- Shokz: Explore the brand story, service policy, and other relevant information.
If you have any feedback, please visit the "About Us" section and select "Feedback" to share your comments with us.
Note
The Shokz app is compatible with OpenRun Pro, OpenFit, OpenFit Air, OpenSwim Pro, OpenRun Pro 2, OpenFit 2, OpenMeet, OpenDots ONE, OpenFit 2+, and OpenFit Pro.
Please be aware that certain features may not be accessible on all products.

bluejetty:00060965:ios.name: CalenGoo Calendar
bluejetty:00060965:ios.summary: CalenGoo gives you a fast and easy way to access and modify your Google Calendar with your iPhone, iPod Touch or iPad. It can also be used when you have no Internet connection, using the cached data. Changes are saved and uploaded the next
bluejetty:00060965:ios.description:
CalenGoo gives you a fast and easy way to access and modify your Google Calendar with your iPhone, iPod Touch or iPad. It can also be used when you have no Internet connection, using the cached data. Changes are saved and uploaded the next time you are connected.
The calendar view is similar to the web view of Google Calendar. Events are displayed using the same calendar colors that you use in your Google Calendar, even Google's event colors are supported (please see http://www.calengoo.com/cc ). It also recognizes which calendars are visible and which are hidden. So the view should match the view of your Google Calendar as much as possible. 
CalenGoo also has a month view similar to that of Google Calendar. It can be zoomed and panned to quickly get an overview over the events of a month. Zooming the month is done by using the two-finger-zoom gesture that you know from Safari and the photo application. A double tap opens the tapped day.
It also supports the same kinds of recurrence rules as Google Calendar and displays recurring events correctly even when you are offline or scroll far into the future.
You can also use Google Calendar's feature to invite people to events and see their status (accepted, declined, maybe, no answer). They will get an invitation email with links to e.g. accept or decline the invitation.
Google Calendar has an integrated task list, called Google Tasks. Tasks with a due date are displayed on the corresponding days of the calendar. CalenGoo can do the same, it can sync this list, display your tasks in the calendar views and in a list view and it even makes your tasks available offline. You can edit and add tasks and the changes will be synced with Google Tasks.
You either need a (free) Google Calendar account to use this app or you can use it with your iOS calendars. However using it with Google Calendar has a few advantages.
To get more information, screenshots and a tutorial, please go to http://www.calengoo.com
If you have any problems or suggestions, please send an email to calengoo@dgunia.de or take a look at CalenGoo's support website to get help.
If you think the font is too small and hard to read, you can increase the font size of all calendar views in the settings under "Settings", "Display and Use".
Features ( http://www.calengoo.com ):
- Drag&drop to quickly copy and move events
- Templates to quickly create similar events again. They can even be combined, e.g. one template for the location of an event and another for the attendees
- Print/PDF function to print the day, week, month or agenda view via AirPrint or to email it as a PDF file
- Supports the same recurrence rules as Google Calendar
- Supports Google Calendar's event colors when syncing via OAuth2
- Icons can be assigned to Google Calendar events
- Date/time can be entered using the iOS wheels or by using a keypad
- Fast search function
- Show/edit iOS calendars in addition to Google calendars (or instead of Google calendars)
- Sync with Google Tasks and iOS Reminders
- Reminders can be snoozed and they can be (optionally) repeated every minute
- Birthdays and anniversaries of your contacts can be displayed
- Zoomable month view, which can be configured to scroll horizontally (month by month) or vertically (week by week)
- Events can be linked to contacts
- Floating events and completable events
- Photos and PDF files can be created and attached to events (via Google Drive)
- Calendar selection bar to quickly show and hide single calendars
- The location of an event can be opened with Apple Maps, Google Maps, Navigon, TomTom, Skobbler, Sygic, iGo or Waze
- View/edit calendars that are shared with others via Google Calendar
- Many configuration options to change the way the app looks and works

apple-macos:922765270.description:
*** Named “Most Innovative iPad App of the Year” by Apple App Store ***
LiquidText offers a fast, natural way to review, gather, and organize information across all your documents and webpages—then apply the results to writing reports, meeting prep, or simply studying. Pull out key facts and connect them together, squeeze a document to compare sections, draw a line to connect ideas in different documents, comment on multiple pages at once, build upon your thoughts, and much more.
► WHAT PEOPLE ARE SAYING:
* "If you want to experience the power of going beyond paper, you can download LiquidText" – Cult of Mac
* One of Macworld’s Top 24 Apps for iPad Pro
* One of Time Magazine's Ten Best apps for iPad Pro *
* "There's a better way to organize your research, and the app is it." – iMore, Serenity Caldwell
* “All you need for deep research projects.” – Macworld, Jackie Dove
* "The world changed with...LiquidText" – Law360, Paul Kiesel
* "LiquidText may just be *the* app for reviewing and annotating PDFs using Apple's tablet and stylus." – CIO Magazine, James Martin
* “One of the most powerful, original iPad apps I've tried in years” – Federico Viticci, MacStories.net
► LIQUIDTEXT’S COMPLETE FEATURE SET INCLUDES:
(Features with * require a paid upgrade.)
Import
• Create a workspace and import all the documents and web pages you need
• Compatible with PDF, Word, and PowerPoint document types
• Import from Dropbox, iCloud Drive, Box, email, and more
• Import content from webpage or send to LiquidText directly from Safari
• Instant OCR to select text in scanned documents; do a full document-OCR to search as well!*
• Import documents & metadata directly from reference managers (supports Zotero and Mendeley)*
Interact
• Pull excerpts from all the documents in your project into the Workspace area
• Add your own notes (typed or written) to the Workspace area
• Freely draw on your notes, or on the workspace itself*
• Organize excerpts and notes into groups
• Connect anything - draw live “ink links” that span pages, documents, notes, and more*
• Create mind-maps by drawing “ink links” connecting your excerpts/notes to one another *
• Get context - tap notes and excerpts to find original source
Compare
• Pinch a document to compare different distant pages side by side
• Collapse text to see annotated parts side-by-side
• Collapse text to view search results(s) side-by-side
• Import unlimited number of documents into a project, view up to 3 at once*
Annotate
• Freely draw* or highlight on your document, notes, or the workspace itself
• Add margin notes/comments to text, images, notes, and excerpts
• Comment on two or more selections simultaneously
• Replace document with a newer version (and annotations are brought to new doc)*
Search
• Search for keywords across all your LiquidText documents
• Find keywords in title or text of your documents*
• Bulk highlight, tag, or link to your search results*
Realtime Collaboration
• Invite colleagues into your shared projects and work together in near realtime*
• Leave comments and notifications for your collaborators*
• Privacy controls: set whether each workspace & document in your project is shared or private*
Easy Export
• Export your project as a PDF (includes your Workspace and documents)
• Export your project as a Word file (converts your notes/excerpts into a linear document) 
• Send a full LiquidText file for those with the app.
• Send files by email or to Dropbox, iCloud Drive, Zotero, and more*
Sync & Backup*
• Real-time, cross-platform sync
• Continuous cloud backup
• Multi-device display: 
• Use your desktop or tablet as additional display for your other device
• Use your tablet for freehand inking while viewing and keyboarding on your desktop
See our terms of use at https://www.liquidtext.net/terms-of-use
